146	def _normalise_payloads(
147	    *,
148	    estimator_id: str,
149	    parameters: dict[str, Any],
150	    fit_summary: dict[str, Any] | None,
151	    training_context: dict[str, Any] | None,
152	    source_kind: str,
153	) -> tuple[str, str, dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any] | None, dict[str, Any] | None, str]:
154	    normalized_estimator_id = str(estimator_id or "").strip()
155	    if not normalized_estimator_id:
156	        raise ValueError("estimator_id is required")
157	
158	    if source_kind not in _VALID_SOURCE_KINDS:
159	        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported source_kind {source_kind!r}; expected one of {sorted(_VALID_SOURCE_KINDS)}")
160	
161	    normalized_parameters = dict(_sanitize_json_payload(parameters or {}))
162	    fitted_param_version = str(normalized_parameters.get("fitted_param_version") or "").strip()
163	    if not fitted_param_version:
164	        raise ValueError("parameters must include fitted_param_version")
165	
166	    normalized_fit_summary = None
167	    if fit_summary is not None:
168	        normalized_fit_summary = dict(_sanitize_json_payload(fit_summary))
169	
170	    normalized_training_context = None
171	    if training_context is not None:
172	        normalized_training_context = dict(_sanitize_json_payload(training_context))
173	
174	    return (
175	        normalized_estimator_id,
176	        fitted_param_version,
177	        normalized_parameters,
178	        normalized_fit_summary,
179	        normalized_training_context,
180	        source_kind,
181	    )
182	
183	
184	def persist_fitted_params_snapshot(
185	    *,
186	    estimator_id: str,
187	    parameters: dict[str, Any],
188	    fit_summary: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
189	    training_context: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
190	    source_kind: Literal["fit", "import"] = "fit",
191	    set_head: bool = True,
192	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig | None = None,
193	) -> PersistResult:
194	    (
195	        normalized_estimator_id,
196	        fitted_param_version,
197	        normalized_parameters,
198	        normalized_fit_summary,
199	        normalized_training_context,
200	        normalized_source_kind,
201	    ) = _normalise_payloads(
202	        estimator_id=estimator_id,
203	        parameters=parameters,
204	        fit_summary=fit_summary,
205	        training_context=training_context,
206	        source_kind=source_kind,
207	    )
208	
209	    database = _ensure_database(storage_config)
210	    created = False
211	    head_updated = False
212	
213	    with database.session_scope() as session:
214	        snapshot_row = session.get(FS10EstimatorFitSnapshotRow, fitted_param_version)
215	        if snapshot_row is None:
216	            snapshot_row = FS10EstimatorFitSnapshotRow(
217	                fitted_param_version=fitted_param_version,
218	                estimator_id=normalized_estimator_id,
219	                parameters_json=normalized_parameters,
220	                fit_summary_json=normalized_fit_summary,
221	                training_context_json=normalized_training_context,
222	                source_kind=normalized_source_kind,
223	                created_at=utc_now(),
224	            )
225	            session.add(snapshot_row)
226	            created = True
227	        else:
228	            snapshot = _snapshot_from_row(snapshot_row)
229	            expected = FittedParamsSnapshot(
230	                estimator_id=normalized_estimator_id,
231	                fitted_param_version=fitted_param_version,
232	                parameters=normalized_parameters,
233	                fit_summary=normalized_fit_summary,
234	                training_context=normalized_training_context,
235	                source_kind=normalized_source_kind,
236	                created_at=snapshot.created_at,
237	            )
238	            if (
239	                snapshot.estimator_id != expected.estimator_id
240	                or snapshot.parameters != expected.parameters
241	                or snapshot.fit_summary != expected.fit_summary
242	                or snapshot.training_context != expected.training_context
243	                or snapshot.source_kind != expected.source_kind
244	            ):
245	                raise ValueError(
246	                    f"Existing fitted-params snapshot {fitted_param_version!r} does not match the new payload; snapshot rows are immutable."
247	                )
248	
249	        if set_head:
250	            head_row = session.get(FS10EstimatorFitHeadRow, normalized_estimator_id)
251	            if head_row is None:
252	                session.add(
253	                    FS10EstimatorFitHeadRow(
254	                        estimator_id=normalized_estimator_id,
255	                        fitted_param_version=fitted_param_version,
256	                        updated_at=utc_now(),
257	                    )
258	                )
259	                head_updated = True
260	            elif head_row.fitted_param_version != fitted_param_version:
261	                head_row.fitted_param_version = fitted_param_version
262	                head_row.updated_at = utc_now()
263	                head_updated = True
264	
265	        session.flush()
266	        assert snapshot_row is not None
267	        snapshot = _snapshot_from_row(snapshot_row)
268	
269	    return PersistResult(snapshot=snapshot, created=created, head_updated=head_updated)
270	
271	
272	def load_fitted_params_snapshot(
273	    *,
274	    estimator_id: str | None = None,
275	    fitted_param_version: str | None = None,
276	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig | None = None,
277	) -> FittedParamsSnapshot | None:
278	    database = _ensure_database(storage_config)
279	
280	    with database.session_scope() as session:
281	        row: FS10EstimatorFitSnapshotRow | None
282	        if fitted_param_version is not None:
283	            row = session.get(FS10EstimatorFitSnapshotRow, str(fitted_param_version))
284	        else:
285	            normalized_estimator_id = str(estimator_id or "").strip()
286	            if not normalized_estimator_id:
287	                raise ValueError("estimator_id is required when fitted_param_version is not provided")
288	            head_row = session.get(FS10EstimatorFitHeadRow, normalized_estimator_id)
289	            if head_row is None:
290	                return None
291	            row = session.get(FS10EstimatorFitSnapshotRow, head_row.fitted_param_version)
292	        if row is None:
293	            return None
294	        return _snapshot_from_row(row)
295

297	def load_fitted_parameters(
298	    *,
299	    estimator_id: str | None = None,
300	    fitted_param_version: str | None = None,
301	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig | None = None,
302	) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
303	    snapshot = load_fitted_params_snapshot(
304	        estimator_id=estimator_id,
305	        fitted_param_version=fitted_param_version,

313	def export_fitted_params_snapshot(
314	    *,
315	    estimator_id: str | None = None,
316	    fitted_param_version: str | None = None,
317	    export_dir: Path = DEFAULT_FITTED_PARAMS_EXPORT_DIR,
318	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig | None = None,
319	) -> Path | None:
320	    snapshot = load_fitted_params_snapshot(
321	        estimator_id=estimator_id,
322	        fitted_param_version=fitted_param_version,
323	        storage_config=storage_config,
324	    )
325	    if snapshot is None:
326	        return None
327	
328	    estimator_dir = Path(export_dir) / snapshot.estimator_id
329	    estimator_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
330	    path = estimator_dir / "latest.json"
331	    path.write_text(json.dumps(snapshot.export_payload(), indent=2, default=str), encoding="utf-8")
332	    return path
333	
334	
335	def import_legacy_fitted_params_dir(
336	    *,
337	    import_dir: Path = DEFAULT_FITTED_PARAMS_EXPORT_DIR,
338	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig | None = None,
339	) -> ImportReport:
340	    import_dir = Path(import_dir)
341	    if not import_dir.exists():
342	        return ImportReport(
343	            estimators_seen=0,
344	            files_seen=0,
345	            snapshots_imported=0,
346	            snapshots_skipped=0,
347	            heads_updated=0,
348	            errors=(),
349	        )
350	
351	    estimators_seen = 0
352	    files_seen = 0
353	    snapshots_imported = 0
354	    snapshots_skipped = 0
355	    heads_updated = 0
356	    errors: list[str] = []
357	
358	    for estimator_dir in sorted(path for path in import_dir.iterdir() if path.is_dir()):
359	        estimators_seen += 1
360	        estimator_id = estimator_dir.name
361	        latest_version: str | None = None
362	        imported_versions: list[str] = []
363	
364	        for path in sorted(estimator_dir.glob("*.json")):
365	            files_seen += 1
366	            try:
367	                payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
368	            except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
369	                errors.append(f"{path}: failed to read legacy fitted params ({exc})")
370	                continue
371	
372	            parameters = payload.get("parameters")
373	            if not isinstance(parameters, dict):
374	                errors.append(f"{path}: missing or invalid parameters payload")
375	                continue
376	
377	            legacy_estimator_id = str(payload.get("estimator_id") or estimator_id).strip() or estimator_id
378	            fit_summary = payload.get("fit_summary")
379	            training_context = payload.get("training_context")
380	            created_at_raw = str(payload.get("persisted_at") or "").strip()
381	
382	            try:
383	                result = persist_fitted_params_snapshot(
384	                    estimator_id=legacy_estimator_id,
385	                    parameters=parameters,
386	                    fit_summary=fit_summary if isinstance(fit_summary, dict) else None,
387	                    training_context=training_context if isinstance(training_context, dict) else None,
388	                    source_kind="import",
389	                    set_head=False,
390	                    storage_config=storage_config,
391	                )
392	            except ValueError as exc:
393	                errors.append(f"{path}: {exc}")
394	                continue
395	
396	            if result.created:
397	                snapshots_imported += 1
398	            else:
399	                snapshots_skipped += 1
400	
401	            imported_versions.append(result.snapshot.fitted_param_version)
402	            if path.name.lower() == "latest.json":
403	                latest_version = result.snapshot.fitted_param_version
404	            elif not latest_version and created_at_raw:
405	                latest_version = result.snapshot.fitted_param_version
406	
407	        if latest_version is None and len(imported_versions) == 1:
408	            latest_version = imported_versions[0]
409	
410	        if latest_version is not None:
411	            latest_snapshot = load_fitted_params_snapshot(
412	                fitted_param_version=latest_version,
413	                storage_config=storage_config,
414	            )
415	            assert latest_snapshot is not None
416	            result = persist_fitted_params_snapshot(
417	                estimator_id=latest_snapshot.estimator_id,
418	                parameters=latest_snapshot.parameters,
419	                fit_summary=latest_snapshot.fit_summary,
420	                training_context=latest_snapshot.training_context,
421	                source_kind="import",
422	                set_head=True,
423	                storage_config=storage_config,
424	            )
425	            if result.head_updated:
426	                heads_updated += 1
427	
428	    return ImportReport(
429	        estimators_seen=estimators_seen,
430	        files_seen=files_seen,
431	        snapshots_imported=snapshots_imported,
432	        snapshots_skipped=snapshots_skipped,
433	        heads_updated=heads_updated,
434	        errors=tuple(errors),
435	    )
436

          export-mirror directory). Otherwise the base is used directly.
    
        The base is always a valid `DefensibilityJudge`, so callers can swap

1	"""Factories for constructing FS11 judges with the right configuration.
2	
3	W1-F closes the FS4 / FS11 outer loop by giving dispatch a one-line way
4	to plug a track-record-aware judge in. The factory:
5	
6	1. Loads a `TrackRecordSnapshot` from DB-backed authority, with optional export-mirror fallback.
7	2. Constructs a `TrackRecordAwareDefensibilityJudge` parameterised on
8	   the right node role.
9	3. Returns it as the `DefensibilityJudge` for that role.
10	
11	Per FS4 §9 the outer loop does NOT update parameters — it informs FS11
12	scoring + FS4 selection. This factory is the seam where that signal
13	flows in.
14	"""
15	
16	from __future__ import annotations
17	
18	from pathlib import Path
19	
20	from packages.storage.runtime_config import StorageRuntimeConfig
21	
22	from .defensibility_judge import DefensibilityJudge, default_defensibility_judge
23	from .llm_scorer import LLMDefensibilityJudge, fs11_llm_scorer_enabled
24	
25	
26	def _resolve_base_judge() -> DefensibilityJudge:
27	    """Pick the bottom-of-stack judge based on the FS11 LLM-scorer env flag.
28	
29	    When ``ELIJAH_FS11_LLM_SCORER`` is set, returns the live LLM scorer;
30	    otherwise the deterministic stub. The track-record-aware wrapper layers
31	    on top of whichever base is chosen — the snapshot-driven adjustment
32	    works the same way regardless of how the base score was produced.
33	    """
34	    if fs11_llm_scorer_enabled():
35	        return LLMDefensibilityJudge()
36	    return default_defensibility_judge
37	
38	
39	def build_judge(
40	    *,
41	    role: str,
42	    track_records_dir: Path | None = None,
43	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig | None = None,
44	) -> DefensibilityJudge:
45	    """Build a judge for `role` ("driver" / "indicator" / "target").
46	
47	    Layering:
48	    - Bottom: the **base scorer** — LLM-driven if ``ELIJAH_FS11_LLM_SCORER``
49	      is set, else the Phase B stub. Selected via :func:`_resolve_base_judge`.
50	    - Top: a **track-record-aware wrapper** if a populated track-record
51	      snapshot exists in DB-backed authority (or, as a fallback, in an
52	      export-mirror directory). Otherwise the base is used directly.
53	
54	    The base is always a valid `DefensibilityJudge`, so callers can swap
55	    layers in / out without breaking the dispatch contract. The
56	    track-record signal only flows when records exist; the LLM signal only
57	    flows when the env flag is set.
58	    """
59	    base = _resolve_base_judge()
60	    if track_records_dir is None and storage_config is None:
61	        return base
62	
63	    from .track_record_loader import load_track_record_snapshot
64	
65	    snapshot = load_track_record_snapshot(track_records_dir=track_records_dir, storage_config=storage_config)
66	    if not snapshot.buckets:
67	        return base
68	
69	    from .track_record_aware_judge import TrackRecordAwareDefensibilityJudge
70	
71	    return TrackRecordAwareDefensibilityJudge(snapshot=snapshot, role=role, base_judge=base)
72	
73	
74	def build_judge_from_snapshot(
75	    *,
76	    role: str,
77	    snapshot: object,
78	) -> DefensibilityJudge:
79	    """Variant that takes a pre-loaded snapshot. Useful when the caller
80	    already has the snapshot in memory (e.g. across many dispatch
81	    invocations).
82	
83	    Layering matches :func:`build_judge`: the base scorer is the LLM scorer
84	    if enabled, else the stub.
85	    """
86	    base = _resolve_base_judge()
87	    if not getattr(snapshot, "buckets", None):
88	        return base
89	
90	    from .track_record_aware_judge import TrackRecordAwareDefensibilityJudge
91	
92	    return TrackRecordAwareDefensibilityJudge(snapshot=snapshot, role=role, base_judge=base)
93	
94	
95	__all__ = [
96	    "build_judge",
97	    "build_judge_from_snapshot",
98	]

Here's the lane 3 summary for you:

## Lane 3: Critical Path Overview

Lane 3 is the **critical data-preparation and inference pipeline** that transforms forecasting questions from raw research into defensible predictions. It flows: QC infrastructure → validation setup → FS2 (retrieval) → FS4 (estimation) → FS5 (graph weighting) → FS6/FS7 (inference + output).

---

## Tickets in Lane 3

**SPI-229: Port FS11 QC infrastructure (scorecards, concerns, gates, judges)** — Status: Done
DB-backed quality-control scorecards, defensibility judges, and gate decisions for five measurement families (Analytical, Research, Driver, Indicator, Graph). Provides evidence and guardrails that block all downstream features (FS2, FS4, FS5, FS10).

**SPI-230: Port FS10 validation lifecycle and tuning authority** — Status: In Progress
Validation packages, candidate items, labels, splits, tuning runs, and metric snapshots—the canonical data-lifecycle owner. Blocks honest analytical gates and is the largest port (~35+ files), handling promotion separation and operator CLI surfaces.

**SPI-231: Port FS2 runtime, current-resolution, and Research Defensibility bridge** — Status: Todo
DB-backed FS2 baseline/current-resolution rows and same-run FS11 Research Defensibility evidence. Enables retrieval and current-resolution, blocking FS2 rollout; can run in parallel with FS4 once FS10 lands.

**SPI-232: Port FS3 extraction, graph admission, and document-pack validation** — Status: Done
Graph-construction validation packages, strengthened extraction/admission surfaces, and entity compliance helpers. Driver/indicator extraction and graph admission are blocking (covered by VD-GRAPH-CONSTRUCTION).

**SPI-233: Port FS4 estimator dispatch, fitted-state, and training stack** — Status: Todo
Estimator classes, target cascade/parallel driver races, fitted parameter storage, and FS10 training orchestration. Baseline/prior estimation and Fermi prompt tuning are blocking rollout; can run in parallel with FS2 once FS10 lands.

**SPI-234: Port FS5 edge weighting and downstream graph-impact validation** — Status: Todo
Edge-weight validation replay, FS11 QC hooks, and graph-impact contract tests. Edge direction/weight calibration is blocking and has direct guardrails; runs sequentially after FS4.

**SPI-235: Port FS6 inference and FS7 output validation surfaces** — Status: Todo
Posterior/summary replay components, QC tests, and validation replay contracts. FS6 handles posterior inference and calibration; FS7 handles summary faithfulness and audit-trace consistency; runs sequentially after FS5.

---

## End-to-End Lane 3 Flow

1. **SPI-229** establishes QC authority (scorecards + defensibility judges)
2. **SPI-230** manages validation data and tuning (required by all downstream)
3. **SPI-231 + SPI-233** run in parallel: FS2 retrieval/research and FS4 baseline estimation (both unblock after FS10)
4. **SPI-234** weights graph edges with FS5 (depends on FS4)
5. **SPI-235** runs posterior inference (FS6) and generates final summaries (FS7)

This lane **gates the entire forecasting inference pipeline**—no question can move to prediction without validated data, quality gates, baselines, graph structure, and posterior inference.
```

> AGENT

Here's the lane in plain terms:

---

**What lane 3 is for:** Building out the full pipeline that takes a forecasting question, validates it's good data, runs it through the estimation and reasoning system, and produces a defensible prediction. Every feature-set (FS) in this lane is a stage in that journey.

---

**The stages:**

**SPI-229 — QC infrastructure** ✅ *Done*
The quality-control layer. Scores every piece of work on axes like "is the research solid?", "are the drivers credible?", and issues pass/fail gate decisions. Everything downstream uses these scores.

**SPI-230 — Validation data lifecycle** ← *in progress*
The data management layer. Manages which questions are in the validation set, splits them into train/eval, tracks fitted model parameters, and runs tuning experiments. Every downstream stage depends on knowing which questions to use and what parameters to use on them.

**SPI-231 — FS2: Retrieval and research** *starts after SPI-230*
The "go find information" stage. Runs baseline retrieval, resolves current-resolution facts, and writes the Research Defensibility evidence into QC. Can run in parallel with SPI-233.

**SPI-233 — FS4: Estimation and baselines** *starts after SPI-230*
The "make a forecast" stage. Runs the actual estimator models (Dirichlet, Weibull, Fermi LLM etc.), stores fitted parameters, and kicks off FS10 training orchestration. Runs in parallel with SPI-231.

**SPI-234 — FS5: Edge weighting** *starts after SPI-233*
Calibrates how much weight each edge in the reasoning graph should carry, with QC hooks validating the calibration. Needs FS4 to be done first.

**SPI-235 — FS6/FS7: Inference and output** *starts after SPI-234*
The final stage. FS6 runs posterior inference to produce the actual probability estimate; FS7 generates the summary and checks it's faithful to the underlying reasoning. Nothing comes after this — it's the finished prediction.

---

So: good data → quality checks → research → estimation → graph weighting → final prediction. SPI-230 PR1 is merged and we're picking up PR2 next.

"""FS10 validation per-component artifact builders.

Each module here owns the artifact emitted by one feature-set's component
during a validation run. Per FS10 §4 / §6, the validation harness collects
these per-FS artifacts so the cross-FS failure-distribution analytics can
attribute issues to the right upstream layer.

Phase D scope: adds `baseline_estimation` (FS4) artifact emission.
Subsequent phases add per-FS modules as their components ship.
"""

I need to flag this before going further. The original PR2 scope had hidden dependencies I missed.

**The reality:**

`gate_runner.py` and `graph_construction.py` depend on three big modules that aren't on dev yet:
- `fs10_validation/real_packages.py` (938 lines)
- `fs10_validation/sample_data.py` (507 lines)
- `fs10_validation/real_tune_evaluator.py` (669 lines)

And `fs1_question_definition.py` depends on `core/fs1_target_set_integrity.py` (142 lines), and `baseline_estimation.py` depends on `packages.domain.baselines.dispatch` which isn't on dev (it's SPI-233).

So the full "PR2" is closer to ~3,500 lines + tests, not the ~1,600 I quoted.

**Realistic split proposal:**

- **PR2a** — Just the self-contained component dataclasses (FS3, FS5, FS6, FS7): ~536 lines. Small, clean, unblocks downstream.
- **PR2b** — FS1 component + `core/fs1_target_set_integrity.py`: ~306 lines. Self-contained.
- **PR2c** — `real_packages.py` + `sample_data.py` + `gate_runner.py`: ~2,000 lines. The actual gate runner machinery.
- **PR2d** — `real_tune_evaluator.py` + `graph_construction.py`: ~1,200 lines. Graph validation.
- **baseline_estimation component** — defer to SPI-233 since it depends on FS4 dispatch code.

PR2a is the safe first step — pure dataclasses, no dependencies on missing code. Want me to proceed with that, or do you want a different split now that you see the dependency picture?

"""FS3 extraction artifact emission for FS10 validation runs."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Literal

from core.node_data import node_detail

NodeRole = Literal["driver", "indicator"]


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ExtractionNodeRecord:
    node_id: str
    node_label: str
    role: NodeRole
    source_mode: str
    generation_mode: str
    grounding_status: str
    epistemic_status: str
    source_context_count: int
    review_required: bool
    quality_flags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    concern_patterns: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ExtractionArtifact:
    question_id: str
    role: NodeRole
    records: list[ExtractionNodeRecord] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def grounded_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(1 for record in self.records if _is_grounded(record))

    @property
    def fallback_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(1 for record in self.records if _uses_fallback(record))

    @property
    def review_required_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(1 for record in self.records if record.review_required)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "question_id": self.question_id,
            "role": self.role,
            "record_count": len(self.records),
            "grounded_count": self.grounded_count,
            "fallback_count": self.fallback_count,
            "review_required_count": self.review_required_count,
            "records": [record.to_dict() for record in self.records],
        }


def build_driver_extraction_artifact(
    *,
    nodes: list[Any],
    question_id: str,
) -> ExtractionArtifact:
    return ExtractionArtifact(
        question_id=question_id,
        role="driver",
        records=[_record_from_node(node, "driver") for node in nodes if _node_role(node) == "driver"],
    )


def build_indicator_extraction_artifact(
    *,
    nodes: list[Any],
    question_id: str,
) -> ExtractionArtifact:
    return ExtractionArtifact(
        question_id=question_id,
        role="indicator",
        records=[_record_from_node(node, "indicator") for node in nodes if _node_role(node) == "indicator"],
    )


def _node_role(node: Any) -> NodeRole | None:
    raw = str(getattr(node, "type", "") or "").strip().lower()
    if raw in {"driver", "indicator"}:
        return raw  # type: ignore[return-value]
    return None


def _node_id(node: Any) -> str:
    raw = getattr(node, "id", None)
    if raw in (None, ""):
        raw = getattr(node, "node_id", "")
    return str(raw or "").strip()


def _detail(node: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return dict(node_detail(getattr(node, "data", {}) or {}) or {})


def _quality_flags(detail: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    raw = detail.get("quality_flags")
    if not isinstance(raw, list):
        return []
    return sorted({str(item).strip() for item in raw if str(item).strip()})


def _concern_patterns(detail: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    patterns: set[str] = set()
    for key in ("concerns", "baseline_concerns", "estimation_concerns"):
        raw = detail.get(key)
        if not isinstance(raw, list):
            continue
        for item in raw:
            if not isinstance(item, dict):
                continue
            pattern = str(item.get("detected_pattern") or "").strip()
            if pattern:
                patterns.add(pattern)
    baseline = detail.get("baseline")
    if isinstance(baseline, dict):
        raw = baseline.get("concerns")
        if isinstance(raw, list):
            for item in raw:
                if not isinstance(item, dict):
                    continue
                pattern = str(item.get("detected_pattern") or "").strip()
                if pattern:
                    patterns.add(pattern)
    return sorted(patterns)


def _record_from_node(node: Any, role: NodeRole) -> ExtractionNodeRecord:
    detail = _detail(node)
    source_contexts = getattr(node, "data", {}).get("source_contexts") or []
    return ExtractionNodeRecord(
        node_id=_node_id(node),
        node_label=str(getattr(node, "label", "") or "").strip(),
        role=role,
        source_mode=str(detail.get("source_mode") or "").strip(),
        generation_mode=str(detail.get("generation_mode") or "").strip(),
        grounding_status=str(detail.get("grounding_status") or "").strip(),
        epistemic_status=str(detail.get("epistemic_status") or "").strip(),
        source_context_count=len(source_contexts) if isinstance(source_contexts, list) else 0,
        review_required=bool(detail.get("review_required")),
        quality_flags=_quality_flags(detail),
        concern_patterns=_concern_patterns(detail),
    )


def _is_grounded(record: ExtractionNodeRecord) -> bool:
    if record.source_context_count > 0:
        return True
    return record.grounding_status not in {"", "ungrounded", "llm_compensated"}


def _uses_fallback(record: ExtractionNodeRecord) -> bool:
    source_mode = record.source_mode.lower()
    generation_mode = record.generation_mode.lower()
    if "fallback" in source_mode or "fallback" in generation_mode:
        return True
    if "free_knowledge" in source_mode or "free_knowledge" in generation_mode:
        return True
    return record.grounding_status == "llm_compensated"


__all__ = [
    "ExtractionArtifact",
    "ExtractionNodeRecord",
    "build_driver_extraction_artifact",
    "build_indicator_extraction_artifact",
]

"""FS5 edge-weight artifact emission for FS10 validation runs."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from typing import Any


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class EdgeWeightRecord:
    edge_id: str
    from_node_id: str
    from_node_label: str
    to_node_id: str
    to_node_label: str
    weight: float
    relationship_judgment: str
    assessment_source: str
    causal_validity: int | None
    empirical_grounding: int | None
    quality_status: str
    review_required: bool
    concern_patterns: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class EdgeWeightArtifact:
    question_id: str
    records: list[EdgeWeightRecord] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def weak_edge_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(
            1
            for record in self.records
            if (record.causal_validity is not None and record.causal_validity <= 2)
            or (record.empirical_grounding is not None and record.empirical_grounding <= 2)
        )

    @property
    def review_required_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(1 for record in self.records if record.review_required)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "question_id": self.question_id,
            "record_count": len(self.records),
            "weak_edge_count": self.weak_edge_count,
            "review_required_count": self.review_required_count,
            "records": [record.to_dict() for record in self.records],
        }


def build_edge_weight_artifact(
    *,
    question_id: str,
    edges: list[Any],
    node_lookup: dict[str, Any],
) -> EdgeWeightArtifact:
    records: list[EdgeWeightRecord] = []
    for edge in edges:
        edge_type = str(getattr(edge, "type", "") or "").strip().upper()
        if edge_type != "CONDITIONAL":
            continue
        data = dict(getattr(edge, "data", {}) or {})
        from_id = str(getattr(edge, "from_node", "") or "").strip()
        to_id = str(getattr(edge, "to_node", "") or "").strip()
        quality = dict(data.get("edge_quality") or {})
        records.append(
            EdgeWeightRecord(
                edge_id=str(getattr(edge, "edge_id", "") or "").strip(),
                from_node_id=from_id,
                from_node_label=str(getattr(node_lookup.get(from_id), "label", "") or "").strip(),
                to_node_id=to_id,
                to_node_label=str(getattr(node_lookup.get(to_id), "label", "") or "").strip(),
                weight=float(getattr(edge, "weight", 1.0) or 1.0),
                relationship_judgment=str(data.get("relationship_judgment") or "").strip(),
                assessment_source=str(data.get("assessment_source") or "").strip(),
                causal_validity=_int_or_none(data.get("causal_validity")),
                empirical_grounding=_int_or_none(data.get("empirical_grounding")),
                quality_status=str(quality.get("status") or "").strip(),
                review_required=_review_required(data=data, quality=quality),
                concern_patterns=_concern_patterns(data=data, quality=quality),
            )
        )
    return EdgeWeightArtifact(question_id=question_id, records=records)


def _int_or_none(value: Any) -> int | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None


def _review_required(*, data: dict[str, Any], quality: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    status = str(quality.get("status") or "").strip().lower()
    if status in {"pending", "llm_error"}:
        return True
    if _int_or_none(data.get("causal_validity")) in {1, 2}:
        return True
    if _int_or_none(data.get("empirical_grounding")) in {1, 2}:
        return True
    return False


def _concern_patterns(*, data: dict[str, Any], quality: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    patterns: set[str] = set()
    status = str(quality.get("status") or "").strip().lower()
    if status == "pending":
        patterns.add("edge_quality_pending")
    if status == "llm_error":
        patterns.add("edge_quality_llm_error")
    causal_validity = _int_or_none(data.get("causal_validity"))
    empirical_grounding = _int_or_none(data.get("empirical_grounding"))
    if causal_validity is not None and causal_validity <= 2:
        patterns.add("weak_causal_validity")
    if empirical_grounding is not None and empirical_grounding <= 2:
        patterns.add("weak_empirical_grounding")
    if not str(data.get("relationship_judgment") or "").strip():
        patterns.add("missing_relationship_judgment")
    return sorted(patterns)


__all__ = [
    "EdgeWeightArtifact",
    "EdgeWeightRecord",
    "build_edge_weight_artifact",
]

"""FS6 inference/sensitivity artifact emission for FS10 validation runs."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from typing import Any

from core.node_data import node_detail_value


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class TargetPosteriorRecord:
    target_id: str
    target_label: str
    option_index: int
    baseline_p: float | None
    posterior_p: float | None
    delta: float | None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class PosteriorInferenceArtifact:
    question_id: str
    records: list[TargetPosteriorRecord] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def posterior_present_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(1 for record in self.records if record.posterior_p is not None)

    @property
    def posterior_sum(self) -> float:
        return sum(float(record.posterior_p or 0.0) for record in self.records)

    @property
    def normalized(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.records) and self.posterior_present_count == len(self.records) and abs(self.posterior_sum - 1.0) <= 1e-6

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "question_id": self.question_id,
            "record_count": len(self.records),
            "posterior_present_count": self.posterior_present_count,
            "posterior_sum": self.posterior_sum,
            "normalized": self.normalized,
            "records": [record.to_dict() for record in self.records],
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SensitivityIndicatorRecord:
    indicator_id: str
    indicator_label: str
    posterior_p: float
    max_delta: float

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SensitivityAnalysisArtifact:
    question_id: str
    candidates_evaluated: int
    records: list[SensitivityIndicatorRecord] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "question_id": self.question_id,
            "candidates_evaluated": self.candidates_evaluated,
            "record_count": len(self.records),
            "top_indicator_label": self.records[0].indicator_label if self.records else "",
            "max_delta": self.records[0].max_delta if self.records else 0.0,
            "records": [record.to_dict() for record in self.records],
        }


def build_posterior_inference_artifact(
    *,
    nodes: list[Any],
    question_id: str,
) -> PosteriorInferenceArtifact:
    records: list[TargetPosteriorRecord] = []
    for node in nodes:
        if str(getattr(node, "type", "") or "").strip().lower() != "target":
            continue
        baseline_p = _float_or_none(getattr(node, "baseline_p", None))
        posterior_p = _float_or_none(getattr(node, "posterior_p", None))
        delta = None
        if baseline_p is not None and posterior_p is not None:
            delta = posterior_p - baseline_p
        records.append(
            TargetPosteriorRecord(
                target_id=_node_id(node),
                target_label=str(getattr(node, "label", "") or "").strip(),
                option_index=_option_index(node),
                baseline_p=baseline_p,
                posterior_p=posterior_p,
                delta=delta,
            )
        )
    records.sort(key=lambda record: (record.option_index, record.target_label.lower(), record.target_id))
    return PosteriorInferenceArtifact(question_id=question_id, records=records)


def build_sensitivity_analysis_artifact(
    *,
    question_id: str,
    sensitivity_summary: dict[str, Any],
) -> SensitivityAnalysisArtifact:
    records: list[SensitivityIndicatorRecord] = []
    for item in list(sensitivity_summary.get("top_indicators") or []):
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        indicator_id = str(item.get("indicator_id") or "").strip()
        indicator_label = str(item.get("indicator_label") or "").strip()
        if not indicator_id:
            continue
        records.append(
            SensitivityIndicatorRecord(
                indicator_id=indicator_id,
                indicator_label=indicator_label,
                posterior_p=float(item.get("posterior_p") or 0.0),
                max_delta=float(item.get("max_delta") or 0.0),
            )
        )
    return SensitivityAnalysisArtifact(
        question_id=question_id,
        candidates_evaluated=int(sensitivity_summary.get("candidates_evaluated") or 0),
        records=records,
    )


def _node_id(node: Any) -> str:
    raw = getattr(node, "id", None)
    if raw in (None, ""):
        raw = getattr(node, "node_id", "")
    return str(raw or "").strip()


def _option_index(node: Any) -> int:
    raw = node_detail_value(getattr(node, "data", {}) or {}, "option_index", 10**6)
    try:
        return int(raw)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return 10**6


def _float_or_none(value: Any) -> float | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    try:
        return float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None


__all__ = [
    "PosteriorInferenceArtifact",
    "SensitivityAnalysisArtifact",
    "SensitivityIndicatorRecord",
    "TargetPosteriorRecord",
    "build_posterior_inference_artifact",
    "build_sensitivity_analysis_artifact",
]

"""FS7 summary artifact emission for FS10 validation runs."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class QuestionSummaryArtifact:
    question_id: str
    classification: str
    options: list[str]
    prior: list[float]
    posterior: list[float]
    analysis: str

    @property
    def required_fields_complete(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.options) and len(self.options) == len(self.prior) == len(self.posterior) and bool(self.analysis.strip())

    @property
    def top_option(self) -> str:
        if not self.options or len(self.options) != len(self.posterior):
            return ""
        top_index = max(range(len(self.posterior)), key=lambda index: float(self.posterior[index] or 0.0))
        return str(self.options[top_index])

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "question_id": self.question_id,
            "classification": self.classification,
            "option_count": len(self.options),
            "options": list(self.options),
            "prior": list(self.prior),
            "posterior": list(self.posterior),
            "analysis": self.analysis,
            "required_fields_complete": self.required_fields_complete,
            "top_option": self.top_option,
        }


def build_question_summary_artifact(
    *,
    question_id: str,
    summary_entry: dict[str, Any],
) -> QuestionSummaryArtifact:
    return QuestionSummaryArtifact(
        question_id=question_id,
        classification=str(summary_entry.get("classification") or "").strip(),
        options=[str(value) for value in list(summary_entry.get("options") or [])],
        prior=[float(value or 0.0) for value in list(summary_entry.get("prior") or [])],
        posterior=[float(value or 0.0) for value in list(summary_entry.get("posterior") or [])],
        analysis=str(summary_entry.get("analysis") or "").strip(),
    )


__all__ = [
    "QuestionSummaryArtifact",
    "build_question_summary_artifact",
]

  "content": "\"\"\"FS6 inference/sensitivity artifact emission for FS10 validation runs.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom core.node_data import node_detail_value\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)\nclass TargetPosteriorRecord:\n    target_id: str\n    target_label: str\n    option_index: int\n    baseline_p: float | None\n    posterior_p: float | None\n    delta: float | None\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return asdict(self)\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)\nclass PosteriorInferenceArtifact:\n    question_id: str\n    records: list[TargetPosteriorRecord] = field(default_factory=list)\n\n    @property\n    def posterior_present_count(self) -> int:\n        return sum(1 for record in self.records if record.posterior_p is not None)\n\n    @property\n    def posterior_sum(self) -> float:\n        return sum(float(record.posterior_p or 0.0) for record in self.records)\n\n    @property\n    def normalized(self) -> bool:\n        return bool(self.records) and self.posterior_present_count == len(self.records) and abs(self.posterior_sum - 1.0) <= 1e-6\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\n            \"question_id\": self.question_id,\n            \"record_count\": len(self.records),\n            \"posterior_present_count\": self.posterior_present_count,\n            \"posterior_sum\": self.posterior_sum,\n            \"normalized\": self.normalized,\n            \"records\": [record.to_dict() for record in self.records],\n        }\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)\nclass SensitivityIndicatorRecord:\n    indicator_id: str\n    indicator_label: str\n    posterior_p: float\n    max_delta: float\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return asdict(self)\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)\nclass SensitivityAnalysisArtifact:\n    question_id: str\n    candidates_evaluated: int\n    records: list[SensitivityIndicatorRecord] = field(default_factory=list)\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\n            \"question_id\": self.question_id,\n            \"candidates_evaluated\": self.candidates_evaluated,\n            \"record_count\": len(self.records),\n            \"top_indicator_label\": self.records[0].indicator_label if self.records else \"\",\n            \"max_delta\": self.records[0].max_delta if self.records else 0.0,\n            \"records\": [record.to_dict() for record in self.records],\n        }\n\n\ndef build_posterior_inference_artifact(\n    *,\n    nodes: list[Any],\n    question_id: str,\n) -> PosteriorInferenceArtifact:\n    records: list[TargetPosteriorRecord] = []\n    for node in nodes:\n        if str(getattr(node, \"type\", \"\") or \"\").strip().lower() != \"target\":\n            continue\n        baseline_p = _float_or_none(getattr(node, \"baseline_p\", None))\n        posterior_p = _float_or_none(getattr(node, \"posterior_p\", None))\n        delta = None\n        if baseline_p is not None and posterior_p is not None:\n            delta = posterior_p - baseline_p\n        records.append(\n            TargetPosteriorRecord(\n                target_id=_node_id(node),\n                target_label=str(getattr(node, \"label\", \"\") or \"\").strip(),\n                option_index=_option_index(node),\n                baseline_p=baseline_p,\n                posterior_p=posterior_p,\n                delta=delta,\n            )\n        )\n    records.sort(key=lambda record: (record.option_index, record.target_label.lower(), record.target_id))\n    return PosteriorInferenceArtifact(question_id=question_id, records=records)\n\n\ndef build_sensitivity_analysis_artifact(\n    *,\n    question_id: str,\n    sensitivity_summary: dict[str, Any],\n) -> SensitivityAnalysisArtifact:\n    records: list[SensitivityIndicatorRecord] = []\n    for item in sensitivity_summary.get(\"top_indicators\") or []:\n        if not isinstance(item, dict):\n            continue\n        indicator_id = str(item.get(\"indicator_id\") or \"\").strip()\n        indicator_label = str(item.get(\"indicator_label\") or \"\").strip()\n        if not indicator_id:\n            continue\n        records.append(\n            SensitivityIndicatorRecord(\n                indicator_id=indicator_id,\n                indicator_label=indicator_label,\n                posterior_p=float(item.get(\"posterior_p\") or 0.0),\n                max_delta=float(item.get(\"max_delta\") or 0.0),\n            )\n        )\n    return SensitivityAnalysisArtifact(\n        question_id=question_id,\n        candidates_evaluated=int(sensitivity_summary.get(\"candidates_evaluated\") or 0),\n        records=records,\n    )\n\n\ndef _node_id(node: Any) -> str:\n    raw = getattr(node, \"id\", None)\n    if raw in (None, \"\"):\n        raw = getattr(node, \"node_id\", \"\")\n    return str(raw or \"\").strip()\n\n\ndef _option_index(node: Any) -> int:\n    raw = node_detail_value(getattr(node, \"data\", {}) or {}, \"option_index\", 10**6)\n    try:\n        return int(raw)\n    except (TypeError, ValueError):\n        return 10**6\n\n\ndef _float_or_none(value: Any) -> float | None:\n    if value is None:\n        return None\n    try:\n        return float(value)\n    except (TypeError, ValueError):\n        return None\n\n\n__all__ = [\n    \"PosteriorInferenceArtifact\",\n    \"SensitivityAnalysisArtifact\",\n    \"SensitivityIndicatorRecord\",\n    \"TargetPosteriorRecord\",\n    \"build_posterior_inference_artifact\",\n    \"build_sensitivity_analysis_artifact\",\n]\n"

Literal\n\nfrom core.node_data import node_detail\n\nNodeRole = Literal[\"driver\", \"indicator\"]\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)\nclass ExtractionNodeRecord:\n    node_id: str\n    node_label: str\n    role: NodeRole\n    source_mode: str\n    generation_mode: str\n    grounding_status: str\n    epistemic_status: str\n    source_context_count: int\n    review_required: bool\n    quality_flags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n    concern_patterns: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return asdict(self)\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)\nclass ExtractionArtifact:\n    question_id: str\n    role: NodeRole\n    records: list[ExtractionNodeRecord] = field(default_factory=list)\n\n    @property\n    def grounded_count(self) -> int:\n        return sum(1 for record in self.records if _is_grounded(record))\n\n    @property\n    def fallback_count(self) -> int:\n        return sum(1 for record in self.records if _uses_fallback(record))\n\n    @property\n    def review_required_count(self) -> int:\n        return sum(1 for record in self.records if record.review_required)\n\n    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        return {\n            \"question_id\": self.question_id,\n            \"role\": self.role,\n            \"record_count\": len(self.records),\n            \"grounded_count\": self.grounded_count,\n            \"fallback_count\": self.fallback_count,\n            \"review_required_count\": self.review_required_count,\n            \"records\": [record.to_dict() for record in self.records],\n        }\n\n\ndef build_driver_extraction_artifact(\n    *,\n    nodes: list[Any],\n    question_id: str,\n) -> ExtractionArtifact:\n    return ExtractionArtifact(\n        question_id=question_id,\n        role=\"driver\",\n        records=[_record_from_node(node, \"driver\") for node in nodes if _node_role(node) == \"driver\"],\n    )\n\n\ndef build_indicator_extraction_artifact(\n    *,\n    nodes: list[Any],\n    question_id: str,\n) -> ExtractionArtifact:\n    return ExtractionArtifact(\n        question_id=question_id,\n        role=\"indicator\",\n        records=[_record_from_node(node, \"indicator\") for node in nodes if _node_role(node) == \"indicator\"],\n    )\n\n\ndef _node_role(node: Any) -> NodeRole | None:\n    raw = str(getattr(node, \"type\", \"\") or \"\").strip().lower()\n    if raw in {\"driver\", \"indicator\"}:\n        return raw  # type: ignore[return-value]\n    return None\n\n\ndef _node_id(node: Any) -> str:\n    raw = getattr(node, \"id\", None)\n    if raw in (None, \"\"):\n        raw = getattr(node, \"node_id\", \"\")\n    return str(raw or \"\").strip()\n\n\ndef _detail(node: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    return dict(node_detail(getattr(node, \"data\", {}) or {}) or {})\n\n\ndef _quality_flags(detail: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:\n    raw = detail.get(\"quality_flags\")\n    if not isinstance(raw, list):\n        return []\n    return sorted({str(item).strip() for item in raw if str(item).strip()})\n\n\ndef _concern_patterns(detail: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:\n    patterns: set[str] = set()\n    for key in (\"concerns\", \"baseline_concerns\", \"estimation_concerns\"):\n        raw = detail.get(key)\n        if not isinstance(raw, list):\n            continue\n        for item in raw:\n            if not isinstance(item, dict):\n                continue\n            pattern = str(item.get(\"detected_pattern\") or \"\").strip()\n            if pattern:\n                patterns.add(pattern)\n    baseline = detail.get(\"baseline\")\n    if isinstance(baseline, dict):\n        raw = baseline.get(\"concerns\")\n        if isinstance(raw, list):\n            for item in raw:\n                if not isinstance(item, dict):\n                    continue\n                pattern = str(item.get(\"detected_pattern\") or \"\").strip()\n                if pattern:\n                    patterns.add(pattern)\n    return sorted(patterns)\n\n\ndef _record_from_node(node: Any, role: NodeRole) -> ExtractionNodeRecord:\n    detail = _detail(node)\n    source_contexts = getattr(node, \"data\", {}).get(\"source_contexts\") or []\n    return ExtractionNodeRecord(\n        node_id=_node_id(node),\n        node_label=str(getattr(node, \"label\", \"\") or \"\").strip(),\n        role=role,\n        source_mode=str(detail.get(\"source_mode\") or \"\").strip(),\n        generation_mode=str(detail.get(\"generation_mode\") or \"\").strip(),\n        grounding_status=str(detail.get(\"grounding_status\") or \"\").strip(),\n        epistemic_status=str(detail.get(\"epistemic_status\") or \"\").strip(),\n        source_context_count=len(source_contexts) if isinstance(source_contexts, list) else 0,\n        review_required=bool(detail.get(\"review_required\")),\n        quality_flags=_quality_flags(detail),\n        concern_patterns=_concern_patterns(detail),\n    )\n\n\ndef _is_grounded(record: ExtractionNodeRecord) -> bool:\n    if record.source_context_count > 0:\n        return True\n    return record.grounding_status not in {\"\", \"ungrounded\", \"llm_compensated\"}\n\n\ndef _uses_fallback(record: ExtractionNodeRecord) -> bool:\n    source_mode = record.source_mode.lower()\n    generation_mode = record.generation_mode.lower()\n    if \"fallback\" in source_mode or \"fallback\" in generation_mode:\n        return True\n    if \"free_knowledge\" in source_mode or \"free_knowledge\" in generation_mode:\n        return True\n    return record.grounding_status == \"llm_compensated\"\n\n\n__all__ = [\n    \"ExtractionArtifact\",\n    \"ExtractionNodeRecord\",\n    \"build_driver_extraction_artifact\",\n    \"build_indicator_extraction_artifact\",\n]\n"
}

> DEVELOPER

why do we have __init__.py under fs10. What even is init.py for and is having so many of them a bad pattern?

> AGENT

`__init__.py` is the file that tells Python "this directory is a package you can import from." Without it (or with the right setup for "namespace packages"), `from fs10_validation.components import EdgeWeightArtifact` wouldn't work.

**What it does:**
1. Marks the directory as a Python package
2. Runs once when the package is first imported
3. Can re-export symbols from submodules so users can write `from fs10_validation.components import X` instead of `from fs10_validation.components.fs5_edge_weights import X`

**Having a lot of them is not a bad pattern** — it's the normal Python convention. Every package directory needs one. The components dir, the fs10_validation dir, the packages dir, etc. — each needs its own. That's just how Python organizes namespaces.

**What IS bad:**

1. **Heavy code in `__init__.py`** — anything you put there runs every time someone imports the package. So `import fs10_validation` would run all the work in the file. Side effects, expensive computation, or big chains of imports slow down startup and surprise people.

2. **Lazy `__getattr__` shenanigans** — like the pattern in `packages/domain/qc/__init__.py` where attributes are loaded on demand. Useful when you have circular import issues, but it hides dependencies and confuses tooling.

3. **Re-exporting everything from everywhere** — making `__init__.py` a giant re-export of every symbol from every submodule. That creates a tangled web where touching one file can break unrelated tests because of import chains.

In this codebase the `__init__.py` files are mostly just clean re-exports (`from .fs5_edge_weights import X` + `__all__ = [...]`), which is fine. The only one that's doing something clever is `packages/domain/qc/__init__.py` with its lazy loader, and that's there to dodge a real circular-import problem.

So: not a bad pattern, just the cost of doing business with Python packages.

> DEVELOPER

but for example thre are 2 init.py in the fs10 folder right, should there be 2>

> AGENT

Yes, two is correct here. The rule is **one `__init__.py` per directory that is itself a package.**

The layout is:

```
fs10_validation/
├── __init__.py              ← marks fs10_validation as a package
├── splits.py
├── track_records.py
├── ...other modules...
└── components/
    ├── __init__.py          ← marks components as a sub-package
    ├── fs3_extraction.py
    ├── fs5_edge_weights.py
    ├── fs6_inference.py
    └── fs7_summary.py
```

`fs10_validation` is a package. `fs10_validation.components` is a *sub-package* — a package nested inside another package. Each one needs its own `__init__.py`. Without the inner one, you couldn't write `from fs10_validation.components import EdgeWeightArtifact`.

If you had three levels — say `fs10_validation/components/helpers/` — you'd need three `__init__.py` files. One per directory in the chain.

So: not redundant, just one per layer. Same as how a folder structure has one folder per level — the `__init__.py` is just the marker that says "this folder is also a Python namespace."

> DEVELOPER

is this the correct structure tho?

> AGENT

Yes, the structure is sensible. Here's the reasoning:

`fs10_validation/` is a big package — it has 10+ top-level modules doing different things: storage (`run_store`, `component_store`), data lifecycle (`validation_data_store`, `splits`, `leakage`), track records, scoring, etc.

The `components/` sub-package groups files that all do the **same kind of thing**: each file is "the artifact builder for one feature set" (FS1, FS3, FS5, FS6, FS7, FS4 baselines). They're conceptually a set — 6 modules in the same pattern, consumed by the same caller (gate_runner).

That's exactly when a sub-package is the right call:
- **Group sub-package**: many files of the same shape/purpose that belong together → makes the relationship explicit
- **Flat package**: a mixed bag of related but differently-shaped modules → flat is fine

If you put `fs5_edge_weights.py` directly in `fs10_validation/`, it would sit next to unrelated things like `splits.py` and `track_records.py` and the "these are all per-FS artifact builders" pattern would be invisible. Inside `components/` it's obvious.

The only time I'd push back on a sub-package is if there were just 1-2 files in it — that's overkill. Six files of the same shape clears the bar.

> AGENT

`__all__` is a Python convention that declares "these are the public names in this module."

**What it actually does:**

It controls `from fs10_validation.components import *` — only names in `__all__` get pulled in. Without `__all__`, that wildcard import grabs every non-underscore name, including things like `dataclass` and `Any` that you imported from elsewhere.

**What it also does (the bigger reason):**

It documents the module's public API. When someone reads the file, the `__all__` list at the bottom says "these are the symbols I intend you to use; everything else is internal." Tools — type checkers, IDEs, ruff, sphinx — use it the same way. If you remove a symbol from `__all__`, ruff will flag any external code still importing it.

**Is it required?**

No. Python works fine without it. You can still write `from fs10_validation.components import EdgeWeightArtifact` whether or not it's in `__all__` — `__all__` only affects wildcard imports and tooling.

**Is it worth the noise?**

For internal modules nobody outside the package imports from, arguably no — it's just maintenance overhead duplicating what the imports already say. For module boundaries — package `__init__.py` files especially — it's genuinely useful as a contract.

This codebase uses it everywhere as a convention. That's a choice — explicit and consistent, at the cost of writing the symbol names twice. Personally I'd skip it on leaf modules and keep it on `__init__.py` files where it actually communicates a public surface. But that's a style call, not a correctness one.

Could add it to the module-organisation investigation ticket if you want to revisit conventions there.

"""
FS1 target-set integrity gate.

The gate is intentionally structural. FS11 can challenge softer quality issues,
but FS1 owns this first-pass verdict before graph persistence.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Sequence
from typing import Any


def _clean_options(options: Sequence[Any] | None) -> list[str]:
    return [str(option or "").strip() for option in options or [] if str(option or "").strip()]


def _issue(code: str, message: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    return {"code": code, "message": message}


def _bucket_pair(bucket: Any) -> tuple[float | None, float | None] | None:
    if not isinstance(bucket, (list, tuple)) or len(bucket) != 2:
        return None
    lower_raw, upper_raw = bucket
    try:
        lower = None if lower_raw is None else float(lower_raw)
        upper = None if upper_raw is None else float(upper_raw)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None
    return lower, upper


def evaluate_target_set_integrity(
    *,
    question_type: str,
    options: Sequence[Any] | None,
    buckets: Sequence[Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Return the canonical FS1 target_set_integrity_gate payload."""

    normalized_type = str(question_type or "").strip().lower()
    clean_options = _clean_options(options)
    blocking_issues: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    warning_issues: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    mutually_exclusive = True
    overlap_detected = False
    downstream_compatible = True
    collective_adequacy = "pass"

    if len(clean_options) < 2:
        blocking_issues.append(_issue("too_few_targets", "A forecast question needs at least two target outcomes."))
        collective_adequacy = "fail"
        downstream_compatible = False

    casefolded = [option.casefold() for option in clean_options]
    if len(set(casefolded)) != len(casefolded):
        blocking_issues.append(_issue("duplicate_target_label", "Target labels must be unique after normalization."))
        mutually_exclusive = False
        overlap_detected = True
        downstream_compatible = False

    if normalized_type == "binary" and set(casefolded) != {"yes", "no"}:
        warning_issues.append(_issue("nonstandard_binary_labels", "Binary targets should normalize to Yes and No."))
        collective_adequacy = "warning" if collective_adequacy == "pass" else collective_adequacy

    if normalized_type in {"numeric_ordinal", "time_ordinal", "numeric_bracket"}:
        if not buckets:
            blocking_issues.append(_issue("missing_buckets", "Ordinal questions require bucket boundaries."))
            collective_adequacy = "fail"
            downstream_compatible = False
        elif len(buckets) != len(clean_options):
            blocking_issues.append(_issue("bucket_option_mismatch", "Bucket count must match target option count."))
            collective_adequacy = "fail"
            downstream_compatible = False
        else:
            previous_upper: float | None = None
            for index, bucket in enumerate(buckets):
                pair = _bucket_pair(bucket)
                if pair is None:
                    blocking_issues.append(_issue("invalid_bucket", f"Bucket {index} must be [lower, upper]."))
                    downstream_compatible = False
                    continue
                lower, upper = pair
                if lower is not None and upper is not None and lower >= upper:
                    blocking_issues.append(_issue("invalid_bucket_order", f"Bucket {index} lower bound must be below upper bound."))
                    mutually_exclusive = False
                    overlap_detected = True
                    downstream_compatible = False
                if previous_upper is not None and lower is not None:
                    if lower < previous_upper:
                        blocking_issues.append(_issue("overlapping_bucket", f"Bucket {index} overlaps the previous bucket."))
                        mutually_exclusive = False
                        overlap_detected = True
                        downstream_compatible = False
                    elif lower > previous_upper:
                        warning_issues.append(_issue("bucket_gap", f"Bucket {index} leaves a gap after the previous bucket."))
                        collective_adequacy = "warning" if collective_adequacy == "pass" else collective_adequacy
                previous_upper = upper

    for option in clean_options:
        lowered = option.casefold()
        if lowered in {"other", "unknown", "none of the above"}:
            warning_issues.append(_issue("catch_all_target", f"Target '{option}' may need analyst review for adequacy."))
            collective_adequacy = "warning" if collective_adequacy == "pass" else collective_adequacy

    if blocking_issues:
        collective_adequacy = "fail"
        verdict = "block"
    elif warning_issues:
        verdict = "warn"
    else:
        verdict = "pass"

    return {
        "mutually_exclusive": mutually_exclusive,
        "overlap_detected": overlap_detected,
        "collective_adequacy": collective_adequacy,
        "downstream_compatible": downstream_compatible,
        "blocking_issues": blocking_issues,
        "warning_issues": warning_issues,
        "verdict": verdict,
    }


def assert_target_set_integrity_passes(
    *,
    question_type: str,
    options: Sequence[Any] | None,
    buckets: Sequence[Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Evaluate the gate and raise when FS1 must block graph persistence."""

    verdict = evaluate_target_set_integrity(question_type=question_type, options=options, buckets=buckets)
    if verdict["verdict"] == "block":
        issues = verdict.get("blocking_issues") or []
        message = "; ".join(str(issue.get("message") or issue.get("code") or "target-set integrity failure") for issue in issues)
        raise ValueError(f"target_set_integrity_gate blocked question: {message}")
    return verdict


__all__ = ["assert_target_set_integrity_passes", "evaluate_target_set_integrity"]
```

"""FS10-H1 replay builder for FS1 question-definition artifacts."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import select

from core.fs1_target_set_integrity import evaluate_target_set_integrity
from fs10_validation.component_store import StoredComponentArtifact, persist_component_artifact
from packages.storage.database import (
    FS10ValidationRunRow,
    NodeRow,
    NodeType,
    QuestionRow,
    TargetRow,
    resolve_storage_database,
    utc_now,
)
from packages.storage.runtime_config import StorageRuntimeConfig


def _enum_value(value: Any) -> str:
    return str(value.value if hasattr(value, "value") else value or "").strip()


def _target_sort_key(row: NodeRow, detail: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[int, str]:
    option_index = (detail.get("detail") or {}).get("option_index") if isinstance(detail.get("detail"), dict) else None
    if isinstance(option_index, int):
        return option_index, str(row.node_id)
    return 9999, str(row.node_id)


def _ensure_validation_run(*, session: Any, run_id: str, question_id: str) -> None:
    if session.get(FS10ValidationRunRow, run_id) is not None:
        return
    session.add(
        FS10ValidationRunRow(
            run_id=run_id,
            set_name="fs1_h1_component_replay",
            question_count=1,
            built_count=1,
            resolved_count=0,
            scored_count=0,
            failed_count=0,
            mean_brier=0.0,
            median_brier=0.0,
            total_seconds=0.0,
            failed_ids_json=[],
            by_type_json={},
            by_bucket_json={},
            stage_b_json={"component": "FS1", "question_id": question_id},
            report_json={"component": "FS1", "artifact_kind": "question_definition"},
            created_at=utc_now(),
            updated_at=utc_now(),
        )
    )


def build_fs1_question_definition_artifact(
    *,
    question: QuestionRow,
    target_nodes: list[NodeRow],
    target_details: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Build the replayable FS1 question_definition artifact from DB rows."""

    targets = dict(question.targets or {})
    metadata = dict(question.metadata_ or {})
    options = [str(option) for option in list(targets.get("options") or [])]
    buckets = list(targets.get("buckets") or []) if targets.get("buckets") is not None else None
    question_type = _enum_value(question.type)
    integrity = metadata.get("target_set_integrity")
    if not isinstance(integrity, dict):
        integrity = evaluate_target_set_integrity(question_type=question_type, options=options, buckets=buckets)

    ordered_targets = sorted(
        target_nodes,
        key=lambda row: _target_sort_key(row, target_details.get(str(row.node_id), {})),
    )
    return {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "source_authority": "db",
        "upstream_fs": "FS1",
        "artifact_kind": "question_definition",
        "question_id": str(question.question_id),
        "request_profile": str(metadata.get("request_profile") or "create_question"),
        "question_text": str(question.title),
        "canonical_question_type": question_type,
        "normalized_options": options,
        "numeric_or_time_bounds": {
            "unit": targets.get("unit"),
            "buckets": buckets,
        },
        "close_date_or_horizon": str(metadata.get("closing_date_text") or metadata.get("target_date_text") or ""),
        "decomposition": {
            "parent_question_id": str(question.parent_question_id or ""),
            "sub_question_ids": list(metadata.get("sub_question_ids") or []) if isinstance(metadata.get("sub_question_ids"), list) else [],
        },
        "target_set_integrity": integrity,
        "target_node_ids": [str(row.node_id) for row in ordered_targets],
        "analyst_overrides": list(metadata.get("analyst_overrides") or []) if isinstance(metadata.get("analyst_overrides"), list) else [],
        "fs11_concerns_known_at_write_time": list(metadata.get("fs11_concerns_known_at_write_time") or [])
        if isinstance(metadata.get("fs11_concerns_known_at_write_time"), list)
        else [],
    }


def persist_fs1_question_definition_artifact(
    *,
    run_id: str,
    question_id: str,
    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig | None = None,
) -> StoredComponentArtifact:
    """Persist the FS10-H1 FS1 replay artifact from DB-backed question state."""

    normalized_run_id = str(run_id or "").strip()
    normalized_question_id = str(question_id or "").strip()
    if not normalized_run_id:
        raise ValueError("run_id is required")
    if not normalized_question_id:
        raise ValueError("question_id is required")

    database = resolve_storage_database(storage_config)
    database.create_all()
    with database.session_scope() as session:
        question = session.get(QuestionRow, normalized_question_id)
        if question is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown question: {normalized_question_id}")
        _ensure_validation_run(session=session, run_id=normalized_run_id, question_id=normalized_question_id)
        target_nodes = list(
            session.scalars(
                select(NodeRow)
                .where(NodeRow.question_id == normalized_question_id)
                .where(NodeRow.type == NodeType.TARGET)
                .order_by(NodeRow.node_id)
            ).all()
        )
        target_details = {
            str(row.node_id): dict((session.get(TargetRow, row.node_id).detail or {}) if session.get(TargetRow, row.node_id) else {})
            for row in target_nodes
        }
        payload = build_fs1_question_definition_artifact(
            question=question,
            target_nodes=target_nodes,
            target_details=target_details,
        )

    status = "warning" if payload["target_set_integrity"].get("verdict") == "warn" else "ok"
    return persist_component_artifact(
        run_id=normalized_run_id,
        question_id=normalized_question_id,
        upstream_fs="FS1",
        artifact_kind="question_definition",
        payload=payload,
        status=status,
        storage_config=storage_config,
    )


__all__ = [
    "build_fs1_question_definition_artifact",
    "persist_fs1_question_definition_artifact",
]

ValueError(f\"Unknown question: {normalized_question_id}\")\n        _ensure_validation_run(session=session, run_id=normalized_run_id, question_id=normalized_question_id)\n        target_nodes = list(\n            session.scalars(\n                select(NodeRow)\n                .where(NodeRow.question_id == normalized_question_id)\n                .where(NodeRow.type == NodeType.TARGET)\n                .order_by(NodeRow.node_id)\n            ).all()\n        )\n        target_details = {\n            str(row.node_id): dict((session.get(TargetRow, row.node_id).detail or {}) if session.get(TargetRow, row.node_id) else {})\n            for row in target_nodes\n        }\n        payload = build_fs1_question_definition_artifact(\n            question=question,\n            target_nodes=target_nodes,\n            target_details=target_details,\n        )\n\n    status = \"warning\" if payload[\"target_set_integrity\"].get(\"verdict\") == \"warn\" else \"ok\"\n    return persist_component_artifact(\n        run_id=normalized_run_id,\n        question_id=normalized_question_id,\n        upstream_fs=\"FS1\",\n        artifact_kind=\"question_definition\",\n        payload=payload,\n        status=status,\n        storage_config=storage_config,\n    )\n\n\n__all__ = [\n    \"build_fs1_question_definition_artifact\",\n    \"persist_fs1_question_definition_artifact\",\n]\n"

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import func, select

from core.fs1_target_set_integrity import evaluate_target_set_integrity
from packages.storage import build_database_worker_storage_adapters
from packages.storage.database import LLMPromptTraceRow, NodeRow, NodeType, QuestionRow, TargetRow
from services.api import create_app
from tests.support.api_runtime import TEST_API_KEY, import_seed_json_into_database, seed_repo_state


def _build_client(tmp_path: Path) -> tuple[TestClient, Any]:
    config = seed_repo_state(tmp_path)
    import_seed_json_into_database(config)
    client = TestClient(create_app(config=config), headers={"X-API-Key": TEST_API_KEY})
    return client, config


def test_target_set_integrity_gate_pass_warn_and_block_payloads() -> None:
    passed = evaluate_target_set_integrity(question_type="binary", options=["Yes", "No"])
    warned = evaluate_target_set_integrity(question_type="categorical", options=["Labour", "Conservative", "Other"])
    blocked = evaluate_target_set_integrity(question_type="categorical", options=["Yes", "yes"])

    assert passed["verdict"] == "pass"
    assert warned["verdict"] == "warn"
    assert warned["warning_issues"][0]["code"] == "catch_all_target"
    assert blocked["verdict"] == "block"
    assert blocked["overlap_detected"] is True
    assert blocked["blocking_issues"][0]["code"] == "duplicate_target_label"


def test_question_create_persists_integrity_verdict_and_target_class_tables(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    client, config = _build_client(tmp_path)

    response = client.post(
        "/api/questions",
        json={
            "id": "fs1_integrity_warn_q",
            "label": "Who will win the next election?",
            "question_type": "categorical",
            "closing_date": "2027-12-31",
            "question_set_id": "local_set",
            "question_set_label": "Local Set",
            "options": ["Labour", "Conservative", "Other"],
        },
    )

    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text

    adapters = build_database_worker_storage_adapters(config.storage_runtime)
    database = adapters.graph_store_repository._database  # noqa: SLF001
    with database.session_scope() as session:
        question = session.get(QuestionRow, "fs1_integrity_warn_q")
        assert question is not None
        assert question.targets["options"] == ["Labour", "Conservative", "Other"]
        assert question.metadata_["target_set_integrity"]["verdict"] == "warn"

        target_nodes = list(
            session.scalars(
                select(NodeRow)
                .where(NodeRow.question_id == "fs1_integrity_warn_q")
                .where(NodeRow.type == NodeType.TARGET)
                .order_by(NodeRow.label)
            ).all()
        )
        assert [node.label for node in target_nodes] == ["Conservative", "Labour", "Other"]
        assert all(session.get(TargetRow, node.node_id) is not None for node in target_nodes)


def test_question_create_blocks_duplicate_targets_before_graph_persistence(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    client, config = _build_client(tmp_path)

    response = client.post(
        "/api/questions",
        json={
            "id": "fs1_integrity_block_q",
            "label": "Which duplicate target wins?",
            "question_type": "categorical",
            "closing_date": "2027-12-31",
            "question_set_id": "local_set",
            "question_set_label": "Local Set",
            "options": ["Yes", "yes"],
        },
    )

    assert response.status_code == 422, response.text
    assert "target_set_integrity_gate blocked" in response.text

    adapters = build_database_worker_storage_adapters(config.storage_runtime)
    database = adapters.graph_store_repository._database  # noqa: SLF001
    with database.session_scope() as session:
        assert session.get(QuestionRow, "fs1_integrity_block_q") is None
        target_count = session.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(NodeRow).where(NodeRow.question_id == "fs1_integrity_block_q"))
        assert target_count == 0


def test_question_draft_records_fs1_prompt_trace_metadata(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch) -> None:
    from services.worker.agents.QuestionDefAgent import question_drafter as qd

    class _StubTool:
        @property
        def model(self) -> str:
            return "small-test-model"

        def _build_full_message_list(self, **kwargs: Any) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
            return [
                {"role": "system", "content": "Draft a question."},
                {"role": "user", "content": str(kwargs.get("draft_text") or "")},
            ]

        def run(self, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
            del kwargs
            return {
                "refined_label": "Will the FS1 prompt trace persist?",
                "target_type": "binary",
                "options": ["Yes", "No"],
                "suggested_close_date": "2027-12-31",
                "reasoning": "Binary trace test.",
            }

    monkeypatch.setattr(qd, "QuestionDrafterTool", _StubTool)
    client, config = _build_client(tmp_path)

    response = client.post("/api/questions/draft", json={"draft_text": "Will the FS1 prompt trace persist?"})

    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text

    adapters = build_database_worker_storage_adapters(config.storage_runtime)
    database = adapters.graph_store_repository._database  # noqa: SLF001
    with database.session_scope() as session:
        rows = list(session.scalars(select(LLMPromptTraceRow).where(LLMPromptTraceRow.fs_id == "FS1")).all())
        assert len(rows) == 1
        assert rows[0].task_id == "FS1.question_drafter"
        assert rows[0].prompt_builder_id == "question_drafter"
        assert rows[0].rendered_prompt_ref.startswith("sha256:")

    )
    title: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=False)

    type: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        _pg_enum(QuestionType, name="question_type"),
        nullable=False,

    keywords: Mapped[list[Any] | None] = mapped_column(JSON, nullable=True)
    metadata_: Mapped[dict[str, Any] | None] = mapped_column("metadata", JSON, nullable=True)
