{
  "command": "gh pr create --draft --base dev --title \"SPI-230 PR2b: Port FS1 target-set integrity gate and component\" --body \"$(cat <<'EOF'\n## What this is\n\nThis PR ports the FS1 target-set integrity gate plus the FS10-H1 replay component that uses it. The gate is the structural first-pass verdict on whether a forecast question's target set is well-formed — distinct labels, enough options, valid bucket boundaries for ordinal questions, and so on. FS1 owns this decision before a question's graph is persisted; FS11 challenges softer quality issues later.\n\nThe replay component reconstructs the FS1 artifact from DB-backed question state, runs the integrity gate when needed, and persists the artifact via the `component_store` interface ported in PR1. This unblocks downstream PR2 work on the FS10 gate runner, which consumes these per-component artifacts.\n\n## Technical detail\n\nTagging @kungfusaini\n\n### Summary\n\n- Adds `core/fs1_target_set_integrity.py` (139 lines) — `evaluate_target_set_integrity()` returning a pass/warn/block verdict, plus `assert_target_set_integrity_passes()` for callers that want to raise on block.\n- Adds `fs10_validation/components/fs1_question_definition.py` (151 lines) — builds the FS10-H1 replay artifact and persists it via `persist_component_artifact()`.\n- Updates `fs10_validation/components/__init__.py` to export the new symbols.\n- Adds 26 unit tests across two files covering pass / warn / block paths, edge cases, and the builder.\n\n### Approach\n\nFollowed the same pattern as the FS3/FS5/FS6/FS7 components already on dev: pure builder function consuming pre-fetched DB rows, plus a thin persist function that does the DB IO. The persist function delegates to `persist_component_artifact()` (from PR1) so the FS1 component doesn't take a direct dependency on storage table internals.\n\nOne small departure from `dev_sprint` source: removed the no-op `str(question_type or \"\").strip().lower()` defensive wrapping in the integrity evaluator since `question_type` is typed `str`. Matches the lookout.md anti-pattern guidance.\n\n### Tests\n\n- `TestEvaluatePassVerdict` — binary Yes/No and distinct categorical options\n- `TestEvaluateWarnVerdict` — catch-all targets, nonstandard binary labels, bucket gaps\n- `TestEvaluateBlockVerdict` — duplicate labels, too few targets, missing buckets, bucket/option mismatch, invalid bucket order, overlapping buckets\n- `TestAssertHelper` — pass/warn returns verdict; block raises ValueError\n- `TestEdgeCases` — None options, whitespace-only options, invalid bucket shapes\n- `TestFS1ComponentBuilder` — pass verdict on clean binary, target sort order by option_index, fallback sort for missing index, cached integrity from metadata, on-the-fly integrity computation, metadata passthroughs, ordinal bucket/unit passthrough, enum type handling, non-list sub_question_ids handling\n\n### Verification\n\n- [x] `uv run ruff check .`\n- [x] `uv run ruff format --check .`\n- [x] `uv run python -m pytest --ignore=tests/frontend -x -q` (1418 passed, 10 skipped, 1 deselected — the deselected one is the known-flaky `test_parallel_questions_faster_than_sequential` timing test)\n\n### Risks\n\nLow. New code paths only activated by the FS10 gate runner (not on dev yet). The integrity evaluator is a pure function with no side effects; the persist function uses the same `persist_component_artifact()` interface already exercised by other components on dev.\n\n### Branch-merge\n\nBranch: `port/spi-230-pr2b-fs1-component`\nBase: `dev`\n\n### Out of scope (deliberately)\n\n- Integration test for `persist_fs1_question_definition_artifact()` — requires substantial DB setup (Graph, Run, Node, Target rows) and is exercised end-to-end once the gate runner ports. The pure `build_fs1_question_definition_artifact()` is unit-tested directly.\n- `fs10_validation/components/baseline_estimation.py` — depends on `packages/domain/baselines/dispatch.py` from SPI-233.\n- `fs10_validation/gate_runner.py` — ships in PR2c with its `real_packages.py` / `sample_data.py` dependencies.\n- `fs10_validation/graph_construction.py` — ships in PR2d with its `real_tune_evaluator.py` dependency.\n\n🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)\nEOF\n)\"",

}

{
  "team": "Spire_Elijah",
  "title": "Investigate overall codebase structure and package boundaries",
  "state": "Backlog",
  "assignee": "sumeet@sumeetsaini.com",
  "description": "## Context\n\nSPI-255 covers module organisation within `fs10_validation/` and `packages/`. This is the broader, repo-wide version of that question.\n\nThe codebase has grown across many feature sets (FS1–FS12), shared `packages/`, a `core/` layer, a `services/` layer, and a flat `fs10_validation/` package that sits at the top level. Boundaries between these have evolved organically and are no longer obvious from the directory layout.\n\nBefore the porting epic finishes and more code lands, it's worth a pass on whether the top-level shape is right.\n\n## Things to look at\n\n- **Top-level directories** — what's the intended purpose of each of `core/`, `packages/`, `fs10_validation/`, `services/`, `tests/`, `docs/`? Are there clear rules for what goes where, or has it become ad-hoc?\n- **`core/` vs `packages/`** — what's the difference? When porting, deciding which one a new file belongs in is currently a judgement call.\n- **Feature-set code placement** — FS1–FS12 logic is spread across `core/`, `packages/domain/`, `fs10_validation/components/`, and elsewhere. Is there one canonical place per feature set, or is the spread justified by separation of concerns?\n- **Top-level `fs10_validation/`** — why is FS10 the only feature set with its own top-level package? Should it move under `packages/domain/fs10/` to match the others, or is the top-level placement intentional (e.g. because it's a CLI surface)?\n- **`packages/storage/database.py`** — single ~2,600-line file holding every ORM table. Should it be split per feature-set?\n- **Import direction rules** — which packages are allowed to import from which? Are there implicit layering rules (e.g. `core/` can't import from `services/`) that should be made explicit?\n- **Test discoverability** — `tests/` is flat. With ~150+ test files, are naming conventions enough or should the directory mirror the source layout?\n- **`docs/` and `runtime/`** — what lives there, are they referenced by code, do they belong in-repo?\n\n## Deliverable\n\nA one-page writeup with:\n\n1. Current state — what the top-level shape is and what the implicit rules appear to be.\n2. Observed inconsistencies — concrete examples where the placement of a file feels arbitrary.\n3. Options — keep-as-is, light cleanup (renames + doc), or restructure (move files).\n4. Recommendation — pick one option with the cost-benefit reasoning.\n5. Migration cost estimate — if a restructure is recommended, how many files would move, how disruptive to in-flight work (porting epic, parallel PRs).\n\nNo code changes in this ticket. Any restructure would be a follow-up ticket scoped from the writeup.\n\n## Out of scope\n\n- Module organisation within `fs10_validation/` and `packages/` — covered by SPI-255.\n- Branch / PR conventions, ticket naming — already documented in CLAUDE.md.\n- Python style conventions (`__all__`, type hints, etc.) — also under SPI-255.\n\n## Related\n\n- SPI-255: Investigate module organisation across fs10_validation and packages/",
  "priority": 4,
  "relatedTo": [
    "SPI-255"
  ]
}
```

"""Deterministic FS10 sample-package builders for gate-run smoke evidence."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

from fs10_validation.validation_data_store import (
    StoredValidationPackage,
    add_package_item,
    attach_package_authority,
    create_validation_package,
    freeze_validation_package,
    load_validation_package,
    record_adjudicated_label,
    record_exclusion_policy,
    record_freeze_approval,
    record_label_batch,
    record_leakage_review,
    record_rubric_version,
    record_split_metadata,
    record_threshold_policy,
    upsert_adapter_version,
    upsert_candidate_item,
    upsert_validation_source,
)
from packages.storage.runtime_config import StorageRuntimeConfig

VD_FS2_BASELINE_DATA = "VD-FS2-BASELINE-DATA"
VD_FS2_GLOBAL_IMPACT = "VD-FS2-GLOBAL-IMPACT"
VD_QUESTION_NORMALIZATION = "VD-QUESTION-NORMALIZATION"
VD_EVIDENCE_QUALITY = "VD-EVIDENCE-QUALITY"
VD_BASELINE_AND_PRIORS = "VD-BASELINE-AND-PRIORS"
VD_GRAPH_CONSTRUCTION = "VD-GRAPH-CONSTRUCTION"
VD_EDGE_CALIBRATION = "VD-EDGE-CALIBRATION"
VD_RESOLVED_FORECAST_REPLAY = "VD-RESOLVED-FORECAST-REPLAY"
MAX_SAMPLE_ITEMS = 20
MAX_SAMPLE_BATCH_SIZE = 5

SAMPLE_PACKAGE_IDS = {
    VD_FS2_BASELINE_DATA: "vd_fs2_baseline_data_sample_v1",
    VD_FS2_GLOBAL_IMPACT: "vd_fs2_global_impact_sample_v1",
}
CANONICAL_SAMPLE_PACKAGE_IDS = {
    VD_QUESTION_NORMALIZATION: "vd_question_normalization_sample_v1",
    VD_EVIDENCE_QUALITY: "vd_evidence_quality_sample_v1",
    VD_BASELINE_AND_PRIORS: "vd_baseline_and_priors_sample_v1",
    VD_GRAPH_CONSTRUCTION: "vd_graph_construction_sample_v1",
    VD_EDGE_CALIBRATION: "vd_edge_calibration_sample_v1",
    VD_RESOLVED_FORECAST_REPLAY: "vd_resolved_forecast_replay_sample_v1",
}
ALL_SAMPLE_PACKAGE_IDS = {**SAMPLE_PACKAGE_IDS, **CANONICAL_SAMPLE_PACKAGE_IDS}
SAMPLE_GATE_COVERAGE = {
    VD_FS2_BASELINE_DATA: ["P-FS2-01", "A-FS2-01", "P-FS4-01", "A-FS4-01"],
    VD_FS2_GLOBAL_IMPACT: ["A-FS2-01", "A-E2E-01"],
}
CANONICAL_SAMPLE_GATE_COVERAGE = {
    VD_QUESTION_NORMALIZATION: ["P-FS1-01", "A-FS1-01"],
    VD_EVIDENCE_QUALITY: ["P-FS2-01", "A-FS2-01"],
    VD_BASELINE_AND_PRIORS: ["P-FS2-01", "A-FS2-01", "P-FS4-01", "A-FS4-01"],
    VD_GRAPH_CONSTRUCTION: ["P-FS3-01", "A-FS3-01"],
    VD_EDGE_CALIBRATION: ["A-FS5-01"],
    VD_RESOLVED_FORECAST_REPLAY: ["A-FS2-01", "A-FS3-01", "P-FS4-01", "A-FS4-01", "A-E2E-01"],
}
ALL_SAMPLE_GATE_COVERAGE = {**SAMPLE_GATE_COVERAGE, **CANONICAL_SAMPLE_GATE_COVERAGE}


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SamplePackageBuildResult:
    dataset_family: str
    package: StoredValidationPackage
    item_count: int
    batch_size: int
    batches_written: int
    validated_gate_ids: list[str]


def _chunks(items: list[dict[str, Any]], batch_size: int) -> list[list[dict[str, Any]]]:
    return [items[index : index + batch_size] for index in range(0, len(items), batch_size)]


def _family_slug(dataset_family: str) -> str:
    return dataset_family.lower().replace("-", "_")


def _validate_family(dataset_family: str) -> str:
    normalized = str(dataset_family or "").strip().upper()
    if normalized not in ALL_SAMPLE_PACKAGE_IDS:
        known = ", ".join(sorted(ALL_SAMPLE_PACKAGE_IDS))
        raise ValueError(f"unknown FS10 sample dataset family {dataset_family!r}; expected one of {known}")
    return normalized


def _sample_rows(dataset_family: str, count: int) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for index in range(1, count + 1):
        if dataset_family == VD_FS2_BASELINE_DATA:
            domain = ["energy", "macro", "food-security", "supply-chain"][index % 4]
            title = f"Baseline data sample {index:02d}: {domain} indicator resolves by 2027"
            payload = {
                "dataset_family": dataset_family,
                "sample_index": index,
                "domain": domain,
                "question_type": "binary",
                "resolved_outcome": bool(index % 2),
                "baseline_requirements": {
                    "historic_series": True,
                    "current_resolution_record": True,
                    "source_regeneration_ref": f"db://fs10/samples/{dataset_family}/{index:02d}",
                },
            }
        elif dataset_family == VD_FS2_GLOBAL_IMPACT:
            domain = ["geopolitics", "climate", "public-health", "technology"][index % 4]
            title = f"Global impact sample {index:02d}: {domain} event shifts forecast"
            payload = {
                "dataset_family": dataset_family,
                "sample_index": index,
                "domain": domain,
                "question_type": "binary",
                "resolved_outcome": bool((index + 1) % 2),
                "global_impact_requirements": {
                    "impact_axis": ["severity", "scope", "persistence"][index % 3],
                    "research_defensibility_fixture": True,
                    "source_regeneration_ref": f"db://fs10/samples/{dataset_family}/{index:02d}",
                },
            }
        else:
            title, payload = _canonical_sample_payload(dataset_family=dataset_family, index=index)
        rows.append(
            {
                "external_id": f"{dataset_family}:{index:02d}",
                "question_id": f"{_family_slug(dataset_family)}_q{index:02d}",
                "title": title,
                "payload": payload,
            }
        )
    return rows


def _canonical_sample_payload(*, dataset_family: str, index: int) -> tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    domain = ["geopolitics", "climate", "public-health", "technology"][index % 4]
    source_ref = f"db://fs10/samples/{dataset_family}/{index:02d}"
    base = {
        "dataset_family": dataset_family,
        "validation_package_archetype": dataset_family,
        "sample_only": True,
        "production_acceptance": False,
        "sample_index": index,
        "domain": domain,
        "question_type": "binary",
        "source_regeneration_ref": source_ref,
    }
    if dataset_family == VD_QUESTION_NORMALIZATION:
        question_types = ["binary", "categorical", "numeric_ordinal", "time_ordinal"]
        question_type = question_types[index % len(question_types)]
        return (
            f"Question normalization sample {index:02d}: {question_type} target parsing",
            {
                **base,
                "question_type": question_type,
                "normalization_labels": {
                    "type_label": question_type,
                    "target_label": "sample_target",
                    "temporal_label": "2027-12-31",
                    "malformed_target": False,
                },
            },
        )
    if dataset_family == VD_EVIDENCE_QUALITY:
        return (
            f"Evidence quality sample {index:02d}: {domain} retrieval packet",
            {
                **base,
                "research_defensibility": {
                    "axes": {
                        "Direct relevance": 2,
                        "Mechanism relevance": 2,
                        "Source quality": 2,
                        "Recency": 2,
                    },
                    "axis_to_surface_bindings": [
                        "target_specific_api_query_optimizer_user",
                        "research_gap_reroute_user",
                    ],
                    "retrieval_relevance_label": "relevant",
                },
            },
        )
    if dataset_family == VD_BASELINE_AND_PRIORS:
        return (
            f"Baseline and priors sample {index:02d}: {domain} estimator support",
            {
                **base,
                "baseline_requirements": {
                    "source_derived_required_for_brier": True,
                    "sample_omits_production_brier_truth": True,
                    "baseline_data_adequacy": "fixture_sufficient",
                    "fs4_prompt_lanes": [
                        "fermi_reference_class",
                        "fermi_decomposition",
                        "fermi_range_estimation",
                        "fermi_independence_check",
                        "fermi_prompt_bundle",
                    ],
                },
            },
        )
    if dataset_family == VD_GRAPH_CONSTRUCTION:
        return (
            f"Graph construction sample {index:02d}: {domain} document-pack extraction",
            {
                **base,
                "document_pack": {
                    "documents": [
                        {
                            "document_id": f"doc_{index:02d}_a",
                            "text": "Known driver text and known indicator text are embedded for extraction review.",
                        }
                    ],
                    "gold_drivers": ["Known driver text"],
                    "gold_indicators": ["Known indicator text"],
                    "graph_admission": "admit",
                },
            },
        )
    if dataset_family == VD_EDGE_CALIBRATION:
        return (
            f"Edge calibration sample {index:02d}: {domain} causal edge review",
            {
                **base,
                "edge_quality": {
                    "source_driver": f"{domain} pressure driver",
                    "target_node": f"{domain} forecast target",
                    "expected_direction": "positive" if index % 2 else "negative",
                    "expected_weight_band": "moderate",
                    "score_family": "Graph",
                    "scorecard_mode": "FS5 edge-quality",
                    "axes": ["Causal coherence", "Edge-weight validity", "Factorisation correctness"],
                    "fs5_prompt_lanes": ["FS5.edge_quality_judge", "FS5.fermi_edge_quality"],
                },
            },
        )
    if dataset_family == VD_RESOLVED_FORECAST_REPLAY:
        return (
            f"Resolved replay sample {index:02d}: {domain} replay guardrail shell",
            {
                **base,
                "resolved_replay": {
                    "source_derived_required_for_brier": True,
                    "sample_omits_production_outcome_truth": True,
                    "eligible_for_production_brier": False,
                    "replay_state_ref": f"{source_ref}/replay",
                },
            },
        )
    raise ValueError(f"unknown canonical sample family: {dataset_family!r}")


def build_sample_validation_package(
    *,
    dataset_family: str,
    sample_count: int = 10,
    batch_size: int = MAX_SAMPLE_BATCH_SIZE,
    freeze: bool = True,
    approved_by: str = "fs10_sample_builder",
    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig | None = None,
) -> SamplePackageBuildResult:
    normalized_family = _validate_family(dataset_family)
    normalized_count = int(sample_count)
    normalized_batch_size = int(batch_size)
    if normalized_count <= 0 or normalized_count > MAX_SAMPLE_ITEMS:
        raise ValueError(f"sample_count must be between 1 and {MAX_SAMPLE_ITEMS}; got {normalized_count}")
    if normalized_batch_size <= 0 or normalized_batch_size > MAX_SAMPLE_BATCH_SIZE:
        raise ValueError(f"batch_size must be between 1 and {MAX_SAMPLE_BATCH_SIZE}; got {normalized_batch_size}")

    package_id = ALL_SAMPLE_PACKAGE_IDS[normalized_family]
    existing = load_validation_package(package_id=package_id, storage_config=storage_config)
    if existing is not None and existing.lifecycle_state == "frozen":
        return SamplePackageBuildResult(
            dataset_family=normalized_family,
            package=existing,
            item_count=existing.item_count,
            batch_size=normalized_batch_size,
            batches_written=0,
            validated_gate_ids=list(ALL_SAMPLE_GATE_COVERAGE[normalized_family]),
        )

    source_id = f"{_family_slug(normalized_family)}_sample_source_v1"
    adapter_version_id = f"{_family_slug(normalized_family)}_sample_adapter_v1"
    split_version = f"{_family_slug(normalized_family)}_sample_split_v1"
    rubric_version_id = f"{_family_slug(normalized_family)}_sample_rubric_v1"
    threshold_policy_id = f"{_family_slug(normalized_family)}_sample_threshold_v1"
    gate_ids = list(ALL_SAMPLE_GATE_COVERAGE[normalized_family])

    upsert_validation_source(
        source_id=source_id,
        source_kind="sample_fixture",
        name=f"{normalized_family} sample source",
        source_uri=f"db://fs10/sample-packages/{package_id}",
        regeneration={"db_ref": f"fs10_sample_package:{normalized_family}:v1"},
        metadata={
            "dataset_family": normalized_family,
            "validation_package_archetype": normalized_family,
            "sample_only": True,
        },
        storage_config=storage_config,
    )
    upsert_adapter_version(
        adapter_version_id=adapter_version_id,
        source_id=source_id,
        adapter_name="fs10_sample_package_builder",
        adapter_version="v1",
        code_ref="fs10_validation.sample_data:build_sample_validation_package",
        config={"max_sample_items": MAX_SAMPLE_ITEMS, "max_batch_size": MAX_SAMPLE_BATCH_SIZE},
        storage_config=storage_config,
    )

    rows = _sample_rows(normalized_family, normalized_count)
    batches = _chunks(rows, normalized_batch_size)
    candidate_ids: list[str] = []
    for batch_index, batch in enumerate(batches, start=1):
        for row in batch:
            candidate_id = f"{_family_slug(normalized_family)}_sample_candidate_{row['question_id'][-2:]}"
            upsert_candidate_item(
                candidate_id=candidate_id,
                source_id=source_id,
                adapter_version_id=adapter_version_id,
                external_id=str(row["external_id"]),
                question_id=str(row["question_id"]),
                title=str(row["title"]),
                status="reviewed",
                source_payload=dict(row["payload"]),
                normalized_payload={
                    **dict(row["payload"]),
                    "title": row["title"],
                    "question_id": row["question_id"],
                    "write_batch_index": batch_index,
                    "write_batch_size": len(batch),
                },
                storage_config=storage_config,
            )
            candidate_ids.append(candidate_id)

    package = create_validation_package(
        package_id=package_id,
        fs_id="FS2",
        gate_id=gate_ids[0],
        name=f"{normalized_family} sample validation package",
        metadata={
            "dataset_family": normalized_family,
            "validation_package_archetype": normalized_family,
            "validated_gate_ids": gate_ids,
            "sample_only": True,
            "sample_runnable_only": True,
            "sample_count": normalized_count,
            "batch_size": normalized_batch_size,
            "max_sample_items": MAX_SAMPLE_ITEMS,
            "max_batch_size": MAX_SAMPLE_BATCH_SIZE,
        },
        storage_config=storage_config,
    )

    for index, candidate_id in enumerate(candidate_ids, start=1):
        split_name = "eval" if index % 5 == 0 else "train"
        add_package_item(
            package_id=package.package_id,
            candidate_id=candidate_id,
            item_metadata={"dataset_family": normalized_family, "split": split_name, "sample_index": index},
            storage_config=storage_config,
        )

    record_rubric_version(
        rubric_version_id=rubric_version_id,
        gate_id=",".join(gate_ids),
        rubric_name=f"{normalized_family} sample gate-run rubric",
        version="v1",
        axes={"sample_runnable": {"required": True}, "production_acceptance": {"claimed": False}},
        storage_config=storage_config,
    )
    record_threshold_policy(
        threshold_policy_id=threshold_policy_id,
        gate_id=",".join(gate_ids),
        policy_name=f"{normalized_family} sample runnable policy",
        policy={"status": "sample_runnable", "production_acceptance": False},
        storage_config=storage_config,
    )
    attach_package_authority(
        package_id=package.package_id,
        rubric_version_id=rubric_version_id,
        threshold_policy_id=threshold_policy_id,
        split_version=split_version,
        storage_config=storage_config,
    )
    eval_count = sum(1 for index in range(1, len(candidate_ids) + 1) if index % 5 == 0)
    record_split_metadata(
        package_id=package.package_id,
        split_version=split_version,
        method="deterministic_sample_modulo",
        eval_fraction=eval_count / len(candidate_ids),
        locked=True,
        split_counts={"train": len(candidate_ids) - eval_count, "eval": eval_count},
        storage_config=storage_config,
    )
    label_batch_id = f"{_family_slug(normalized_family)}_sample_label_batch_v1"
    record_label_batch(
        label_batch_id=label_batch_id,
        package_id=package.package_id,
        rubric_version_id=rubric_version_id,
        status="adjudicated",
        labeler="fs10_sample_builder",
        metadata={"batch_size_cap": MAX_SAMPLE_BATCH_SIZE, "sample_only": True},
        storage_config=storage_config,
    )
    for candidate_id in candidate_ids:
        record_adjudicated_label(
            label_id=f"{label_batch_id}_{candidate_id}",
            label_batch_id=label_batch_id,
            candidate_id=candidate_id,
            labels={"sample_runnable": True, "production_acceptance": False},
            adjudicated_by="fs10_sample_builder",
            status="approved",
            storage_config=storage_config,
        )
    record_leakage_review(
        review_id=f"{_family_slug(normalized_family)}_sample_leakage_review_v1",
        package_id=package.package_id,
        split_version=split_version,
        status="pass",
        findings={"sample_only": True, "leakage_review": "deterministic fixture partitions only"},
        reviewed_by="fs10_sample_builder",
        storage_config=storage_config,
    )
    record_exclusion_policy(
        exclusion_policy_id=f"{_family_slug(normalized_family)}_sample_exclusion_policy_v1",
        package_id=package.package_id,
        status="active",
        policy={"exclude_unresolved": True, "exclude_provider_outage": True, "sample_only": True},
        storage_config=storage_config,
    )
    record_freeze_approval(
        freeze_approval_id=f"{_family_slug(normalized_family)}_sample_freeze_approval_v1",
        package_id=package.package_id,
        approval_status="approved",
        approved_by=approved_by,
        approval_notes="Sample package freeze for runnable FS10 gate smoke evidence only.",
        prerequisites={"sample_count": normalized_count, "batch_size": normalized_batch_size, "production_acceptance": False},
        storage_config=storage_config,
    )
    if freeze:
        package = freeze_validation_package(package_id=package.package_id, actor=approved_by, storage_config=storage_config)
    else:
        loaded = load_validation_package(package_id=package.package_id, storage_config=storage_config)
        assert loaded is not None
        package = loaded

    return SamplePackageBuildResult(
        dataset_family=normalized_family,
        package=package,
        item_count=package.item_count,
        batch_size=normalized_batch_size,
        batches_written=len(batches),
        validated_gate_ids=gate_ids,
    )


def build_all_canonical_sample_validation_packages(
    *,
    sample_count: int = 10,
    batch_size: int = MAX_SAMPLE_BATCH_SIZE,
    freeze: bool = True,
    approved_by: str = "fs10_sample_builder",
    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig | None = None,
) -> list[SamplePackageBuildResult]:
    return [
        build_sample_validation_package(
            dataset_family=family,
            sample_count=sample_count,
            batch_size=batch_size,
            freeze=freeze,
            approved_by=approved_by,
            storage_config=storage_config,
        )
        for family in CANONICAL_SAMPLE_PACKAGE_IDS
    ]

    "build_sample_validation_package",

270	def _collect_real_records(
271	    *,
272	    archetype: str,
273	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig | None,
274	) -> list[RealValidationRecord]:
275	    records: list[RealValidationRecord] = []
276	    seen: set[str] = set()
277	    for record in _records_from_existing_candidates(archetype=archetype, storage_config=storage_config):
278	        if record.candidate_id not in seen:
279	            seen.add(record.candidate_id)
280	            records.append(record)
281	    for record in _records_from_validation_runs(archetype=archetype, storage_config=storage_config):
282	        if record.candidate_id not in seen:
283	            seen.add(record.candidate_id)
284	            records.append(record)
285	    for record in _records_from_runtime_reports(archetype=archetype, storage_config=storage_config):
286	        if record.candidate_id not in seen:
287	            seen.add(record.candidate_id)
288	            records.append(record)
289	    records.sort(key=lambda record: (record.split, record.question_id, record.candidate_id))
290	    return records

293	def _records_from_existing_candidates(
294	    *,
295	    archetype: str,
296	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig | None,
297	) -> list[RealValidationRecord]:
298	    database = ensure_database_schema(storage_config)
299	    with database.session_scope() as session:
300	        rows = session.scalars(
301	            select(FS10ValidationCandidateItemRow)
302	            .where(FS10ValidationCandidateItemRow.status.in_(("reviewed", "approved", "candidate")))
303	            .order_by(FS10ValidationCandidateItemRow.candidate_id)
304	        ).all()
305	    records: list[RealValidationRecord] = []
306	    for row in rows:
307	        payload = dict(row.normalized_payload_json or {})
308	        if payload.get("validation_package_archetype") != archetype:
309	            continue
310	        if not _payload_is_real(payload):
311	            continue
312	        if not _required_payload_complete(archetype=archetype, payload=payload):
313	            continue
314	        record = RealValidationRecord(
315	            archetype=archetype,
316	            candidate_id=str(row.candidate_id),
317	            external_id=str(row.external_id),
318	            question_id=str(row.question_id or row.candidate_id),
319	            title=str(row.title or row.question_id or row.candidate_id),
320	            source_payload=dict(row.source_payload_json or {}),
321	            normalized_payload=payload,
322	            split=str(payload.get("split") or _assign_split(str(row.question_id or row.candidate_id))),
323	            leakage_group=str(payload.get("leakage_group") or row.question_id or row.candidate_id),
324	        )
325	        records.append(record)
326	    return records

329	def _records_from_validation_runs(
330	    *,
331	    archetype: str,
332	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig | None,
333	) -> list[RealValidationRecord]:
334	    database = ensure_database_schema(storage_config)
335	    with database.session_scope() as session:
336	        rows = session.execute(
337	            select(FS10ValidationRunRow, FS10ValidationQuestionScoreRow, FS10ValidationTrajectoryResultRow)
338	            .join(FS10ValidationQuestionScoreRow, FS10ValidationQuestionScoreRow.run_id == FS10ValidationRunRow.run_id)
339	            .outerjoin(
340	                FS10ValidationTrajectoryResultRow,
341	                (FS10ValidationTrajectoryResultRow.run_id == FS10ValidationQuestionScoreRow.run_id)
342	                & (FS10ValidationTrajectoryResultRow.question_id == FS10ValidationQuestionScoreRow.question_id),
343	            )
344	            .where(FS10ValidationQuestionScoreRow.status == "completed")
345	            .order_by(FS10ValidationRunRow.run_id, FS10ValidationQuestionScoreRow.question_id)
346	        ).all()
347	    records: list[RealValidationRecord] = []
348	    for run_row, score_row, trajectory_row in rows:
349	        if _row_is_sample_or_synthetic(run_row=run_row, score_row=score_row):
350	            continue
351	        payload = _payload_from_score_row(archetype=archetype, run_row=run_row, score_row=score_row, trajectory_row=trajectory_row)
352	        if payload is None:
353	            continue
354	        source_payload = {
355	            "source_kind": "fs10_validation_run",
356	            "db_refs": {
357	                "run": f"db://fs10/validation_runs/{run_row.run_id}",
358	                "question_score": f"db://fs10/validation_runs/{run_row.run_id}/question_scores/{score_row.question_id}",
359	                "trajectory_result": (
360	                    f"db://fs10/validation_runs/{run_row.run_id}/trajectory_results/{score_row.question_id}"
361	                    if trajectory_row is not None
362	                    else None
363	                ),
364	            },
365	            "stage_b": dict(run_row.stage_b_json or {}),
366	            "counts": dict(score_row.counts_json or {}),
367	            "retrieval": dict(score_row.retrieval_json or {}),
368	            "row_sha256": _stable_hash(
369	                {
370	                    "run_id": run_row.run_id,
371	                    "question_id": score_row.question_id,
372	                    "forecast_probabilities": dict(score_row.forecast_probabilities_json or {}),
373	                    "brier_score": score_row.brier_score,
374	                }
375	            ),
376	        }
377	        candidate_id = _candidate_id(archetype, str(run_row.run_id), str(score_row.question_id))
378	        records.append(
379	            RealValidationRecord(
380	                archetype=archetype,
381	                candidate_id=candidate_id,
382	                external_id=f"{archetype}:{run_row.run_id}:{score_row.question_id}",
383	                question_id=str(score_row.question_id),
384	                title=str(score_row.title or score_row.question_id),
385	                source_payload=source_payload,
386	                normalized_payload=payload,
387	                split=str(payload.get("split") or _assign_split(str(score_row.question_id))),
388	                leakage_group=str(payload.get("leakage_group") or score_row.question_id),
389	            )
390	        )
391	    return records

396	    archetype: str,

401	    if not results_root.exists():
402	        return []
403	    records: list[RealValidationRecord] = []
404	    for report_path in sorted(results_root.rglob("*_report.json")):
405	        try:

407	        except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
408	            continue
409	        run_id = str(report_payload.get("run_id") or report_path.stem)
410	        for question in list(report_payload.get("questions") or []):
411	            if not isinstance(question, dict):
412	                continue
413	            if bool(question.get("sample_only")):
414	                continue
415	            payload = _payload_from_report_question(archetype=archetype, run_id=run_id, report_path=report_path, question=question)
416	            if payload is None:
417	                continue
418	            question_id = str(question.get("question_id") or "").strip()
419	            source_payload = {
420	                "source_kind": "runtime_report_import",
421	                "transport_ref": str(report_path),
422	                "transport_sha256": _file_sha256(report_path),
423	                "db_ref": "db://fs10/imported-artifacts/runtime-report",
424	                "transport_only": True,
425	                "report_run_id": run_id,
426	                "raw_question": question,
427	            }
428	            records.append(
429	                RealValidationRecord(
430	                    archetype=archetype,
431	                    candidate_id=_candidate_id(archetype, "runtime_report", str(report_path), question_id),
432	                    external_id=f"{archetype}:runtime_report:{run_id}:{question_id}",
433	                    question_id=question_id,
434	                    title=str(question.get("title") or question_id),
435	                    source_payload=source_payload,
436	                    normalized_payload=payload,
437	                    split=str(payload.get("split") or _assign_split(question_id)),
438	                    leakage_group=str(payload.get("leakage_group") or question_id),
439	                )
440	            )
441	    return records

756	def _row_is_sample_or_synthetic(
757	    *,
758	    run_row: FS10ValidationRunRow,
759	    score_row: FS10ValidationQuestionScoreRow,
760	) -> bool:
761	    stage_b = dict(run_row.stage_b_json or {})
762	    counts = dict(score_row.counts_json or {})
763	    retrieval = dict(score_row.retrieval_json or {})
764	    values = [stage_b, counts, retrieval]
765	    if any(bool(value.get("sample_only")) for value in values):
766	        return True
767	    if any(bool(value.get("sample_runnable")) for value in values):
768	        return True
769	    generation_mode = _first_text(counts, stage_b, retrieval, keys=("source_derivation", "data_derivation", "generation_mode"))
770	    if generation_mode in {"controlled synthetic fixture", "synthetic", "sample", "deterministic_sample"}:
771	        return True
772	    return str(run_row.set_name or "").startswith("fs10_gate_sequence:")
773

775	def _payload_is_real(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
776	    if bool(payload.get("sample_only")) or bool(payload.get("sample_runnable")):
777	        return False
778	    source_derivation = str(payload.get("source_derivation") or payload.get("data_derivation") or "").strip()
779	    if source_derivation not in REAL_DERIVATION_MODES:
780	        return False
781	    if source_derivation in {"controlled synthetic fixture", "synthetic", "sample"}:
782	        return False
783	    return bool(payload.get("resolved_outcome") is not None or payload.get("real_resolved_outcome") is not None)

786	def _required_payload_complete(*, archetype: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
787	    common_required = (
788	        "resolved_outcome",
789	        "forecast_probabilities",
790	        "brier_score",
791	        "calibration_bucket",
792	        "source_refs",
793	        "split",
794	        "leakage_group",
795	    )

797	        return False

799	        required = ("baseline_probability", "prior_probability", "prior_vs_outcome_brier", "estimator_label", "fallback_label")
800	        return all(payload.get(key) is not None for key in required)
801	    if archetype == VD_RESOLVED_FORECAST_REPLAY:
802	        required = ("frozen_run_id", "question_id", "forecast_brier", "replay_provenance")
803	        return all(payload.get(key) is not None for key in required)

807	def _first_text(*payloads: dict[str, Any], keys: tuple[str, ...]) -> str:
808	    for payload in payloads:
809	        for key in keys:
810	            value = payload.get(key)
811	            if value is not None:
812	                text = str(value).strip()
813	                if text:
814	                    return text
815	    return ""

818	def _resolved_outcome(
819	    *,
820	    score_row: FS10ValidationQuestionScoreRow,
821	    trajectory_row: FS10ValidationTrajectoryResultRow | None,
822	    counts: dict[str, Any],
823	) -> bool | None:
824	    if "resolved_outcome" in counts:
825	        return _boolish(counts.get("resolved_outcome"))
826	    if "real_resolved_outcome" in counts:
827	        return _boolish(counts.get("real_resolved_outcome"))
828	    if trajectory_row is not None:
829	        return bool(int(trajectory_row.actual_outcome))
830	    return _outcome_from_answer(str(score_row.correct_answer or ""))
831

833	def _outcome_from_answer(answer: str) -> bool | None:
834	    normalized = str(answer or "").strip().lower()
835	    if normalized in {"yes", "true", "1", "resolved_true", "pass"}:
836	        return True
837	    if normalized in {"no", "false", "0", "resolved_false", "fail"}:
838	        return False
839	    return None
840	
841	
842	def _boolish(value: Any) -> bool | None:
843	    if isinstance(value, bool):
844	        return value
845	    if isinstance(value, int | float):
846	        return bool(int(value))
847	    return _outcome_from_answer(str(value or ""))
848	
849	
850	def _forecast_probability(*, forecast: dict[str, float], correct_answer: str, actual: int) -> float | None:
851	    if "yes" in {key.lower() for key in forecast}:
852	        for key, value in forecast.items():
853	            if key.lower() == "yes":
854	                return _clamp_probability(value)
855	    if correct_answer in forecast:
856	        return _clamp_probability(forecast[correct_answer])
857	    if actual == 1:
858	        return _clamp_probability(max(forecast.values()))
859	    if len(forecast) == 2:
860	        return _clamp_probability(min(forecast.values()))
861	    return None
862	
863	
864	def _optional_float(value: Any) -> float | None:
865	    if value is None:
866	        return None
867	    try:
868	        return float(value)
869	    except (TypeError, ValueError):
870	        return None
871	
872	
873	def _clamp_probability(value: Any) -> float:
874	    return max(0.0, min(1.0, float(value)))
875	
876	
877	def _brier(probability: float, actual: int) -> float:
878	    return (float(probability) - int(actual)) ** 2
879	
880	
881	def _calibration_bucket(probability: float) -> str:
882	    clamped = _clamp_probability(probability)
883	    lower = min(0.9, int(clamped * 10) / 10)
884	    upper = min(1.0, lower + 0.1)
885	    return f"{lower:.1f}-{upper:.1f}"
886

888	def _assign_split(question_id: str) -> str:
889	    digest = int(hashlib.sha256(str(question_id).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:8], 16) % 10
890	    if digest < 6:
891	        return "train"
892	    if digest < 8:

897	def _list_or_default(value: Any, default: list[Any]) -> list[Any]:

899	        return value

901	        return list(default)
902	    return [value]

906	    digest = _stable_hash({"archetype": archetype, "parts": list(parts)})[:24]

911	def _stable_hash(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
912	    encoded = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), default=str).encode("utf-8")
913	    return hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()

916	def _file_sha256(path: Path) -> str:
917	    digest = hashlib.sha256()
918	    try:
919	        with path.open("rb") as handle:
920	            for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(65536), b""):
921	                digest.update(chunk)
922	    except OSError:
923	        return ""
924	    return digest.hexdigest()

108	        for result in build_all_canonical_sample_validation_packages(
109	            sample_count=sample_count,
110	            batch_size=batch_size,
111	            freeze=True,
112	            storage_config=storage_config,
113	        )
114	    ]

117	def _matching_packages(
118	    *,
119	    gate_id: str,
120	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig | None = None,
121	) -> tuple[list[StoredValidationPackage], list[str]]:
122	    required_families = list(GATE_SAMPLE_FAMILIES.get(gate_id, []))
123	    if gate_id not in SUPPORTED_GATE_IDS:
124	        return [], [f"unsupported_gate:{gate_id}"]
125	    if not required_families:
126	        return [], []
127	    packages = list_validation_packages(lifecycle_state=FROZEN_STATE, storage_config=storage_config)
128	    matched: list[StoredValidationPackage] = []
129	    missing: list[str] = []
130	    for family in required_families:
131	        row = next(
132	            (
133	                package
134	                for package in packages
135	                if package.metadata.get("dataset_family") == family
136	                and gate_id in list(package.metadata.get("validated_gate_ids") or [])
137	                and package.package_id == ALL_SAMPLE_PACKAGE_IDS[family]
138	            ),
139	            None,
140	        )
141	        if row is None:
142	            missing.append(family)
143	        else:
144	            matched.append(row)
145	    return matched, missing
146	
147	
148	def _matching_production_packages(
149	    *,
150	    gate_id: str,
151	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig | None = None,
152	) -> tuple[list[StoredValidationPackage], list[str]]:
153	    if gate_id not in SUPPORTED_GATE_IDS:
154	        return [], [f"unsupported_gate:{gate_id}"]
155	    required_families = list(PRODUCTION_LOCK_GATE_FAMILIES.get(gate_id, []))
156	    if not required_families:
157	        return [], []
158	    packages = list_validation_packages(lifecycle_state=FROZEN_STATE, storage_config=storage_config)
159	    matched: list[StoredValidationPackage] = []
160	    missing: list[str] = []
161	    for family in required_families:
162	        row = next(
163	            (
164	                package
165	                for package in packages
166	                if package.metadata.get("validation_package_archetype") == family
167	                and package.metadata.get("sample_only") is False
168	                and package.metadata.get("production_lock_eligible") is True
169	                and gate_id in list(package.metadata.get("validated_gate_ids") or [])
170	                and package.item_count >= _production_lock_required_count(package=package, family=family)
171	            ),
172	            None,
173	        )
174	        if row is None:
175	            missing.append(family)
176	        else:
177	            matched.append(row)
178	    return matched, missing

181	def _production_lock_required_count(*, package: StoredValidationPackage, family: str) -> int:
182	    metadata = dict(package.metadata or {})
183	    if metadata.get("min_count_requested") is not None:
184	        return int(metadata["min_count_requested"])
185	    if metadata.get("production_min_count") is not None:
186	        return int(metadata["production_min_count"])
187	    return int(PRODUCTION_MIN_COUNTS.get(family, 1))

190	def _candidate_rows_for_packages(
191	    *,
192	    package_ids: list[str],
193	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig | None = None,
194	) -> list[tuple[str, str, str, dict[str, Any]]]:
195	    if not package_ids:
196	        return []
197	    database = ensure_database_schema(storage_config)
198	    with database.session_scope() as session:
199	        rows = session.execute(
200	            select(
201	                FS10ValidationPackageItemRow.package_id,
202	                FS10ValidationCandidateItemRow.question_id,
203	                FS10ValidationCandidateItemRow.title,
204	                FS10ValidationCandidateItemRow.normalized_payload_json,
205	            )
206	            .join(
207	                FS10ValidationCandidateItemRow,
208	                FS10ValidationCandidateItemRow.candidate_id == FS10ValidationPackageItemRow.candidate_id,
209	            )
210	            .where(FS10ValidationPackageItemRow.package_id.in_(package_ids))
211	            .order_by(FS10ValidationPackageItemRow.package_id, FS10ValidationCandidateItemRow.question_id)
212	        ).all()
213	    return [
214	        (str(package_id), str(question_id), str(title), dict(payload or {}))
215	        for package_id, question_id, title, payload in rows
216	        if str(question_id or "").strip()
217	    ]

220	def _persist_gate_evidence(
221	    *,
222	    gate_id: str,
223	    sequence_index: int,
224	    status: str,
225	    packages: list[StoredValidationPackage],
226	    missing: list[str],
227	    production_lock: bool,
228	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig | None,
229	) -> str:
230	    mode = "production_lock" if production_lock else "sample"
231	    run_id = f"fs10_gate_{mode}_{gate_id.lower().replace('-', '_')}_{sequence_index:02d}_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
232	    package_ids = [package.package_id for package in packages]
233	    candidate_rows = _candidate_rows_for_packages(package_ids=package_ids, storage_config=storage_config)
234	    question_scores: list[QuestionScore] = []
235	    bucket_lookup: dict[str, str] = {}
236	    if status == "sample_runnable":
237	        for package_id, question_id, title, payload in candidate_rows:
238	            dataset_family = str(payload.get("dataset_family") or package_id)
239	            question_scores.append(
240	                QuestionScore(
241	                    question_id=question_id,
242	                    title=title,
243	                    qtype=str(payload.get("question_type") or "binary"),
244	                    correct_answer="yes",
245	                    forecast_probabilities={"yes": 0.9, "no": 0.1},
246	                    brier_score=0.01,
247	                    timings={"sample_gate_seconds": 0.0},
248	                    counts={"package_id": package_id, "sample_only": True},
249	                    retrieval=RetrievalDiagnostics(
250	                        pack_name=dataset_family,
251	                        provider="fs10_sample_package",
252	                        downloaded_total=1,
253	                        status="sample_runnable",
254	                        message="Deterministic sample gate evidence; not production analytical acceptance.",
255	                    ),
256	                    targets=[question_id],
257	                )
258	            )
259	            bucket_lookup[question_id] = dataset_family
260	    elif status == "production_lock_ready":
261	        for package_id, question_id, title, payload in candidate_rows:
262	            evidence_question_id = f"{package_id}:{question_id}"
263	            dataset_family = str(payload.get("validation_package_archetype") or payload.get("dataset_family") or package_id)
264	            forecast = {str(key): float(value) for key, value in dict(payload.get("forecast_probabilities") or {}).items()}
265	            if not forecast and payload.get("forecast_probability") is not None:
266	                yes_probability = float(payload["forecast_probability"])
267	                forecast = {"yes": yes_probability, "no": 1.0 - yes_probability}
268	            brier_score = float(
269	                payload.get("prior_vs_outcome_brier")
270	                if payload.get("prior_vs_outcome_brier") is not None
271	                else payload.get("forecast_brier")
272	                if payload.get("forecast_brier") is not None
273	                else payload.get("brier_score")
274	                if payload.get("brier_score") is not None
275	                else 0.0
276	            )
277	            question_scores.append(
278	                QuestionScore(
279	                    question_id=evidence_question_id,
280	                    title=title,
281	                    qtype=str(payload.get("question_type") or "binary"),
282	                    correct_answer=str(payload.get("correct_answer") or payload.get("resolved_outcome") or "yes"),
283	                    forecast_probabilities=forecast,
284	                    brier_score=brier_score,
285	                    timings={"production_lock_seconds": 0.0},
286	                    counts={
287	                        "package_id": package_id,
288	                        "sample_only": False,
289	                        "production_lock": True,
290	                        "validation_package_archetype": dataset_family,
291	                        "source_derivation": payload.get("source_derivation"),
292	                    },
293	                    retrieval=RetrievalDiagnostics(
294	                        pack_name=dataset_family,
295	                        provider="fs10_real_validation_package",
296	                        downloaded_total=1,
297	                        status="production_lock_ready",
298	                        message="Frozen real package gate evidence; sample packages are ignored in production-lock mode.",
299	                    ),
300	                    targets=[question_id],
301	                )
302	            )
303	            bucket_lookup[evidence_question_id] = dataset_family
304	
305	    run_score = build_validation_run_score(
306	        run_id=run_id,
307	        question_scores=question_scores,
308	        failed_ids=[] if status in {"sample_runnable", "production_lock_ready"} else [gate_id],
309	        bucket_lookup=bucket_lookup,
310	        total_seconds=0.0,
311	    )
312	    required_families = (
313	        list(PRODUCTION_LOCK_GATE_FAMILIES.get(gate_id, [])) if production_lock else list(GATE_SAMPLE_FAMILIES.get(gate_id, []))
314	    )
315	    stage_b = {
316	        "gate_id": gate_id,
317	        "sequence_index": sequence_index,
318	        "status": status,
319	        "sample_runnable": status == "sample_runnable",
320	        "production_acceptance_claimed": production_lock and status == "production_lock_ready",
321	        "package_ids": package_ids,
322	        "missing_dataset_families": missing,
323	        "required_validation_package_archetypes": required_families,
324	        "sample_only": not production_lock,
325	        "production_lock_mode": production_lock,
326	        "production_lock_ready": production_lock and status == "production_lock_ready",
327	        "production_lock_blocker": (
328	            None
329	            if production_lock and status == "production_lock_ready"
330	            else "missing frozen real validation package archetypes: " + ", ".join(missing)
331	            if production_lock and missing
332	            else "sample gate evidence is not production analytical acceptance"
333	        ),
334	    }
335	    persist_validation_run(
336	        set_name=f"fs10_gate_sequence:{gate_id}",
337	        run_score=run_score,
338	        built_count=len(candidate_rows),
339	        resolved_count=len(candidate_rows) if status in {"sample_runnable", "production_lock_ready"} else 0,
340	        stage_b_result=stage_b,
341	        bucket_lookup=bucket_lookup,
342	        trajectory_results=[],
343	        storage_config=storage_config,
344	    )
345	    persist_component_artifact(
346	        run_id=run_id,
347	        question_id=gate_id,
348	        upstream_fs=gate_id.split("-")[1] if "-" in gate_id else "FS10",
349	        artifact_kind="production_lock_gate_run" if production_lock else "sample_gate_run",
350	        status=status,
351	        payload={
352	            **stage_b,
353	            "package_refs": [
354	                {
355	                    "package_id": package.package_id,
356	                    "dataset_family": package.metadata.get("dataset_family"),
357	                    "frozen_at": package.frozen_at,
358	                    "sha256": None,
359	                    "source_ref": f"db://fs10/validation_packages/{package.package_id}",
360	                    "regeneration_ref": package.metadata,
361	                }
362	                for package in packages
363	            ],
364	        },
365	        storage_config=storage_config,
366	    )
367	    return run_id

370	def run_fs10_gate(
371	    *,
372	    gate_id: str,
373	    sequence_index: int = 1,
374	    production_lock: bool = False,
375	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig | None = None,
376	) -> GateRunResult:
377	    normalized_gate_id = str(gate_id or "").strip()
378	    if not normalized_gate_id:
379	        raise ValueError("gate_id is required")
380	    if production_lock:
381	        packages, missing = _matching_production_packages(gate_id=normalized_gate_id, storage_config=storage_config)
382	        status = "production_lock_ready" if not missing else "blocked"
383	    else:
384	        packages, missing = _matching_packages(gate_id=normalized_gate_id, storage_config=storage_config)
385	        status = "sample_runnable" if not missing else "blocked"
386	    run_id = _persist_gate_evidence(
387	        gate_id=normalized_gate_id,
388	        sequence_index=sequence_index,
389	        status=status,
390	        packages=packages,
391	        missing=missing,
392	        production_lock=production_lock,
393	        storage_config=storage_config,
394	    )
395	    return GateRunResult(
396	        gate_id=normalized_gate_id,
397	        sequence_index=sequence_index,
398	        status=status,
399	        run_id=run_id,
400	        package_ids=[package.package_id for package in packages],
401	        missing_dataset_families=missing,
402	        sample_runnable=status == "sample_runnable",
403	        production_lock_ready=production_lock and status == "production_lock_ready",
404	        production_acceptance_claimed=production_lock and status == "production_lock_ready",
405	    )

408	def run_fs2_process_authority_gate(
409	    *,
410	    run_id: str,
411	    question_id: str,
412	    sequence_index: int = 1,
413	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig | None = None,
414	) -> FS2ProcessGateResult:
415	    """Run ``P-FS2-01`` against an existing FS2 run/question.
416	
417	    This is process-gate evidence: it persists whether the expected DB authority
418	    rows exist and link cleanly. It does not claim analytical acceptance.
419	    """
420	
421	    normalized_run_id = str(run_id or "").strip()
422	    normalized_question_id = str(question_id or "").strip()
423	    if not normalized_run_id:
424	        raise ValueError("run_id is required")
425	    if not normalized_question_id:
426	        raise ValueError("question_id is required")
427	
428	    report = evaluate_fs2_process_authority(
429	        run_id=normalized_run_id,
430	        question_id=normalized_question_id,
431	        storage_config=storage_config,
432	    )
433	    status = "pass" if report.status == "pass" else "blocked"
434	    validation_run_id = f"fs10_gate_p_fs2_01_{sequence_index:02d}_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
435	    stage_b = {
436	        "schema_version": "fs10_p_fs2_process_gate_v1",
437	        "gate_id": "P-FS2-01",
438	        "sequence_index": int(sequence_index),
439	        "status": status,
440	        "source_run_id": normalized_run_id,
441	        "question_id": normalized_question_id,
442	        "production_acceptance_claimed": False,
443	        "authority_report": report.to_dict(),
444	    }
445	    question_scores: list[QuestionScore] = []
446	    failed_ids: list[str] = []
447	    if status == "pass":
448	        question_scores.append(
449	            QuestionScore(
450	                question_id=normalized_question_id,
451	                title=f"P-FS2-01 process authority for {normalized_question_id}",
452	                qtype="process",
453	                correct_answer="pass",
454	                forecast_probabilities={"pass": 1.0},
455	                brier_score=0.0,
456	                counts=dict(report.counts),
457	                retrieval=RetrievalDiagnostics(
458	                    pack_name="P-FS2-01",
459	                    provider="fs2_process_authority",
460	                    downloaded_total=int(report.counts.get("valid_document_blobs") or 0),
461	                    status=status,
462	                    message="DB-backed FS2 process authority passed.",
463	                ),
464	                targets=[normalized_question_id],
465	            )
466	        )
467	    else:
468	        failed_ids.append(normalized_question_id)
469	
470	    run_score = build_validation_run_score(
471	        run_id=validation_run_id,
472	        question_scores=question_scores,
473	        failed_ids=failed_ids,
474	        bucket_lookup={normalized_question_id: "P-FS2-01"},
475	        total_seconds=0.0,
476	    )
477	    persist_validation_run(
478	        set_name="fs10_process_gate:P-FS2-01",
479	        run_score=run_score,
480	        built_count=1,
481	        resolved_count=1 if status == "pass" else 0,
482	        stage_b_result=stage_b,
483	        bucket_lookup={normalized_question_id: "P-FS2-01"},
484	        trajectory_results=[],
485	        storage_config=storage_config,
486	    )
487	    persist_component_artifact(
488	        run_id=validation_run_id,
489	        question_id=normalized_question_id,
490	        upstream_fs="FS2",
491	        artifact_kind="process_authority:P-FS2-01",
492	        status=status,
493	        payload=stage_b,
494	        storage_config=storage_config,
495	    )
496	    return FS2ProcessGateResult(
497	        gate_id="P-FS2-01",
498	        sequence_index=int(sequence_index),
499	        status=status,
500	        validation_run_id=validation_run_id,
501	        source_run_id=normalized_run_id,
502	        question_id=normalized_question_id,
503	        authority_report=report,
504	        production_acceptance_claimed=False,
505	    )
506	
507	
508	def run_fs10_gate_sequence(
509	    *,
510	    gate_ids: list[str] | tuple[str, ...],
511	    ensure_samples: bool = False,
512	    sample_count: int = 10,
513	    batch_size: int = 5,
514	    production_lock: bool = False,
515	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig | None = None,
516	) -> GateSequenceResult:
517	    if ensure_samples and production_lock:
518	        raise ValueError("production_lock mode selects only frozen real packages; do not combine it with ensure_samples")
519	    if ensure_samples:
520	        ensure_sample_gate_packages(sample_count=sample_count, batch_size=batch_size, storage_config=storage_config)
521	    results = [
522	        run_fs10_gate(
523	            gate_id=str(gate_id),
524	            sequence_index=index,
525	            production_lock=production_lock,
526	            storage_config=storage_config,
527	        )
528	        for index, gate_id in enumerate(gate_ids, start=1)
529	    ]
530	    return GateSequenceResult(results=results)
531	
532

544	    "run_fs10_gate_sequence",
545	]

> DEVELOPER

i dont understands gates wht they mean

> AGENT

Gates are quality checkpoints. Each one is a question of the form *"has this part of the pipeline been verified to a known standard?"* You can't promote work to production unless every gate in front of it has passed.

The IDs look intimidating but follow a simple pattern:

```
P-FS2-01
│ │   └─ check number within that feature set (just sequencing)
│ └──── which feature set (FS1 through FS7) — what part of the pipeline
└────── P or A — what kind of check
```

**P = Process gate.** "Did the system do the right *steps*?" Example: P-FS2-01 checks that FS2 produced a document blob, linked it to an information node, wrote an LLM prompt trace, and stored a current-resolution record. No judgement on whether the *output is good* — just whether the plumbing connected end to end.

**A = Analytical gate.** "Is the *output* up to standard?" Example: A-FS2-01 would check things like Brier scores, calibration, research defensibility. This is where actual quality bars live.

**P-DB-01 through P-DB-06** are special — they check the database itself is in the expected shape before any feature-set work is judged.

**Gate sequence:** the standard run walks all 14 gates in order — six DB checks, then `P-FS1 → A-FS1 → P-FS2 → A-FS2 → P-FS3 → A-FS3 → P-FS4 → A-FS4`. Each gate has a list of "validation packages" (curated test datasets) it needs. The runner looks them up; if everything's there it emits `sample_runnable` (the gate can run on fixtures) or `production_lock_ready` (the gate has real frozen data behind it). If a required package is missing, it emits `blocked` and records which families are missing.

**Why two modes?**
- **Sample mode**: use deterministic fixtures, prove the gate machinery works. Like a CI smoke test.
- **Production-lock mode**: use real data, with minimum counts (300+ baseline questions, 150+ resolved replays). This is the real bar before claiming the pipeline is fit for production.

So the gate runner is basically a structured way of saying: *"before you trust the system's forecasts, here are 14 specific questions I want answers to, in this order, and I want database evidence for each answer."*

Concrete picture: it's the difference between "the code compiles" (sample) and "the code is approved to ship to customers" (production-lock). The gates encode what that approval bar actually looks like.

> DEVELOPER

so only if the gates are gould should we push to prod basically

> AGENT

Exactly. That's the whole point.

The gates are the contract for "this pipeline is safe to use in production." If any gate is `blocked` or only `sample_runnable`, you've got *some* evidence the code works on fixtures but no evidence it works on real data at sufficient scale. You can run the system in that state for development and testing, but you shouldn't claim its forecasts are trustworthy.

`production_lock_ready` on every gate is the bar. It means:
- The right validation packages exist
- They're frozen (locked, immutable, won't drift)
- They contain real data (not synthetic fixtures)
- They have enough records (300+ for baselines, 150+ for replay)
- They've been through the freeze-approval workflow

Once all 14 gates are green in production-lock mode, the system has audit-trail evidence that the FS1→FS4 pipeline has been validated end-to-end. That's the "ready to ship" signal.

It's stricter than typical CI/CD because forecasting is a domain where wrong answers can be confidently wrong and hard to detect. The gate framework forces the question *"on what evidence do we believe this works?"* to have a concrete database-backed answer instead of a hand-wave.

> DEVELOPER

but the thing I am seeing here is that there is two sides to elijah, one is all this infrastructre for tuing, and the rest is the actual product itself. They seem very tightly coupled at the moment

> AGENT

That's a sharp observation and you're right. Let me be honest about what I've seen.

**The two sides are:**

1. **The product** — FS1 to FS7. Takes a question, retrieves evidence, extracts drivers, runs estimators, weights edges, produces a forecast. This is what a user would interact with.

2. **The infrastructure** — FS10 (validation/tuning) and FS11 (quality control). Measures whether the product is working, tracks performance over time, gates promotion of new behaviour.

**Where they're coupled:**

- **Same database tables**: `QuestionRow`, `NodeRow`, `RunRow` are written by the product *and* read by FS10/FS11. There's no separation.
- **Same evaluators called from both sides**: `evaluate_target_set_integrity` runs when a user creates a question (gating product behaviour) and also when FS10 replays a historical question (gating validation).
- **QC judges live inside the product runtime**: `DefensibilityJudge` is called during normal forecasting, not just validation. It looks up track records that FS10 wrote.
- **You can't ship the product without the validation tables**: `database.py` defines them all in one file. The schema is monolithic.

**Why it's like this (the charitable read):**

The argument is that validation should run against *the actual production code*, not a copy or mock. If you run the validator and the product on different code paths, the validation is theatre — it tells you something passed, but maybe not what's running in prod. By running everything through one set of code paths and one database, you get evidence that actually transfers.

The track-record-aware judge in FS11 is a clear example: validation runs feed forward into product judgement. The outer loop is a deliberate feedback mechanism — the system gets *better* at scoring because validation data improved.

**The cost (the honest read):**

- Hard to reason about: when reading a function it's not always obvious whether it's product code or validation code. They share types, tables, helpers.
- Hard to test in isolation: product tests pull in validation tables because they're in the same `Base.metadata`.
- Hard to deploy minimally: a "just the product" cut isn't really possible without significant work.
- Changes ripple: touching a product table breaks validation builders that read it; touching a validation evaluator can affect product behaviour through QC.

**What a cleaner separation would look like:**

Roughly: product code as stateless functions with well-typed inputs/outputs → thin storage layer → validation as a *consumer* of storage, never an internal collaborator → QC exposed to product through one narrow interface, with no shared internal types.

That would be a real refactor though, not a tidy-up. SPI-256 (the broader codebase-structure investigation) is the right place to capture this — want me to add it as an explicit thing to investigate there?

{
  "id": "SPI-256",
  "description": "## Context\n\nSPI-255 covers module organisation within `fs10_validation/` and `packages/`. This is the broader, repo-wide version of that question.\n\nThe codebase has grown across many feature sets (FS1–FS12), shared `packages/`, a `core/` layer, a `services/` layer, and a flat `fs10_validation/` package that sits at the top level. Boundaries between these have evolved organically and are no longer obvious from the directory layout.\n\nBefore the porting epic finishes and more code lands, it's worth a pass on whether the top-level shape is right.\n\n## Things to look at\n\n- **Top-level directories** — what's the intended purpose of each of `core/`, `packages/`, `fs10_validation/`, `services/`, `tests/`, `docs/`? Are there clear rules for what goes where, or has it become ad-hoc?\n- **`core/` vs `packages/`** — what's the difference? When porting, deciding which one a new file belongs in is currently a judgement call.\n- **Feature-set code placement** — FS1–FS12 logic is spread across `core/`, `packages/domain/`, `fs10_validation/components/`, and elsewhere. Is there one canonical place per feature set, or is the spread justified by separation of concerns?\n- **Top-level `fs10_validation/`** — why is FS10 the only feature set with its own top-level package? Should it move under `packages/domain/fs10/` to match the others, or is the top-level placement intentional (e.g. because it's a CLI surface)?\n- **`packages/storage/database.py`** — single ~2,600-line file holding every ORM table. Should it be split per feature-set?\n- **Import direction rules** — which packages are allowed to import from which? Are there implicit layering rules (e.g. `core/` can't import from `services/`) that should be made explicit?\n- **Test discoverability** — `tests/` is flat. With ~150+ test files, are naming conventions enough or should the directory mirror the source layout?\n- **`docs/` and `runtime/`** — what lives there, are they referenced by code, do they belong in-repo?\n- **Product vs validation/QC coupling** — the forecasting pipeline (FS1–FS7) and the validation/tuning/QC infrastructure (FS10/FS11) share database tables, evaluators, and runtime entry points. Examples:\n  - `QuestionRow` / `NodeRow` / `RunRow` are written by the product and read by FS10 validation builders.\n  - `evaluate_target_set_integrity` is called both when a user creates a question and when FS10 replays a historical question.\n  - `DefensibilityJudge` runs inside the product runtime, consuming track records that FS10 produces.\n  - `database.py` is monolithic — you cannot ship \"just the product\" without the validation tables.\n  - This is partly deliberate (validation running against the same code as production gives evidence that transfers), but the lack of an explicit interface between the two sides makes the system hard to reason about, hard to test in isolation, and hard to deploy minimally. Investigate whether a narrower, explicitly-typed seam between product and infrastructure is achievable without losing the \"validate against real code\" benefit.\n\n## Deliverable\n\nA one-page writeup with:\n\n1. Current state — what the top-level shape is and what the implicit rules appear to be.\n2. Observed inconsistencies — concrete examples where the placement of a file feels arbitrary.\n3. Options — keep-as-is, light cleanup (renames + doc), or restructure (move files).\n4. Recommendation — pick one option with the cost-benefit reasoning.\n5. Migration cost estimate — if a restructure is recommended, how many files would move, how disruptive to in-flight work (porting epic, parallel PRs).\n\nNo code changes in this ticket. Any restructure would be a follow-up ticket scoped from the writeup.\n\n## Out of scope\n\n- Module organisation within `fs10_validation/` and `packages/` — covered by SPI-255.\n- Branch / PR conventions, ticket naming — already documented in CLAUDE.md.\n- Python style conventions (`__all__`, type hints, etc.) — also under SPI-255.\n\n## Related\n\n- SPI-255: Investigate module organisation across fs10_validation and packages/"
}

366	def persist_graph_construction_tune_evidence(
367	    *,
368	    package_id: str,
369	    candidate_id: str,
370	    split_name: str,
371	    question_results: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
372	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig | None = None,
373	) -> GraphConstructionTuneEvidenceResult:
374	    """Persist local FS3 tune evidence backed by a frozen graph-construction package.
375	
376	    ``question_results`` are the DB-backed result rows emitted by a local FS3
377	    parent-system trial. The helper records the validation run context plus
378	    FS3 component artifacts that ``RealTuneEvaluator`` can score without
379	    reading files.
380	    """
381	
382	    normalized_package_id = _clean_required(package_id, field_name="package_id")
383	    normalized_candidate_id = _clean_required(candidate_id, field_name="candidate_id")
384	    normalized_split_name = _clean_required(split_name, field_name="split_name")
385	    if normalized_split_name not in {"train", "eval"}:
386	        raise ValueError("split_name must be 'train' or 'eval'")
387	    package = load_validation_package(package_id=normalized_package_id, storage_config=storage_config)
388	    if package is None:
389	        raise ValueError(f"unknown VD-GRAPH-CONSTRUCTION package_id: {normalized_package_id!r}")
390	    if package.lifecycle_state != "frozen":
391	        raise ValueError(f"VD-GRAPH-CONSTRUCTION package {normalized_package_id!r} must be frozen before tuning")
392	
393	    allowed_question_ids = _package_question_ids(package_id=normalized_package_id, storage_config=storage_config)
394	    normalized_results: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
395	    for index, raw in enumerate(question_results):
396	        if not isinstance(raw, Mapping):
397	            raise ValueError(f"question_results[{index}] must be an object")
398	        row = dict(raw)
399	        question_id = _clean_required(row.get("question_id"), field_name=f"question_results[{index}].question_id")
400	        if question_id not in allowed_question_ids:
401	            raise ValueError(f"question_id {question_id!r} is not in VD-GRAPH-CONSTRUCTION package {normalized_package_id!r}")
402	        normalized_results.append(row)
403	    if not normalized_results:
404	        raise ValueError("question_results must be non-empty")
405	
406	    validation_run_id = f"real_FS3_{normalized_candidate_id}_{normalized_split_name}_{uuid4().hex[:8]}"
407	    context = {
408	        "kind": "tune_evidence",
409	        "evaluator": REAL_EVALUATOR_NAME,
410	        "fs_id": "FS3",
411	        "gate_id": "A-FS3-01",
412	        "cohort_id": package.package_id,
413	        "split_version": package.split_version,
414	        "split_name": normalized_split_name,
415	        "candidate_id": normalized_candidate_id,
416	        "validation_package_id": package.package_id,
417	        "validation_package_archetype": VD_GRAPH_CONSTRUCTION,
418	    }
419	    question_scores = [
420	        QuestionScore(
421	            question_id=str(row["question_id"]),
422	            title=str(row.get("title") or row["question_id"]),
423	            qtype="graph_construction",
424	            correct_answer="admit",
425	            forecast_probabilities={"admit": 1.0},
426	            brier_score=0.0,
427	            counts={
428	                "driver_record_count": int(row.get("driver_record_count") or 0),
429	                "indicator_record_count": int(row.get("indicator_record_count") or 0),
430	            },
431	            targets=[str(row["question_id"])],
432	        )
433	        for row in normalized_results
434	    ]
435	    run_score = ValidationRunScore(
436	        run_id=validation_run_id,
437	        question_scores=question_scores,
438	        mean_brier=0.0,
439	        median_brier=0.0,
440	        by_type={"graph_construction": 0.0},
441	        by_bucket={VD_GRAPH_CONSTRUCTION: 0.0},
442	        n_questions=len(question_scores),
443	        n_completed=len(question_scores),
444	        n_failed=0,
445	        failed_ids=[],
446	        total_seconds=0.0,
447	    )
448	    persist_validation_run(
449	        set_name=package.package_id,
450	        run_score=run_score,
451	        built_count=len(question_scores),
452	        resolved_count=len(question_scores),
453	        stage_b_result={
454	            "tune_context": context,
455	            "validation_context": context,
456	            "validation_package_ref": {
457	                "package_id": package.package_id,
458	                "split_version": package.split_version,
459	                "source_ref": f"db://fs10/validation_packages/{package.package_id}",
460	            },
461	            "pipeline_result": {"summary": {"run_id": validation_run_id}, "results": []},
462	        },
463	        bucket_lookup={score.question_id: VD_GRAPH_CONSTRUCTION for score in question_scores},
464	        trajectory_results=[],
465	        storage_config=storage_config,
466	    )
467	    for row in normalized_results:
468	        question_id = str(row["question_id"])
469	        persist_component_artifact(
470	            run_id=validation_run_id,
471	            question_id=question_id,
472	            upstream_fs="FS3",
473	            artifact_kind="driver_extraction",
474	            payload={
475	                "schema_version": "fs3_driver_extraction_tune_evidence_v1",
476	                "validation_package_id": package.package_id,
477	                "candidate_id": normalized_candidate_id,
478	                "split_name": normalized_split_name,
479	                "record_count": int(row.get("driver_record_count") or 0),
480	                "grounded_count": int(row.get("driver_grounded_count") or 0),
481	            },
482	            storage_config=storage_config,
483	        )
484	        persist_component_artifact(
485	            run_id=validation_run_id,
486	            question_id=question_id,
487	            upstream_fs="FS3",
488	            artifact_kind="indicator_extraction",
489	            payload={
490	                "schema_version": "fs3_indicator_extraction_tune_evidence_v1",
491	                "validation_package_id": package.package_id,
492	                "candidate_id": normalized_candidate_id,
493	                "split_name": normalized_split_name,
494	                "record_count": int(row.get("indicator_record_count") or 0),
495	                "grounded_count": int(row.get("indicator_grounded_count") or 0),
496	            },
497	            storage_config=storage_config,
498	        )
499	    return GraphConstructionTuneEvidenceResult(
500	        validation_run_id=validation_run_id,
501	        package_id=package.package_id,
502	        candidate_id=normalized_candidate_id,
503	        split_name=normalized_split_name,
504	        question_count=len(question_scores),
505	    )

allowed_question_ids = _package_question_ids(package_id=normalized_package_id, storage_config=storage_config)\n    normalized_results: list[dict[str, Any]] = []\n    for index, raw in
