{
  "id": "SPI-256",
  "description": "## Context\n\nSPI-255 covers module organisation within `fs10_validation/` and `packages/`. This is the broader, repo-wide version of that question.\n\nThe codebase has grown across many feature sets (FS1–FS12), shared `packages/`, a `core/` layer, a `services/` layer, and a flat `fs10_validation/` package that sits at the top level. Boundaries between these have evolved organically and are no longer obvious from the directory layout.\n\nBefore the porting epic finishes and more code lands, it's worth a pass on whether the top-level shape is right.\n\n## Things to look at\n\n- **Top-level directories** — what's the intended purpose of each of `core/`, `packages/`, `fs10_validation/`, `services/`, `tests/`, `docs/`? Are there clear rules for what goes where, or has it become ad-hoc?\n- **`core/` vs `packages/`** — what's the difference? When porting, deciding which one a new file belongs in is currently a judgement call.\n- **Feature-set code placement** — FS1–FS12 logic is spread across `core/`, `packages/domain/`, `fs10_validation/components/`, and elsewhere. Is there one canonical place per feature set, or is the spread justified by separation of concerns?\n- **Top-level `fs10_validation/`** — why is FS10 the only feature set with its own top-level package? Should it move under `packages/domain/fs10/` to match the others, or is the top-level placement intentional (e.g. because it's a CLI surface)?\n- **`packages/storage/database.py`** — single ~2,600-line file holding every ORM table. Should it be split per feature-set?\n- **Import direction rules** — which packages are allowed to import from which? Are there implicit layering rules (e.g. `core/` can't import from `services/`) that should be made explicit?\n- **Test discoverability** — `tests/` is flat. With ~150+ test files, are naming conventions enough or should the directory mirror the source layout?\n- **`docs/` and `runtime/`** — what lives there, are they referenced by code, do they belong in-repo?\n- **Product vs validation/QC coupling** — the forecasting pipeline (FS1–FS7) and the validation/tuning/QC infrastructure (FS10/FS11) share database tables, evaluators, and runtime entry points. Examples:\n  - `QuestionRow` / `NodeRow` / `RunRow` are written by the product and read by FS10 validation builders.\n  - `evaluate_target_set_integrity` is called both when a user creates a question and when FS10 replays a historical question.\n  - `DefensibilityJudge` runs inside the product runtime, consuming track records that FS10 produces.\n  - `database.py` is monolithic — you cannot ship \"just the product\" without the validation tables.\n  - This is partly deliberate (validation running against the same code as production gives evidence that transfers), but the lack of an explicit interface between the two sides makes the system hard to reason about, hard to test in isolation, and hard to deploy minimally. Investigate whether a narrower, explicitly-typed seam between product and infrastructure is achievable without losing the \"validate against real code\" benefit.\n- **CLI surface — is it actually needed?** FS10 ships operator-facing commands (`fs10-validation-*`, tune CLI, polymarket loaders, etc.) and is partly the reason `fs10_validation/` sits at the top level. Investigate:\n  - Who uses these commands today — engineers, operators, both, neither?\n  - Are they invoked manually, from CI, from cron, from a UI, or only from tests?\n  - Which subcommands are load-bearing vs. left over from earlier development?\n  - Could the same surface be served by a thinner CLI wrapper (e.g. a single entry point that calls into the library) or replaced entirely by direct function calls + a small operator UI?\n  - If the CLI is needed, should it live under `services/cli/` or a similar dedicated package rather than inside `fs10_validation/`?\n  - If most subcommands aren't used, propose a deprecation list and what to do with the underlying functions (keep as library API, remove, or relocate).\n- **`to_dict()` boilerplate — is it the right pattern?** Most dataclasses in the codebase carry a `to_dict()` method that just calls `dataclasses.asdict(self)`. The method exists because dataclasses can't be passed directly to a JSON column or `json.dumps()`. Investigate:\n  - How many dataclasses define `to_dict()` and how many of those are non-trivial (do real reshaping) versus pure `return asdict(self)` shims?\n  - Could a single boundary serializer at the persistence / API edge replace the per-class method (e.g. a helper that detects dataclasses and converts them automatically)?\n  - Are there places in the codebase where data round-trips dataclass → dict → dataclass within one runtime call (instead of crossing a boundary)? Each such round-trip throws away type information for no benefit.\n  - Are there places where a `dict[str, Any]` is being passed around internally that should really be a typed dataclass?\n  - Recommend either: keep `to_dict()` as a convention with a docstring explaining why, or migrate to a single boundary serializer and delete the per-class methods.\n- **Stringly-typed code — replace bare strings with proper types where it matters.** The codebase uses bare strings as identifiers and state values in many places where an enum, Literal type, or dataclass would carry more information and prevent typos. Examples to audit and decide on:\n  - Gate IDs like `\"P-FS1-01\"`, `\"A-FS3-01\"` — currently strings constructed and compared inline. Should there be a `GateId` value object with structured fields (kind: process/analytical, fs: FS1–FS7, index: int)?\n  - Feature-set tags like `\"FS1\"`, `\"FS2\"` — passed as strings to dispatchers (`tune_fs(\"FS2\", ...)`) and stored as strings in `upstream_fs` columns. Should be an enum.\n  - Status values like `\"pass\"`, `\"blocked\"`, `\"sample_runnable\"`, `\"production_lock_ready\"` — string comparisons throughout the gate runner. Easy to mistype and silently fail.\n  - Score families (`\"Research\"`, `\"Driver\"`, `\"Indicator\"`, `\"Graph\"`) — already capitalised consistently but enforced only by convention.\n  - Question types and answer-outcome strings (`\"yes\"`, `\"no\"`, `\"true\"`, `\"1\"`, `\"resolved_true\"`) — currently lots of `.strip().lower()` defensive comparisons. A normalised enum at the boundary would remove the comparisons.\n  - Split names (`\"train\"`, `\"eval\"`) — already a `Literal[\"train\", \"eval\"]`, which is the right idea. Audit which other string fields could become Literals or enums.\n  - String-keyed metadata dicts where the keys are conceptually a fixed enum (e.g. `metadata[\"validation_package_archetype\"]`).\n  - Concrete examples found while porting: `relationship: str` (values `\"direct\"`, `\"guardrail\"`), `promotion_kind: str` (`\"prompt\"`, `\"parameter\"`, `\"policy\"`), and `role: str` on `TuningSurface` are all closed-set fields typed as bare strings.\n  - Anti-pattern marker: any `if str(x or \"\").strip().lower() == \"literal\"` pattern should be flagged — see lookout.md.\n  - For each finding: keep as string (with reason), promote to Literal type, or promote to enum / value-object class. The cost is real (renames ripple through code, DB columns, JSON payloads) so the writeup should rank candidates by how much benefit each conversion would deliver.\n- **Codify Pythonic conventions and audit against them.** A lot of the points above are symptoms of an underlying issue: the codebase doesn't have a written convention for \"how should this project organise code Python-idiomatically?\" Background and recommendation:\n  - **The Python unit is the module, not the class.** Java/C# style (\"one public class per file\") and C++ style (header/source split) don't carry over. A `.py` file is a cohesive set of related code — multiple classes, functions, and constants belonging together is fine and expected.\n  - **Visibility is by naming convention.** `public_name` is public, `_private_name` is internal. Python doesn't have `private` keywords; the underscore prefix is the social contract. `__all__` makes the public surface explicit for libraries.\n  - **`__init__.py` is the package's public API.** Internal submodules can refactor freely as long as `__init__.py` keeps re-exporting the same names.\n  - **Organise by \"what changes together,\" not by \"what's declaration vs implementation.\"** Splitting `tuning_profiles.py` out of `tuning.py` was the right shape because metric values change for completely different reasons than the tuning algorithm. Same principle for other registries / catalogues / seed-data tables.\n  - **Don't fight the language.** Patterns like Java-style getters/setters, C++-style header/source separation, or DI-framework-style abstract base class hierarchies usually waste code in Python without delivering value.\n  - **Actions for the writeup:**\n    - Write a short \"Python conventions for this project\" doc covering: module = cohesion unit, naming for visibility, `__init__.py` as public surface, organise by rate-of-change, dataclasses over `dict[str, Any]`, enums / Literal over bare strings.\n    - Then audit existing patterns against it. Specifically flag places where the codebase looks like Java/C++ thinking carried into Python (one-class-per-file splits, defensive coercion, dict-as-DTO, stringly-typed identifiers).\n    - Decide which conventions to enforce via ruff rules / linters and which are review-time judgement calls.\n- **Dead-code sweep.** Constants, functions, and helper modules that no caller imports anywhere in the repo. Often left behind after refactors or copy-paste from earlier code. Concrete examples found while porting:\n  - `REPO_ROOT` was defined inside `fs10_validation/tuning_surfaces.py` and never imported — removed during PR3a cleanup. Other files that need a repo-root path define their own.\n  - Pattern to audit: any module-level constant or helper function that grep can't find a caller for. Suggest a one-time pass with `vulture` or `ruff --select F401,F841` plus manual grep, then a follow-up cleanup PR. Should also be part of code-review discipline — `lookout.md` already has a \"dead code left behind\" entry.\n- **Typo / inconsistency sweep.** Once a misspelling makes it into a Literal type, enum, or DB column name, every caller is forced to repeat it. Concrete examples:\n  - `\"Paramater Tuning Workflow\"` was baked into the `RunnerType` Literal and every entry using parameter-tuning surfaces — propagated to 5 call sites in `tuning_surfaces.py`. Fixed during PR3a cleanup; nothing outside this file referenced the misspelt string.\n  - Audit candidates: any Literal type, enum, or string-keyed dict with values that look misspelt or inconsistent (e.g. American vs British spelling, \"completed\" vs \"complete\", \"pass\" vs \"passed\").\n  - Worth deciding: enforce a project-wide spelling/glossary check, or rely on review. Renaming a Literal value usually means renaming everywhere it's used as a string, including in DB columns and persisted JSON — costly but cheaper now than later.\n\n## Deliverable\n\nA one-page writeup with:\n\n1. Current state — what the top-level shape is and what the implicit rules appear to be.\n2. Observed inconsistencies — concrete examples where the placement of a file feels arbitrary.\n3. Options — keep-as-is, light cleanup (renames + doc), or restructure (move files).\n4. Recommendation — pick one option with the cost-benefit reasoning.\n5. Migration cost estimate — if a restructure is recommended, how many files would move, how disruptive to in-flight work (porting epic, parallel PRs).\n\nNo code changes in this ticket. Any restructure would be a follow-up ticket scoped from the writeup.\n\n## Out of scope\n\n- Module organisation within `fs10_validation/` and `packages/` — covered by SPI-255.\n- Branch / PR conventions, ticket naming — already documented in CLAUDE.md.\n- Python style conventions (`__all__`, type hints, etc.) — also under SPI-255.\n\n## Related\n\n- SPI-255: Investigate module organisation across fs10_validation and packages/"
}

30	def resolve_real_evidence_mode(live_mode: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> str:
31	    """Resolve the explicit real-evidence mode for FS10 real tuning."""
32	
33	    payload = dict(live_mode or {})
34	    mode = str(payload.get("real_evidence_mode") or "").strip().lower()
35	    if not mode:
36	        mode = REAL_EVIDENCE_MODE_LIVE if bool(payload.get("live_allowed")) else REAL_EVIDENCE_MODE_REPLAY
37	    if mode not in REAL_EVIDENCE_MODES:
38	        raise ValueError(f"real_evidence_mode must be one of replay or live, got {mode!r}")
39	    return mode

42	class RealTuneEvaluator:
43	    """Evaluate tune candidates against persisted validation runs.
44	
45	    The evaluator is intentionally DB-first. It reuses matching validation
46	    evidence when available and invokes ``run_fs10_validation`` only when the
47	    tune spec's live mode explicitly allows live execution.
48	    """

51	        self,
52	        *,
53	        storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig,
54	        runner: Callable[..., dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
55	    ) -> None:
56	        self.storage_config = storage_config

59

61	        key = (spec.fs_id, spec.cohort_id, spec.split_version, candidate.candidate_id, split_name)
62	        cached = self._cache.get(key)
63	        if cached is not None:
64	            return cached
65	
66	        real_evidence_mode = resolve_real_evidence_mode(spec.live_mode)
67	        run = self._find_matching_run(spec=spec, candidate=candidate, split_name=split_name)
68	        if run is None and real_evidence_mode == REAL_EVIDENCE_MODE_LIVE:
69	            run = self._run_missing_evidence(spec=spec, candidate=candidate, split_name=split_name)
70	        if run is None:
71	            raise RealTuneEvidenceMissing(
72	                "real tune evidence is missing for "
73	                f"{spec.fs_id} {candidate.candidate_id!r} {spec.cohort_id}:{spec.split_version}:{split_name}; "
74	                "rerun with --real-evidence-mode live or --live to create DB-backed evidence"
75	            )
76	
77	        payload = self._evaluate_run(spec=spec, candidate=candidate, split_name=split_name, run=run)

282	def _parse_metric_payload(payload: Any, *, default_sample_size: int) -> tuple[dict[str, float], int, list[str]] | None:
283	    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
284	        return None
285	    raw_metrics = payload.get("metrics", payload)
286	    if not isinstance(raw_metrics, dict):
287	        return None
288	    metrics = {
289	        str(key): float(value) for key, value in raw_metrics.items() if isinstance(value, int | float) and key not in {"sample_size"}
290	    }
291	    if not metrics:
292	        return None
293	    sample_size = int(payload.get("sample_size") or default_sample_size or 0)
294	    evidence_ids = [str(item) for item in list(payload.get("evidence_ids") or []) if str(item).strip()]
295	    return metrics, sample_size, evidence_ids

423	def _fs2_scores_from_stage_results(run: StoredValidationRun) -> list[QuestionScore]:
424	    from fs10_validation.runner import _extract_retrieval_diagnostics
425	
426	    scores: list[QuestionScore] = []
427	    for question_id, result in _stage_results_by_question(run).items():
428	        retrieval = _extract_retrieval_diagnostics(result)
429	        has_evidence = bool(retrieval.downloaded_total > 0 or retrieval.provider or retrieval.pack_name or retrieval.status)
430	        if not has_evidence:
431	            continue
432	        scores.append(
433	            QuestionScore(
434	                question_id=question_id,
435	                title=str(result.get("title") or result.get("question_title") or question_id),
436	                qtype=str(result.get("qtype") or result.get("question_type") or "binary"),
437	                correct_answer=str(result.get("correct_answer") or "Yes"),
438	                forecast_probabilities={"Yes": 0.5, "No": 0.5},
439	                brier_score=float(result.get("brier_score") or 0.25),
440	                retrieval=retrieval,
441	                targets=[question_id],
442	            )
443	        )
444	    return scores

451	    candidate: TuneCandidate,
452	    split_name: SplitName,
453	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig,
454	) -> None:

456	        scores = _fs2_scores_from_stage_results(run)
457	    if not scores:
458	        return
459	    from fs10_validation.runner import _extract_retrieval_diagnostics, _fs2_tune_axes, _fs2_tune_source_refs
460	    from packages.domain.qc.research_defensibility_store import persist_fs2_research_defensibility_score
461

466	            retrieval = _extract_retrieval_diagnostics(result)
467	            if retrieval.downloaded_total > 0 or retrieval.provider or retrieval.pack_name or retrieval.status:
468	                score = replace(score, retrieval=retrieval)
469	        persist_fs2_research_defensibility_score(

472	            candidate_id=candidate.candidate_id,
473	            split_name=split_name,
474	            axes=_fs2_tune_axes(question_score=score, candidate_id=candidate.candidate_id),
475	            rationale=("A-FS2 tune evidence scored from live FS2 retrieval diagnostics against a frozen FS10 validation package."),
476	            source_refs=_fs2_tune_source_refs(score),
477	            storage_config=storage_config,

485	    spec: TuneSpec,
486	    split_name: SplitName,
487	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig,

489	    rows = [

541	    artifacts = _component_artifacts(run, upstream_fs="FS3", spec=spec, split_name=split_name, storage_config=storage_config)
542	    by_question: dict[str, list[StoredComponentArtifact]] = {}
543	    for artifact in artifacts:
544	        by_question.setdefault(artifact.question_id, []).append(artifact)
545	    completeness: list[float] = []
546	    grounded_driver_shares: list[float] = []
547	    indicator_observability: list[float] = []
548	    for rows in by_question.values():
549	        driver = next((row for row in rows if row.artifact_kind == "driver_extraction"), None)
550	        indicator = next((row for row in rows if row.artifact_kind == "indicator_extraction"), None)
551	        driver_records = int((driver.payload if driver else {}).get("record_count") or 0)
552	        indicator_records = int((indicator.payload if indicator else {}).get("record_count") or 0)
553	        driver_present = 1.0 if driver_records > 0 else 0.0
554	        indicator_present = 1.0 if indicator_records > 0 else 0.0
555	        completeness.append((driver_present + indicator_present) / 2.0)
556	        if driver is not None and driver_records > 0:
557	            grounded_driver_shares.append(float(driver.payload.get("grounded_count") or 0) / float(driver_records))
558	        if indicator is not None and indicator_records > 0:
559	            indicator_observability.append(float(indicator.payload.get("grounded_count") or 0) / float(indicator_records))
560	    scorecards = _fs11_scorecards_for_run(

566	    indicator_scorecards = [row for row in scorecards if row.score_family == "Indicator"]
567	    graph_scorecards = [row for row in scorecards if row.score_family == "Graph"]
568	    if graph_scorecards:
569	        completeness.extend(float(row.normalised) for row in graph_scorecards)
570	    elif scorecards and not completeness:
571	        completeness.extend(float(row.normalised) for row in scorecards)
572	    grounded_driver_shares.extend(float(row.normalised) for row in driver_scorecards)
573	    indicator_observability.extend(float(row.normalised) for row in indicator_scorecards)
574	    return (

577	            "grounded_driver_share": _mean(grounded_driver_shares),

589	    run: StoredValidationRun,

593	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig,
594	) -> tuple[dict[str, float], int, list[str]]:
595	    scores = _split_scores(run, spec=spec, split_name=split_name, storage_config=storage_config)
596	    artifacts = _component_artifacts(run, upstream_fs="FS4", spec=spec, split_name=split_name, storage_config=storage_config)
597	    ok_rates = [float(row.payload.get("ok_rate") or 0.0) for row in artifacts if row.artifact_kind == "baseline_estimation"]
598	    fallthrough: list[float] = []
599	    for row in artifacts:
600	        records = list(row.payload.get("records") or [])
601	        if records:
602	            failures = sum(1 for item in records if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("outcome") == "failure")
603	            fallthrough.append(failures / float(len(records)))
604	    briers = [float(score.brier_score) for score in scores if score.brier_score >= 0]
605	    return (
606	        {
607	            "prior_brier": _mean(briers, run.mean_brier),
608	            "cascade_fallthrough_rate": _mean(fallthrough),
609	            "estimator_quality": _mean(ok_rates),
610	        },
611	        len(scores) or run.scored_count,
612	        [f"component_artifact:{row.run_id}:{row.question_id}:{row.upstream_fs}:{row.artifact_kind}" for row in artifacts],

616	def _fs5_metrics(
617	    run: StoredValidationRun,
618	    *,
619	    spec: TuneSpec,
620	    split_name: SplitName,
621	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig,
622	) -> tuple[dict[str, float], int, list[str]]:
623	    artifacts = _component_artifacts(run, upstream_fs="FS5", spec=spec, split_name=split_name, storage_config=storage_config)
624	    direction: list[float] = []
625	    calibration: list[float] = []
626	    for row in artifacts:
627	        if row.artifact_kind != "edge_weight_estimation":
628	            continue
629	        records = list(row.payload.get("records") or [])
630	        if not records:
631	            continue
632	        non_review = sum(1 for item in records if isinstance(item, dict) and not bool(item.get("review_required")))
633	        weak = int(row.payload.get("weak_edge_count") or 0)
634	        direction.append(non_review / float(len(records)))
635	        calibration.append(max(0.0, 1.0 - (weak / float(len(records)))))
636	    scorecards = _fs11_scorecards_for_run(
637	        run,
638	        storage_config=storage_config,
639	        score_families={"Graph"},
640	        scorecard_mode="FS5 edge-quality",
641	    )
642	    if scorecards:
643	        direction.extend(float(row.normalised) for row in scorecards)
644	        calibration.extend(float(row.normalised) for row in scorecards)
645	    usefulness = _mean([float(row.normalised) for row in scorecards], max(0.0, 1.0 - float(run.mean_brier)))
646	    return (
647	        {
648	            "reviewed_direction_agreement": _mean(direction),
649	            "weight_calibration": _mean(calibration),
650	            "downstream_usefulness": usefulness,
651	        },
652	        max(len(artifacts), len(scorecards)),
653	        [
654	            *[f"component_artifact:{row.run_id}:{row.question_id}:{row.upstream_fs}:{row.artifact_kind}" for row in artifacts],
655	            *_scorecard_ids(scorecards),
656	        ],

storage_config=storage_config,\n        score_families={\"Driver\", \"Indicator\", \"Graph\"},\n    )\n    driver_scorecards = [row for row in scorecards if row.score_family == \"Driver\"]\n    indicator_scorecards = [row for row in scorecards if row.score_family == \"Indicator\"]\n    graph_scorecards = [row for row in scorecards if row.score_family == \"Graph\"]\n    if graph_scorecards:\n        completeness.extend(float(row.normalised) for row in graph_scorecards)\n    elif scorecards and not completeness:\n        completeness.extend(float(row.normalised) for row in scorecards)\n    grounded_driver_shares.extend(float(row.normalised) for row in driver_scorecards)\n    indicator_observability.extend(float(row.normalised) for row in indicator_scorecards)\n    return (\n        {\n            \"structural_completeness\": _mean(completeness),\n            \"grounded_driver_share\": _mean(grounded_driver_shares),\n            \"indicator_observability\": _mean(indicator_observability),\n        },\n        max(len(by_question), len({row.question_id for row in scorecards})),\n        [\n            *[f\"component_artifact:{row.run_id}:{row.question_id}:{row.upstream_fs}:{row.artifact_kind}\" for row in artifacts],\n            *_scorecard_ids(scorecards),\n        ],\n    )\n\n\ndef _fs4_metrics(\n    run: StoredValidationRun,\n    *,\n    spec: TuneSpec,\n    split_name: SplitName,\n    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig,\n) -> tuple[dict[str, float], int, list[str]]:\n    scores = _split_scores(run, spec=spec, split_name=split_name, storage_config=storage_config)\n    artifacts = _component_artifacts(run, upstream_fs=\"FS4\", spec=spec, split_name=split_name, storage_config=storage_config)\n    ok_rates = [float(row.payload.get(\"ok_rate\") or 0.0) for row in artifacts if row.artifact_kind == \"baseline_estimation\"]\n    fallthrough: list[float] = []\n    for row in artifacts:\n        records = list(row.payload.get(\"records\") or [])\n        if records:\n            failures = sum(1 for item in records if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get(\"outcome\") == \"failure\")\n            fallthrough.append(failures / float(len(records)))\n    briers = [float(score.brier_score) for score in scores if score.brier_score >= 0]\n    return (\n        {\n            \"prior_brier\": _mean(briers, run.mean_brier),\n            \"cascade_fallthrough_rate\": _mean(fallthrough),\n            \"estimator_quality\": _mean(ok_rates),\n        },\n        len(scores) or run.scored_count,\n        [f\"component_artifact:{row.run_id}:{row.question_id}:{row.upstream_fs}:{row.artifact_kind}\" for row in artifacts],\n    )\n\n\ndef _fs5_metrics(\n    run: StoredValidationRun,\n    *,\n    spec: TuneSpec,\n    split_name: SplitName,\n    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig,\n) -> tuple[dict[str, float], int, list[str]]:\n    artifacts = _component_artifacts(run, upstream_fs=\"FS5\", spec=spec, split_name=split_name, storage_config=storage_config)\n    direction: list[float] = []\n    calibration: list[float] = []\n    for row in artifacts:\n        if row.artifact_kind != \"edge_weight_estimation\":\n            continue\n        records = list(row.payload.get(\"records\") or [])\n        if not records:\n            continue\n        non_review = sum(1 for item in records if isinstance(item, dict) and not bool(item.get(\"review_required\")))\n        weak = int(row.payload.get(\"weak_edge_count\") or 0)\n        direction.append(non_review / float(len(records)))\n        calibration.append(max(0.0, 1.0 - (weak / float(len(records)))))\n    scorecards = _fs11_scorecards_for_run(\n        run,\n        storage_config=storage_config,\n        score_families={\"Graph\"},\n        scorecard_mode=\"FS5 edge-quality\",\n    )\n    if scorecards:\n        direction.extend(float(row.normalised) for row in scorecards)\n        calibration.extend(float(row.normalised) for row in scorecards)\n    usefulness = _mean([float(row.normalised) for row in scorecards], max(0.0, 1.0 - float(run.mean_brier)))\n    return (\n        {\n            \"reviewed_direction_agreement\": _mean(direction),\n            \"weight_calibration\": _mean(calibration),\n            \"downstream_usefulness\": usefulness,\n       *_scorecard_ids(scorecards),\n        ],\n    )\n\n\n__all__ = [\n    \"REAL_EVALUATOR_NAME\",\n    \"REAL_EVIDENCE_MODE_LIVE\",\n    \"REAL_EVIDENCE_MODE_REPLAY\",\n 219	    *,
220	    tune_run_id: str,
221	    candidate_id: str,
222	    split: str,
223	    metric_id: str,
224	    direction: str,
225	    signal_scope: str,
226	    raw_value: float | None = None,
227	    comparable_value: float | None = None,
228	    question_id: str | None = None,
229	    case_ref: str | None = None,
230	    scorer_ref: str | None = None,
231	    scorecard_id: str | None = None,
232	    guardrail: bool = False,
233	    hard_fail: bool = False,
234	    details: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
235	    signal_snapshot_id: str | None = None,
236	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig | None = None,
237	) -> StoredTuneSignalSnapshot:
238	    database = _ensure_database(storage_config)
239	    normalized_id = _clean_optional(signal_snapshot_id) or f"signal_{uuid4().hex[:16]}"
240	    with database.session_scope() as session:
241	        if session.get(FS10SignalSnapshotRow, normalized_id) is not None:
242	            raise ValueError(f"signal snapshot already exists: {normalized_id!r}")
243	        if (
244	            session.get(
245	                FS10TuneCandidateRow,
246	                {
247	                    "tune_run_id": _clean_required(tune_run_id, field_name="tune_run_id"),
248	                    "candidate_id": _clean_required(candidate_id, field_name="candidate_id"),
249	                },
250	            )
251	            is None
252	        ):
253	            raise ValueError("tune signal snapshots require an existing tune candidate")
254	        row = FS10SignalSnapshotRow(
255	            signal_snapshot_id=normalized_id,
256	            tune_run_id=_clean_required(tune_run_id, field_name="tune_run_id"),
257	            candidate_id=_clean_required(candidate_id, field_name="candidate_id"),
258	            split=_clean_required(split, field_name="split"),
259	            question_id=_clean_optional(question_id) or None,
260	            case_ref=_clean_optional(case_ref) or None,
261	            metric_id=_clean_required(metric_id, field_name="metric_id"),
262	            raw_value=float(raw_value) if raw_value is not None else None,
263	            comparable_value=float(comparable_value) if comparable_value is not None else None,
264	            direction=_clean_required(direction, field_name="direction"),
265	            signal_scope=_clean_required(signal_scope, field_name="signal_scope"),
266	            scorer_ref=_clean_optional(scorer_ref) or None,
267	            scorecard_id=_clean_optional(scorecard_id) or None,
268	            guardrail=bool(guardrail),
269	            hard_fail=bool(hard_fail),
270	            details_json=dict(details or {}),
271	            created_at=utc_now(),
272	        )
273	        session.add(row)
274	    stored = load_tune_signal_snapshot(signal_snapshot_id=normalized_id, storage_config=storage_config)
275	    assert stored is not None
276	    return stored

551	def record_metric_snapshots_as_signals(
552	    *,
553	    tune_run_id: str,
554	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig | None = None,
555	) -> list[StoredTuneSignalSnapshot]:
556	    """Mirror aggregate tune metrics into per-metric signal rows."""
557	
558	    from fs10_validation.tuning_store import load_tune_run
559	
560	    stored = load_tune_run(tune_run_id=tune_run_id, storage_config=storage_config)
561	    if stored is None:
562	        raise ValueError(f"unknown tune_run_id: {tune_run_id!r}")
563	    direction = _direction(stored.metric_goal)
564	    signals: list[StoredTuneSignalSnapshot] = []
565	    for snapshot in stored.metric_snapshots:
566	        for metric_id, value in dict(snapshot["metrics"]).items():
567	            signals.append(
568	                record_tune_signal_snapshot(
569	                    tune_run_id=stored.tune_run_id,
570	                    candidate_id=str(snapshot["candidate_id"]),
571	                    split=str(snapshot["split_name"]),
572	                    metric_id=str(metric_id),
573	                    raw_value=float(value),
574	                    comparable_value=float(value),
575	                    direction=direction,
576	                    signal_scope="global" if metric_id == stored.primary_metric else "diagnostic",
577	                    details={"source": "fs10_tune_metric_snapshots"},
578	                    storage_config=storage_config,
579	                )
580	            )
581	    return signals

{
  "command": "gh pr create --draft --base dev --title \"SPI-230 PR3b: Port FS10 tuning machinery (real evaluator + authority)\" --body \"$(cat <<'EOF'\n@kungfusaini\n\nLinear: SPI-230\n\n## What this is\n\nContinues the SPI-230 port from `dev_sprint` to `dev`. This PR brings across the two pieces of FS10 tuning machinery that the prior PRs left on the other side: the DB-backed real-evidence evaluator that runs analytical tunes against persisted validation runs, and the FS10 tuning authority that records the signals, batch scores, prompt surfaces, and prompt edit/head events produced by the tuning loop.\n\nTogether with PR3a (foundations), this gives `dev` the full surface needed to run and persist FS10 tuning, except for the orchestrator entry-point (held for PR4 because it depends on PR4-scope modules).\n\nIt also tidies a temporary fixup from PR2d: `REAL_EVALUATOR_NAME` was inlined in `graph_construction.py` to avoid a forward dependency, and this PR moves it back to its canonical home in `real_tune_evaluator.py`.\n\n## Technical detail\n\n### Summary\n\n- New: `fs10_validation/real_tune_evaluator.py` — `RealTuneEvaluator`, `RealTuneEvidenceMissing`, `resolve_real_evidence_mode`, and the FS2/FS3/FS4/FS5 metric extractors.\n- New: `fs10_validation/tuning_authority.py` — `record_tune_signal_snapshot`, `record_candidate_batch_score`, `upsert_prompt_surface`, `record_prompt_edit_decision`, `record_prompt_head_event`, `record_metric_snapshots_as_signals`, and the five corresponding stored dataclasses.\n- Modified: `fs10_validation/graph_construction.py` — removes the temporary inline `REAL_EVALUATOR_NAME` and re-imports it from `real_tune_evaluator`.\n- New: `tests/test_fs10_tuning_machinery.py` — round-trip coverage for both modules.\n\n### Approach\n\n- The real evaluator's call into `run_fs10_validation` uses a function-scoped (deferred) import because `runner.py` is PR4 scope. Module import stays clean; the deferred import only fires when a `TuneSpec` opts into live-evidence mode.\n- The runner call is routed through a `dict[str, Any]` kwargs map. `storage_config` and `validation_context` were added to the runner signature on `dev_sprint` as part of the tuning work; on `dev` the runner does not yet accept them. The kwargs-dict shape keeps mypy quiet on `dev` and matches the runner that PR4 will land.\n- During port, the snapshot row class was renamed `FS10SignalSnapshotRow` → `FS10TuneSignalSnapshotRow` to match the PR1-era schema on `dev`. > AGENT

Not empty — it has a docstring, which is the body. The class inherits everything it needs from `ValueError`.

```python
class RealTuneEvidenceMissing(ValueError):
    """Raised when a real tune evaluation has no DB-backed evidence."""
```

This is Python's idiom for a **custom exception type**. It exists purely so callers can distinguish *this* failure from any other `ValueError`:

```python
try:
    evaluator.evaluate(...)
except RealTuneEvidenceMissing:
    # specifically the "no evidence in DB" case → maybe skip the candidate
except ValueError:
    # any other bad-value error
```

If you raised plain `ValueError("no evidence")` you'd have to string-match the message to tell cases apart, which is fragile. A named subclass makes the failure mode part of the type system.

The docstring is required structurally — a Python class body can't be literally empty. Without the docstring you'd need `pass`:

```python
class RealTuneEvidenceMissing(ValueError):
    pass
```

The docstring does double duty: satisfies the syntax requirement *and* documents what the exception means. That's why you see this exact pattern all over Python codebases.

> AGENT

Yes — it's too large, and it violates the "one file, one concern" rule we put in `lookout.md`. There are four separable concerns mashed together:

1. **Evaluator entry-point** (lines 26-211, ~185): `RealTuneEvidenceMissing`, `resolve_real_evidence_mode`, `RealTuneEvaluator` itself.
2. **Generic evidence/run-matching helpers** (lines 213-330, ~120): `_tune_context`, `_context_matches`, `_run_matches_model_set`, `_explicit_metrics`, `_parse_metric_payload`, `_split_scores`, `_mean`.
3. **FS2 metric extractor + its helpers** (lines 332-540, ~210): stage-result reconstruction, scorecard reach, artifact persistence. This block alone has its own internal substructure and is the heaviest piece.
4. **FS3/FS4/FS5 metric extractors** (lines 541-676, ~135): three smaller per-FS extractors.

A natural split:

- `real_tune_evaluator.py` — only the entry-point class and exception.
- `real_tune_run_lookup.py` — generic run-matching + metric-payload helpers.
- `real_tune_metrics_fs2.py` — the FS2 bundle (it earns its own file).
- `real_tune_metrics.py` — FS3/FS4/FS5 (small enough to share).

That said: this is a **faithful port** of `dev_sprint` and the rule we've been holding is *port-as-is, refactor separately*. Same shape as `tuning_surfaces.py` last session — I flagged the smells, you added them to SPI-256 rather than fixing in the port PR.

**Recommended move:** keep PR3b as-is (already pushed), add this split to SPI-256 as a known refactor item. Want me to add it?

190	        elif spec.fs_id == "FS3":
191	            metrics, sample_size, evidence_ids = _fs3_metrics(run, spec=spec, split_name=split_name, storage_config=self.storage_config)
192	        elif spec.fs_id == "FS4":
193	            metrics, sample_size, evidence_ids = _fs4_metrics(run, spec=spec, split_name=split_name, storage_config=self.storage_config)
194	        elif spec.fs_id == "FS5":
195	            metrics, sample_size, evidence_ids = _fs5_metrics(run, spec=spec, split_name=split_name, storage_config=self.storage_config)
196	        else:
197	            raise ValueError(f"real evaluator is only implemented for FS2-FS5, got {spec.fs_id!r}")
198	
199	        if spec.primary_metric not in metrics:
200	            raise ValueError(f"real evaluator did not produce primary metric {spec.primary_metric!r}")
201	        if sample_size <= 0:
202	            raise RealTuneEvidenceMissing(
203	                f"real tune evidence for {spec.fs_id} {candidate.candidate_id!r} {split_name!r} has sample_size=0; "
204	                "expected persisted validation runs, component artifacts, metric snapshots, or FS11 scorecards"
205	            )
206	        return {
207	            "metrics": metrics,
208	            "sample_size": sample_size,
209	            "evidence_ids": [f"validation_run:{run.run_id}", *evidence_ids],
210	        }

213	def _tune_context(run: StoredValidationRun) -> dict[str, Any]:
214	    stage_b = dict(run.stage_b or {})
215	    context = stage_b.get("tune_context") or stage_b.get("validation_context") or {}
216	    return dict(context) if isinstance(context, dict) else {}

219	def _context_matches(
220	    context: dict[str, Any],
221	    *,
222	    spec: TuneSpec,
223	    candidate: TuneCandidate,
224	    split_name: SplitName,
225	) -> bool:
226	    matches = (
227	        str(context.get("evaluator") or "") == REAL_EVALUATOR_NAME
228	        and str(context.get("fs_id") or "") == spec.fs_id
229	        and str(context.get("cohort_id") or "") == spec.cohort_id
230	        and str(context.get("split_version") or "") == spec.split_version
231	        and str(context.get("split_name") or "") == split_name
232	        and str(context.get("candidate_id") or "") == candidate.candidate_id
233	    )
234	    if not matches:
235	        return False
236	    if bool(spec.live_mode.get("live_allowed")) and candidate.candidate_id != spec.baseline_candidate_id:
237	        return context.get("candidate_parameters") == dict(candidate.parameters)
238	    return True

241	def _run_matches_model_set(run: StoredValidationRun, *, spec: TuneSpec) -> bool:
242	    expected = str(spec.live_mode.get("model_set") or "").strip()
243	    if not expected:
244	        return True
245	    summary = dict((dict(run.stage_b or {}).get("pipeline_result") or {}).get("summary") or {})
246	    llm_config = dict(summary.get("llm_config") or {})
247	    actual = str(llm_config.get("model_set") or "").strip()
248	    return not actual or actual == expected

251	def _explicit_metrics(
252	    run: StoredValidationRun,
253	    *,
254	    fs_id: str,
255	    candidate_id: str,
256	    split_name: SplitName,
257	) -> tuple[dict[str, float], int, list[str]] | None:
258	    raw = dict(run.stage_b or {}).get("analytical_metrics")
259	    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
260	        return None
261	
262	    candidates = raw.get("candidates")
263	    if isinstance(candidates, dict):
264	        candidate_payload = candidates.get(candidate_id)
265	        if isinstance(candidate_payload, dict):
266	            split_payload = candidate_payload.get(split_name, candidate_payload)
267	            parsed = _parse_metric_payload(split_payload, default_sample_size=run.scored_count)
268	            if parsed is not None:
269	                return parsed
270	
271	    fs_payload = raw.get(fs_id, raw)
272	    if isinstance(fs_payload, dict):
273	        candidate_payload = fs_payload.get(candidate_id)
274	        if isinstance(candidate_payload, dict):
275	            split_payload = candidate_payload.get(split_name, candidate_payload)
276	            parsed = _parse_metric_payload(split_payload, default_sample_size=run.scored_count)
277	            if parsed is not None:
278	                return parsed
279	        split_payload = fs_payload.get(split_name, fs_payload)
280	        parsed = _parse_metric_payload(split_payload, default_sample_size=run.scored_count)
281	        if parsed is not None:
282	            return parsed
283	    return None

285	
286	def _parse_metric_payload(payload: Any, *, default_sample_size: int) -> tuple[dict[str, float], int, list[str]] | None:
287	    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
288	        return None
289	    raw_metrics = payload.get("metrics", payload)
290	    if not isinstance(raw_metrics, dict):
291	        return None
292	    metrics = {
293	        str(key): float(value) for key, value in raw_metrics.items() if isinstance(value, int | float) and key not in {"sample_size"}
294	    }
295	    if not metrics:
296	        return None
297	    sample_size = int(payload.get("sample_size") or default_sample_size or 0)
298	    evidence_ids = [str(item) for item in (payload.get("evidence_ids") or []) if str(item).strip()]
299	    return metrics, sample_size, evidence_ids

332	def _fs2_metrics(
333	    run: StoredValidationRun,
334	    *,
335	    spec: TuneSpec,
336	    candidate: TuneCandidate,
337	    split_name: SplitName,
338	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig,
339	) -> tuple[dict[str, float], int, list[str]]:
340	    artifacts = _component_artifacts(run, upstream_fs="FS2", spec=spec, split_name=split_name, storage_config=storage_config)
341	    expected_kind = f"research_defensibility:{split_name}:{candidate.candidate_id}"
342	    research_artifacts = [row for row in artifacts if row.artifact_kind == expected_kind]
343	    rows = _split_scores(run, spec=spec, split_name=split_name, storage_config=storage_config)
344	    if len(research_artifacts) < len(rows) or not _fs2_research_artifacts_have_signal(research_artifacts):
345	        _persist_fs2_tune_artifacts_from_stage(
346	            run=run,
347	            scores=rows,
348	            candidate=candidate,
349	            split_name=split_name,
350	            storage_config=storage_config,
351	        )
352	        artifacts = _component_artifacts(run, upstream_fs="FS2", spec=spec, split_name=split_name, storage_config=storage_config)
353	        research_artifacts = [row for row in artifacts if row.artifact_kind == expected_kind]
354	    if not research_artifacts:
355	        research_artifacts = [row for row in artifacts if row.artifact_kind.startswith("research_defensibility")]
356	    research_payloads = [row.payload for row in research_artifacts]
357	    if research_payloads:
358	        metrics = aggregate_research_defensibility_payloads(research_payloads)
359	        return (
360	            metrics,
361	            len(research_payloads),
362	            [f"component_artifact:{row.run_id}:{row.question_id}:{row.upstream_fs}:{row.artifact_kind}" for row in research_artifacts],
363	        )
364	
365	    if spec.primary_metric == "research_defensibility":
366	        stage_scores = _fs2_scores_from_stage_results(run)
367	        raise RealTuneEvidenceMissing(
368	            "FS2 research_defensibility evidence missing for "
369	            f"run_id={run.run_id!r}, candidate_id={candidate.candidate_id!r}, split_name={split_name!r}; "
370	            f"expected artifact_kind={expected_kind!r}; "
371	            f"question_scores={len(rows or run.question_scores)}, stage_results={len(_stage_results_by_question(run))}, "
372	            f"usable_retrieval_stage_results={len(stage_scores)}"
373	        )
374	
375	    rows = rows or run.question_scores
376	    precisions: list[float] = []
377	    freshness: list[float] = []
378	    diversity: list[float] = []
379	    packs: set[str] = set()
380	    for score in rows:
381	        retrieval = score.retrieval
382	        ok = retrieval.status.lower() in {"ok", "pass", "passed", "completed", "valid"} and not retrieval.errors
383	        precisions.append(1.0 if ok and retrieval.downloaded_total > 0 else 0.0)
384	        freshness.append(min(float(retrieval.downloaded_total) / 3.0, 1.0) if ok else 0.0)
385	        if retrieval.pack_name:
386	            packs.add(retrieval.pack_name)
387	        diversity.append(1.0 if retrieval.provider and retrieval.pack_name else 0.5 if retrieval.provider or retrieval.pack_name else 0.0)
388	    if len(packs) > 1 and diversity:
389	        diversity = [min(1.0, value + 0.1) for value in diversity]
390	    return (
391	        {
392	            "evidence_relevance_precision_at_k": _mean(precisions),
393	            "freshness_adequacy": _mean(freshness),
394	            "diversity_score": _mean(diversity),
395	        },
396	        len(rows),
397	        [],
398	    )
399

401	def _fs2_research_artifacts_have_signal(artifacts: list[StoredComponentArtifact]) -> bool:
402	    if not artifacts:
403	        return False
404	    for row in artifacts:
405	        payload = row.payload if isinstance(row.payload, dict) else {}
406	        score = payload.get("score") if isinstance(payload.get("score"), dict) else {}
407	        if float(score.get("normalised") or 0.0) > 0.0:
408	            return True
409	        for ref in payload.get("source_refs") or []:
410	            if not isinstance(ref, dict):
411	                continue
412	            if int(ref.get("downloaded_total") or 0) > 0 or str(ref.get("artifact_id") or "").strip():
413	                return True
414	    return False

417	def _stage_results_by_question(run: StoredValidationRun) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
418	    pipeline_result = dict(dict(run.stage_b or {}).get("pipeline_result") or {})
419	    results = pipeline_result.get("results") if isinstance(pipeline_result.get("results"), list) else []
420	    return {
421	        str(row.get("question_id") or "").strip(): dict(row)
422	        for row in results
423	        if isinstance(row, dict) and str(row.get("question_id") or "").strip()
424	    }

427	def _fs2_scores_from_stage_results(run: StoredValidationRun) -> list[QuestionScore]:
428	    # Deferred import: runner.py is PR4 scope. Only fires when the FS2
429	    # evaluator needs to reconstruct scores from stage results.
430	    from fs10_validation.runner import _extract_retrieval_diagnostics
431	
432	    scores: list[QuestionScore] = []
433	    for question_id, result in _stage_results_by_question(run).items():
434	        retrieval = _extract_retrieval_diagnostics(result)
435	        has_evidence = bool(retrieval.downloaded_total > 0 or retrieval.provider or retrieval.pack_name or retrieval.status)
436	        if not has_evidence:
437	            continue
438	        scores.append(
439	            QuestionScore(
440	                question_id=question_id,
441	                title=str(result.get("title") or result.get("question_title") or question_id),
442	                qtype=str(result.get("qtype") or result.get("question_type") or "binary"),
443	                correct_answer=str(result.get("correct_answer") or "Yes"),
444	                forecast_probabilities={"Yes": 0.5, "No": 0.5},
445	                brier_score=float(result.get("brier_score") or 0.25),
446	                retrieval=retrieval,
447	                targets=[question_id],
448	            )
449	        )
450	    return scores

453	def _persist_fs2_tune_artifacts_from_stage(
454	    *,
455	    run: StoredValidationRun,
456	    scores: list[Any],
457	    candidate: TuneCandidate,
458	    split_name: SplitName,
459	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig,
460	) -> None:
461	    if not scores:
462	        scores = _fs2_scores_from_stage_results(run)
463	    if not scores:
464	        return
465	    # Deferred import: runner.py is PR4 scope.
466	    from fs10_validation.runner import _extract_retrieval_diagnostics, _fs2_tune_axes, _fs2_tune_source_refs
467	    from packages.domain.qc.research_defensibility_store import persist_fs2_research_defensibility_score
468	
469	    stage_results = _stage_results_by_question(run)
470	    for score in scores:
471	        result = stage_results.get(str(score.question_id))
472	        if result is not None:
473	            retrieval = _extract_retrieval_diagnostics(result)
474	            if retrieval.downloaded_total > 0 or retrieval.provider or retrieval.pack_name or retrieval.status:
475	                score = replace(score, retrieval=retrieval)
476	        persist_fs2_research_defensibility_score(
477	            validation_run_id=run.run_id,
478	            question_id=str(score.question_id),
479	            candidate_id=candidate.candidate_id,
480	            split_name=split_name,
481	            axes=_fs2_tune_axes(question_score=score, candidate_id=candidate.candidate_id),
482	            rationale=("A-FS2 tune evidence scored from live FS2 retrieval diagnostics against a frozen FS10 validation package."),
483	            source_refs=_fs2_tune_source_refs(score),
484	            storage_config=storage_config,
485	        )

488	def _component_artifacts(
489	    run: StoredValidationRun,

492	    spec: TuneSpec,
493	    split_name: SplitName,
494	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig,
495	) -> list[StoredComponentArtifact]:

497	        row for row in list_component_artifacts_for_run(run_id=run.run_id, storage_config=storage_config) if row.upstream_fs == upstream_fs
498	    ]
499	    if _run_is_split_scoped(run, split_name):
500	        return rows
501	    return [
502	        row for row in rows if assign_split(row.question_id, split_version=spec.split_version, storage_config=storage_config) == split_name
503	    ]

506	def _scorecard_question_ids(run: StoredValidationRun) -> list[str]:
507	    question_ids = [score.question_id for score in run.question_scores if score.question_id.strip()]
508	    for question_id in _stage_results_by_question(run):
509	        if question_id not in question_ids:
510	            question_ids.append(question_id)
511	    return question_ids

514	def _fs11_scorecards_for_run(
515	    run: StoredValidationRun,
516	    *,
517	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig,
518	    score_families: set[str] | None = None,
519	    scorecard_mode: str | None = None,
520	) -> list[Any]:
521	    from packages.domain.qc.store import list_question_scorecards
522	
523	    rows: list[Any] = []
524	    for question_id in _scorecard_question_ids(run):
525	        for scorecard in list_question_scorecards(run_id=run.run_id, question_id=question_id, storage_config=storage_config):
526	            if score_families is not None and scorecard.score_family not in score_families:
527	                continue
528	            if scorecard_mode is not None and scorecard.scorecard_mode != scorecard_mode:
529	                continue
530	            rows.append(scorecard)
531	    return rows
532	
533	
534	def _scorecard_ids(scorecards: list[Any]) -> list[str]:
535	    return [
536	        f"fs11_scorecard:{row.run_id}:{row.question_id}:{row.node_id}:{row.score_family}:{row.scorecard_mode or 'default'}"
537	        for row in scorecards
538	    ]

540	
541	def _fs3_metrics(
542	    run: StoredValidationRun,
543	    *,
544	    spec: TuneSpec,
545	    split_name: SplitName,
546	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig,
547	) -> tuple[dict[str, float], int, list[str]]:
548	    artifacts = _component_artifacts(run, upstream_fs="FS3", spec=spec, split_name=split_name, storage_config=storage_config)
549	    by_question: dict[str, list[StoredComponentArtifact]] = {}
550	    for artifact in artifacts:
551	        by_question.setdefault(artifact.question_id, []).append(artifact)
552	    completeness: list[float] = []
553	    grounded_driver_shares: list[float] = []
554	    indicator_observability: list[float] = []
555	    for rows in by_question.values():
556	        driver = next((row for row in rows if row.artifact_kind == "driver_extraction"), None)
557	        indicator = next((row for row in rows if row.artifact_kind == "indicator_extraction"), None)
558	        driver_records = int((driver.payload if driver else {}).get("record_count") or 0)
559	        indicator_records = int((indicator.payload if indicator else {}).get("record_count") or 0)
560	        driver_present = 1.0 if driver_records > 0 else 0.0
561	        indicator_present = 1.0 if indicator_records > 0 else 0.0
562	        completeness.append((driver_present + indicator_present) / 2.0)
563	        if driver is not None and driver_records > 0:
564	            grounded_driver_shares.append(float(driver.payload.get("grounded_count") or 0) / float(driver_records))
565	        if indicator is not None and indicator_records > 0:
566	            indicator_observability.append(float(indicator.payload.get("grounded_count") or 0) / float(indicator_records))
567	    scorecards = _fs11_scorecards_for_run(
568	        run,
569	        storage_config=storage_config,
570	        score_families={"Driver", "Indicator", "Graph"},
571	    )
572	    driver_scorecards = [row for row in scorecards if row.score_family == "Driver"]
573	    indicator_scorecards = [row for row in scorecards if row.score_family == "Indicator"]
574	    graph_scorecards = [row for row in scorecards if row.score_family == "Graph"]
575	    if graph_scorecards:
576	        completeness.extend(float(row.normalised) for row in graph_scorecards)
577	    elif scorecards and not completeness:
578	        completeness.extend(float(row.normalised) for row in scorecards)
579	    grounded_driver_shares.extend(float(row.normalised) for row in driver_scorecards)
580	    indicator_observability.extend(float(row.normalised) for row in indicator_scorecards)
581	    return (
582	        {
583	            "structural_completeness": _mean(completeness),
584	            "grounded_driver_share": _mean(grounded_driver_shares),
585	            "indicator_observability": _mean(indicator_observability),
586	        },
587	        max(len(by_question), len({row.question_id for row in scorecards})),
588	        [
589	            *[f"component_artifact:{row.run_id}:{row.question_id}:{row.upstream_fs}:{row.artifact_kind}" for row in artifacts],
590	            *_scorecard_ids(scorecards),
591	        ],
592	    )
593	
594	
595	def _fs4_metrics(
596	    run: StoredValidationRun,
597	    *,
598	    spec: TuneSpec,
599	    split_name: SplitName,
600	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig,
601	) -> tuple[dict[str, float], int, list[str]]:
602	    scores = _split_scores(run, spec=spec, split_name=split_name, storage_config=storage_config)
603	    artifacts = _component_artifacts(run, upstream_fs="FS4", spec=spec, split_name=split_name, storage_config=storage_config)
604	    ok_rates = [float(row.payload.get("ok_rate") or 0.0) for row in artifacts if row.artifact_kind == "baseline_estimation"]
605	    fallthrough: list[float] = []
606	    for row in artifacts:
607	        records = list(row.payload.get("records") or [])
608	        if records:
609	            failures = sum(1 for item in records if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("outcome") == "failure")
610	            fallthrough.append(failures / float(len(records)))
611	    briers = [float(score.brier_score) for score in scores if score.brier_score >= 0]
612	    return (
613	        {
614	            "prior_brier": _mean(briers, run.mean_brier),
615	            "cascade_fallthrough_rate": _mean(fallthrough),
616	            "estimator_quality": _mean(ok_rates),
617	        },
618	        len(scores) or run.scored_count,
619	        [f"component_artifact:{row.run_id}:{row.question_id}:{row.upstream_fs}:{row.artifact_kind}" for row in artifacts],
620	    )
621	
622	
623	def _fs5_metrics(
624	    run: StoredValidationRun,
625	    *,
626	    spec: TuneSpec,
627	    split_name: SplitName,
628	    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig,
629	) -> tuple[dict[str, float], int, list[str]]:
630	    artifacts = _component_artifacts(run, upstream_fs="FS5", spec=spec, split_name=split_name, storage_config=storage_config)
631	    direction: list[float] = []
632	    calibration: list[float] = []
633	    for row in artifacts:
634	        if row.artifact_kind != "edge_weight_estimation":
635	            continue
636	        records = list(row.payload.get("records") or [])
637	        if not records:
638	            continue
639	        non_review = sum(1 for item in records if isinstance(item, dict) and not bool(item.get("review_required")))
640	        weak = int(row.payload.get("weak_edge_count") or 0)
641	        direction.append(non_review / float(len(records)))
642	        calibration.append(max(0.0, 1.0 - (weak / float(len(records)))))
643	    scorecards = _fs11_scorecards_for_run(
644	        run,
645	        storage_config=storage_config,
646	        score_families={"Graph"},
647	        scorecard_mode="FS5 edge-quality",
648	    )
649	    if scorecards:
650	        direction.extend(float(row.normalised) for row in scorecards)
651	        calibration.extend(float(row.normalised) for row in scorecards)
652	    usefulness = _mean([float(row.normalised) for row in scorecards], max(0.0, 1.0 - float(run.mean_brier)))
653	    return (
654	        {
655	            "reviewed_direction_agreement": _mean(direction),
656	            "weight_calibration": _mean(calibration),
657	            "downstream_usefulness": usefulness,
658	        },
659	        max(len(artifacts), len(scorecards)),
660	        [
661	            *[f"component_artifact:{row.run_id}:{row.question_id}:{row.upstream_fs}:{row.artifact_kind}" for row in artifacts],
662	            *_scorecard_ids(scorecards),
663	        ],
664	    )
665

676	]

> DEVELOPER

hate that natmin with them all having the same real_tune st the start

> AGENT

Fair — the `real_tune_` prefix is redundant noise when they all live in `fs10_validation/` anyway. Better Python convention: a subpackage where the directory provides the context once.

```
fs10_validation/real_tune/
  __init__.py        # re-exports the public surface
  evaluator.py       # RealTuneEvaluator, RealTuneEvidenceMissing, resolve_real_evidence_mode
  run_lookup.py      # _tune_context, _context_matches, _run_matches_model_set, _explicit_metrics, _parse_metric_payload, _split_scores, _mean
  metrics_fs2.py     # the FS2 bundle
  metrics.py         # FS3, FS4, FS5 extractors
```

return None\n    raw_metrics = payload.get(\"metrics\", payload)\n    if not isinstance(raw_metrics, dict):\n        return None\n    metrics = {\n        str(key): float(value) for key, value in split_scores(\n    run: StoredValidationRun,\n    *,\n    spec: TuneSpec,\n    split_name: SplitName,\n    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig,\n) -> list[Any]:\n    if run_is_split_scoped(run, return rows\n    return [\n        row for row in rows if assign_split(row.question_id, split_version=spec.split_version, storage_config=storage_config) == split_name\n    ]\n\n\ndef stage_results_by_question(run):\n        if question_id not in question_ids:\n            question_ids.append(question_id)\n    return question_ids\n\n\ndef fs11_scorecards_for_run(\n    run: StoredValidationRun,\n    *,\n    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig,\n    score_families: set[str] | None = None,\n    scorecard_mode: str | None = None,\n) -> list[Any]:\n    from packages.domain.qc.store import list_question_scorecards\n\n    rows: list[Any] = []\n    for question_id in scorecard_question_ids(run):\n        for scorecard in list_question_scorecards(run_id=run.run_id, question_id=question_id, storage_config=storage_config):\n            if score_families is not None and scorecard.score_family not in score_families:\n                continue\n            if scorecard_mode is not None and scorecard.scorecard_mode != scorecard_mode:\n                continue\n            rows.append(scorecard)\n    return rows\n\n\ndef Only fires when the FS2\n    # evaluator needs to reconstruct scores from stage results.\n    from fs10_validation.runner import _extract_retrieval_diagnostics\n\n    scores: list[QuestionScore] = []\n    for question_id, result in stage_results_by_question(run).items():\n        retrieval = _extract_retrieval_diagnostics(result)\n        has_evidence = bool(retrieval.downloaded_total > 0 or retrieval.provider or retrieval.pack_name or retrieval.status)\n        if not has_evidence:\n            continue\n        scores.append(\n            QuestionScore(\n                question_id=question_id,\n                title=str(result.get(\"title\") or result.get(\"question_title\") or question_id),\n                qtype=str(result.get(\"qtype\") or result.get(\"question_type\") or \"binary\"),\n                correct_answer=str(result.get(\"correct_answer\") or \"Yes\"),\n                forecast_probabilities={\"Yes\": 0.5, \"No\": 0.5},\n                brier_score=float(result.get(\"brier_score\") or 0.25),\n                retrieval=retrieval,\n                targets=[question_id],\n            )\n        )\n    return scores\n\n\ndef _persist_tune_artifacts_from_stage(\n    *,\n    run: StoredValidationRun,\n    scores: list[Any],\n    candidate: TuneCandidate,\n    split_name: SplitName,\n    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig,\n) -> None:\n    if not scores:\n        scores = _scores_from_stage_results(run)\n    if not scores:\n        return\n    #  run: StoredValidationRun,\n    *,\n    spec: TuneSpec,\n    split_name: SplitName,\n    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig,\n) -> tuple[dict[str, float], int, list[str]]:\n    artifacts = grounded_driver_shares.extend(float(row.normalised) for row in driver_scorecards)\n    indicator_observability.extend(float(row.normalised) for row in indicator_scorecards)\n    return (\n        {\n            \"structural_completeness\": mean(completeness),\n            \"grounded_driver_share\": mean(grounded_driver_shares),\n            \"indicator_observability\": item.get(\"outcome\") == \"failure\")\n            fallthrough.append(failures / float(len(records)))\n    briers = [float(score.brier_score) for score in scores if score.brier_score >= 0]\n    return (\n        {\n            \"prior_brier\": mean(briers, run.mean_brier),\n            \"cascade_fallthrough_rate\": mean(fallthrough),\n            \"estimator_quality\": mean(ok_rates),\n        },\n        len(scores) or run.scored_count,\n        [f\"component_artifact:{row.run_id}:{row.question_id}:{row.upstream_fs}:{row.artifact_kind}\" for row in artifacts],\n    )\n\n\ndef fs5_metrics(\n    run: StoredValidationRun,\n    *,\n    spec: TuneSpec,\n    split_name: SplitName,\n    storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig,\n) -> tuple[dict[str, float], int, list[str]]:\n    artifacts = component_artifacts(run, upstream_fs=\"FS5\", spec=spec, split_name=split_name, storage_config=storage_config)\n    direction: list[float] = []\n    calibration: list[float] = []\n    for row in artifacts:\n        if row.artifact_kind != \"edge_weight_estimation\":\n            continue\n        records = list(row.payload.get(\"records\") or [])\n        if not records:\n            continue\n        non_review = sum(1 for item in records if isinstance(item, dict) and not bool(item.get(\"review_required\")))\n        weak = int(row.payload.get(\"weak_edge_count\") or 0)\n        direction.append(non_review / float(len(records)))\n        calibration.append(max(0.0, 1.0 - (weak / float(len(records)))))\n    scorecards = fs11_scorecards_for_run(\n        run,\n        storage_config=storage_config,\n        score_families={\"Graph\"},\n        scorecard_mode=\"FS5 edge-quality\",\n    )\n    if scorecards:\n        direction.extend(float(row.normalised) for row in scorecards)\n        calibration.extend(float(row.normalised) for row in scorecards)\n    usefulness = mean([float(row.normalised) for row in scorecards], max(0.0, 1.0 - float(run.mean_brier)))\n    return (\n        {\n            \"reviewed_direction_agreement\": mean(direction),\n            \"weight_calibration\": mean(calibration),\n            \"downstream_usefulness\": usefulness,\n        },\n        max(len(artifacts), len(scorecards)),\n        [\n            *[f\"component_artifact:{row.run_id}:{row.question_id}:{row.upstream_fs}:{row.artifact_kind}\" for row in artifacts],\n            *scorecard_ids(scorecards),\n        ],\n    )\n"
}

  "content": "\"\"\"DB-backed real evaluator for FS2-FS5 analytical tuning.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom collections.abc import Callable, Mapping\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom fs10_validation.real_tune.metrics import fs3_metrics, fs4_metrics, fs5_metrics\nfrom fs10_validation.real_tune.metrics_fs2 import fs2_metrics\nfrom fs10_validation.real_tune.run_lookup import (\n    REAL_EVALUATOR_NAME,\n    context_matches,\n    explicit_metrics,\n    run_matches_model_set,\n    tune_context,\n)\nfrom fs10_validation.run_store import StoredValidationRun, list_validation_runs, load_validation_run\nfrom fs10_validation.tuning import SplitName, TuneCandidate, TuneSpec\nfrom packages.storage.runtime_config import StorageRuntimeConfig\n\nREAL_EVIDENCE_MODE_REPLAY = \"replay\"\nREAL_EVIDENCE_MODE_LIVE = \"live\"\nREAL_EVIDENCE_MODES = frozenset({REAL_EVIDENCE_MODE_REPLAY, REAL_EVIDENCE_MODE_LIVE})\nREAL_TUNE_ACCEPTANCE_FS_IDS = frozenset({\"FS2\", \"FS3\", \"FS4\", \"FS5\"})\n\n\nclass RealTuneEvidenceMissing(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"Raised when a real tune evaluation has no DB-backed evidence.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef resolve_real_evidence_mode(live_mode: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Resolve the explicit real-evidence mode for FS10 real tuning.\"\"\"\n\n    payload = dict(live_mode or {})\n    mode = str(payload.get(\"real_evidence_mode\") or \"\").strip().lower()\n    if not mode:\n        mode = REAL_EVIDENCE_MODE_LIVE if bool(payload.get(\"live_allowed\")) else REAL_EVIDENCE_MODE_REPLAY\n    if mode not in REAL_EVIDENCE_MODES:\n        raise ValueError(f\"real_evidence_mode must be one of replay or live, got {mode!r}\")\n    return mode\n\n\nclass RealTuneEvaluator:\n    \"\"\"Evaluate tune candidates against persisted validation runs.\n\n    The evaluator is intentionally DB-first. It reuses matching validation\n    evidence when available and invokes ``run_fs10_validation`` only when the\n    tune spec's live mode explicitly allows live execution.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        *,\n        storage_config: StorageRuntimeConfig,\n        runner: Callable[..., dict[str, Any]] | None = None,\n    ) -> None:\n        self.storage_config = storage_config\n        self._runner = runner\n        self._cache: dict[tuple[str, str, str, str, str], Mapping[str, Any]] = {}\n\n    def __call__(self, spec: TuneSpec, candidate: TuneCandidate, split_name: SplitName) -> Mapping[str, Any]:\n        key = (spec.fs_id, spec.cohort_id, spec.split_version, candidate.candidate_id, split_name)\n        cached = self._cache.get(key)\n        if cached is not None:\n            return cached\n\n        real_evidence_mode = resolve_real_evidence_mode(spec.live_mode)\n        run = self._find_matching_run(spec=spec, candidate=candidate, split_name=split_name)\n        if run is None and real_evidence_mode == REAL_EVIDENCE_MODE_LIVE:\n            run = self._run_missing_evidence(spec=spec, candidate=candidate, split_name=split_name)\n        if run is None:\n            raise RealTuneEvidenceMissing(\n                \"real tune evidence is missing for \"\n                f\"{spec.fs_id} {candidate.candidate_id!r} {spec.cohort_id}:{spec.split_version}:{split_name}; \"\n                \"rerun with --real-evidence-mode live or --live to create DB-backed evidence\"\n            )\n\n        payload = self._evaluate_run(spec=spec, candidate=candidate, split_name=split_name, run=run)\n        self._cache[key] = payload\n        return payload\n\n    def _find_matching_run(\n        self,\n        *,\n        spec: TuneSpec,\n        candidate: TuneCandidate,\n        split_name: SplitName,\n    ) -> StoredValidationRun | None:\n        for run in list_validation_runs(set_name=spec.cohort_id, storage_config=self.storage_config):\n            context = tune_context(run)\n            if context_matches(context, spec=spec, candidate=candidate, split_name=split_name) and run_matches_model_set(run, spec=spec):\n                return run\n        return None\n\n    def _run_missing_evidence(\n        self,\n        *,\n        spec: TuneSpec,\n        candidate: TuneCandidate,\n        split_name: SplitName,\n    ) -> StoredValidationRun:\n        runner = self._runner\n        if runner is None:\n            # Deferred import: runner.py is part of PR4 scope. Live-evidence\n            # mode only fires when the spec explicitly opts in, so the import\n            # only runs at that point.\n            from fs10_validation.runner import run_fs10_validation\n\n            runner = run_fs10_validation\n\n        context = {\n            \"kind\": \"tune_evidence\",\n            \"evaluator\": REAL_EVALUATOR_NAME,\n            \"fs_id\": spec.fs_id,\n            \"gate_id\": spec.gate_id,\n            \"cohort_id\": spec.cohort_id,\n            \"split_version\": spec.split_version,\n            \"split_name\": split_name,\n            \"candidate_id\": candidate.candidate_id,\n            \"primary_metric\": spec.primary_metric,\n            \"metric_goal\": spec.metric_goal,\n            \"real_evidence_mode\": REAL_EVIDENCE_MODE_LIVE,\n            \"validation_package_id\": spec.live_mode.get(\"validation_package_id\"),\n            \"model_set\": spec.live_mode.get(\"model_set\"),\n            \"model_family\": spec.live_mode.get(\"model_family\"),\n            \"candidate_parameters\": dict(candidate.parameters),\n        }\n        question_limit = int(spec.live_mode.get(\"tune_question_limit\") or spec.live_mode.get(\"max_questions\") or 0)\n        if question_limit > 0:\n            context[\"max_questions\"] = question_limit\n            context[\"tune_question_limit\"] = question_limit\n        run_config_overrides = {\n            \"fs10_tune_context\": context,\n            \"fs10_tune_candidate\": candidate.to_dict(),\n            **dict(candidate.parameters),\n        }\n        model_set = str(spec.live_mode.get(\"model_set\") or \"\").strip()\n        if model_set:\n            run_config_overrides[\"model_set\"] = model_set\n        workspace = self._workspace_for(spec=spec, candidate=candidate, split_name=split_name)\n        runner_kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {\n            \"set_name\": spec.cohort_id,\n            \"graphs_dir\": workspace / \"graphs\",\n            \"output_root\": workspace / \"runs\",\n            \"results_root\": workspace / \"results\",\n            \"skip_existing\": False,\n            \"storage_config\": self.storage_config,\n            \"run_config_overrides\": run_config_overrides,\n            \"validation_context\": context,\n        }\n        result = runner(**runner_kwargs)\n        run_id = str(result.get(\"run_id\") or \"\").strip()\n        run = load_validation_run(run_id=run_id, storage_config=self.storage_config) if run_id else None\n        if run is None:\n            raise RealTuneEvidenceMissing(f\"live real tune runner did not persist validation evidence for run_id={run_id!r}\")\n        return run\n\n    def _workspace_for(self, *, spec: TuneSpec, candidate: TuneCandidate, split_name: SplitName) -> Path:\n        def clean(value: str) -> str:\n            return \"\".join(ch if ch.isalnum() or ch in {\"-\", \"_\"} else \"_\" for ch in value).strip(\"_\") or \"unknown\"\n\n        return (\n            Path(self.storage_config.local_workspace_root)\n            / \"fs10_validation_tune\"\n            / clean(spec.fs_id)\n            / clean(spec.cohort_id)\n            / clean(spec.split_version)\n            / clean(candidate.candidate_id)\n            / clean(split_name)\n        )\n\n    def _evaluate_run(\n        self,\n        *,\n        spec: TuneSpec,\n        candidate: TuneCandidate,\n        split_name: SplitName,\n        run: StoredValidationRun,\n    ) -> Mapping[str, Any]:\n        explicit = explicit_metrics(run, fs_id=spec.fs_id, candidate_id=candidate.candidate_id, split_name=split_name)\n        if explicit is not None:\n            metrics, sample_size, evidence_ids = explicit\n        elif spec.fs_id == \"FS2\":\n            metrics, sample_size, evidence_ids = fs2_metrics(\n                run,\n                spec=spec,\n                candidate=candidate,\n                split_name=split_name,\n                storage_config=self.storage_config,\n            )\n        elif spec.fs_id == \"FS3\":\n            metrics, sample_size, evidence_ids = fs3_metrics(run, spec=spec, split_name=split_name, storage_config=self.storage_config)\n        elif spec.fs_id == \"FS4\":\n            metrics, sample_size, evidence_ids = fs4_metrics(run, spec=spec, split_name=split_name, storage_config=self.storage_config)\n        elif spec.fs_id == \"FS5\":\n            metrics, sample_size, evidence_ids = fs5_metrics(run, spec=spec, split_name=split_name, storage_config=self.storage_config)\n        else:\n            raise ValueError(f\"real evaluator is only implemented for FS2-FS5, got {spec.fs_id!r}\")\n\n        if spec.primary_metric not in metrics:\n            raise ValueError(f\"real evaluator did not produce primary metric {spec.primary_metric!r}\")\n        if sample_size <= 0:\n            raise RealTuneEvidenceMissing(\n                f\"real tune evidence for {spec.fs_id} {candidate.candidate_id!r} {split_name!r} has sample_size=0; \"\n                \"expected persisted validation runs, component artifacts, metric snapshots, or FS11 scorecards\"\n            )\n        return {\n            \"metrics\": metrics,\n            \"sample_size\": sample_size,\n            \"evidence_ids\": [f\"validation_run:{run.run_id}\", *evidence_ids],\n        }\n"
}

1	 ## Code quality patterns
2	
3	  ### Anti-patterns — reject on sight
4	
5	  - **Inline system prompts** — prompts must live in `prompts/` and load via `default_prompt_store().load(...)`.
6	  Never `_SYSTEM_PROMPT = "..."`.
7	  - **JSON files as storage** — all persistent state goes through the database via `packages/storage/`. JSON file
8	  storage is retired.
9	  - **Defensive string wrapping on comparisons** — `str(x or "").strip().upper() == "CONDITIONAL"` adds nothing over
10	   `x == "CONDITIONAL"`. Reject it.
11	  - **Global mutation + lazy imports** — `global _x` inside a function body with an inline import is a scratch
12	  pattern. Revert it. If a circular import forces deferred loading, use a function-scoped `from X import Y`
13	  (Python caches imports after first call). Never use module-level `Any | None` sentinels with `global`
14	  mutation and tuple-of-`Any` return values — it destroys type information for no benefit.
15	  - **Dropped model resolution fallback** — use `model or resolve_role_model("tool")`, not `str(model or
16	  "").strip()`.
17	  - **Module-level model resolution constants** — `MY_MODEL = resolve_task_model("FS3.task")` at module scope
18	  resolves at import time and exports an internal detail as a public constant. Call `resolve_task_model()`
19	  at the point of use. Tests should call it directly, not import a "compatibility alias".
20	  - **ORM Row class defined outside `packages/storage/database.py`** — every SQLAlchemy `Base` subclass must
21	  live in `packages/storage/database.py`. Defining a Row class in a domain module (e.g. `fitted_params_store.py`)
22	  makes the table invisible to the shared Base until that module is imported, silently allows tables to
23	  diverge from the canonical schema inventory, and hides the class from the `__all__` export in `database.py`.
24	  - **No-op list comprehensions and indiscriminate type coercion** — `[item for item in list(x or [])]` is
25	  just `list(x or [])`. And wrapping every DB field in `str(row.field or "")` regardless of nullability
26	  obscures which fields are actually nullable. Coerce only where the source type genuinely differs from the
27	  target type; don't apply `str()` / `int()` / `float()` uniformly to fields that are already the correct
28	  type.
29	  - **Dead code left behind** — if a function appears to have no callers, flag it. Grep for callers first; if
30	  there are none, confirm with the user before removing. Don't silently leave dead code with "compatibility
31	  alias" or "legacy" comments, but don't silently delete it either.
32	  - **`os.environ` deep in domain code** — environment variables should be read at the edges (config loading,
33	  CLI entry points, runtime initialization) and threaded through as typed config. Checking
34	  `os.environ.get("LITELLM_PROXY_BASE_URL")` inside a function that builds LLM messages means behavior
35	  changes silently based on env state, is untestable without monkeypatching `os.environ`, and buries
36	  configuration decisions where no one will find them.
37	  - **One file, one concern** — a module that mixes type definitions, algorithm logic, AND large blocks
38	  of declarative configuration data is doing too much. Split by rate-of-change: data that domain experts
39	  tweak (metric expectations, profiles, registries, thresholds) belongs in its own file, separate from
40	  the code that consumes it. Example: `fs10_validation/tuning.py` originally held `TuneSpec` /
41	  `run_tune()` plus a ~200-line `DEFAULT_PROFILES` table of per-feature-set baseline metrics. The
42	  profiles were moved to `fs10_validation/tuning_profiles.py` because tweaking expected metric values
43	  has nothing to do with the tuning algorithm. Same rule for surface registries, prompt catalogues,
44	  gate sequence definitions — if it's data that lives alongside code, ask whether the data has its own
45	  reason to change.
46	
47	  ### Architectural patterns — always follow
48	
49	  - LLM tools inherit from `BaseLLMTool` and every `LLMConfig()` must have `task_id=`.
50	  - Use `resolve_task_model("FS3.task")` for named tasks, `resolve_role_model("tool"|"agent")` for generic
51	  fallbacks. Never hardcode model names.
52	  - All stage results use `build_stage_outcome()`. Never return ad-hoc dicts.
53	  - All graph nodes use `build_node_data()` / `build_origin()` / `build_provenance()`.
54	  - Direct SQL access is confined to `packages/storage/database.py`. Domain code never touches S
55	
```
